notes.title: 00 - All Islands
notes.body:
**Islands**

-   'The Bear': Mainland [Thylea](wiki:thylea)
-   'The Gygan': island of Yonder [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder)
    -   Part of Antikythera is here.
    -   **[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) wants to go here for our friend of the cult. ([Gaius](wiki:gaius))**
-   'The Prisoner': [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)
    -   Active volcano.
    -   The 'lizard folk' live here. They make great weapons. (There's several tribes that are warring with each other)
    -   **[Versi](wiki:versi) sees a dragon egg there for me!**
-   'The Heart': goes to the island 'the golden heart'.
    -   Where 'the heart of Thylea' is.
-   'The Trickster': [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island)
    -   There's a highly aggressive Chymera on this island. King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) has set a bounty on its head of 1000 gold pieces.
-   'The Bard': [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates)
    -   **[Atyche](wiki:atyche) wants to go here.**
-   'The warrior': The island of the exiles
    -   Australia mate!
    -   Sent here if you make a big boo-boo
-   'The Centaur': [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
    -   **[Brax](wiki:brax) wants to go to.**
-   'The Queen': Indigo Island
    -   A large collection of barbarian warriors.
    -   A place of travel for barbarians to learn new things.
    -   The birthplace of all barbarians in Thylea.
    -   Indigo Tribes: there are multiple. Shipwrecked on the Thylea thousands of years ago, helped by the natives, and sailed to and sailed to indigo island. They fought on the side of the natives in the first war.
    -   They like fish.
-   'The Twins': The island of [Themis](wiki:themis):
    -   Home of [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons).
    -   'Calimero?'
-   'The ant': Titan's Folley.
    -   3 perfectly molded green hills.
    -   Encompassed by a giant glass dome.
    -   Can be bypassed by teleportation magic.
    -   _Must be avoided at all cost._
    -   Rumored to be the home of Thylea's greatest treasure.
    -   Sealed away by [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan) as a result of the first war of the gods (so not the war of the dragonlords)
    -   Known by all fishermen, for the legend says that it is the home of Thylea’s greatest treasure.
-   'Titan': probably [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)?
-   'The dreamer': [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis)
    -   probably [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)?
    - There's a whirlpool here - see [Session 27](wiki:session-27).
-   'The Centaur': [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
    -   Something something monk/cleric.
-   'The Chariot': [Garden of Helios](wiki:gardens-of-helios) .
    -   [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) wants to go here. Dragon egg?
-   ‘The End’: [Titan’s Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley)
-   ‘???’: the Island of the Oathbreakers
    -   Daar is iemand van Thyphoon z’n backstory.
-   ‘The Spear’: [Typhon](wiki:typhon)

notes.title: Acustus
notes.body:
The last true descendant of the Dragonlords
Husband of the wisest of [the 5 gods](wiki:the-five), [Vallus](wiki:vallus)
Has resurrected the race of dragons.

- King of [Mytros](wiki:mytros). On [Day 1](wiki:day-1) we found a scroll with his order to find out about the heroes and report back ([Session 1](wiki:session-1)).
- Said to have a dozen dragons under his command ([Session 6](wiki:session-6)).
- Last descendant of [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander) ([Session 13](wiki:session-13)).
- At court during Sydon's storm he asks us to choose how to end it ([Session 22](wiki:session-22), [Day 11](wiki:day-11)). Has had his dragons for over half a year, which is unnaturally fast, and wants to found a new order of dragonlords. His own dragon is [Icarus](wiki:icarus). Has a hard time sleeping ([Session 23](wiki:session-23)).
- Summons us to Mytros with three dragonriders ([Session 19](wiki:session-19), [Day 8](wiki:day-8)).

notes.title: Advisor Polyphorus
notes.body:
Was the chief advisor to [King Jamkor](wiki:king-jamkor). A devotee of the [Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan).

Used to be the "true ruler".

notes.title: Aesop
notes.body:
Priest and keeper of the [Dragon Shrine](wiki:dragon-shrine) in [Estoria](wiki:estoria).

- Asks us to return the stolen [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria) to [Vallus](wiki:vallus) ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)).
- We ask him about the cold portal in the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines) (legends of a race that "crawled from the earth") and about the dragons: [Acustus](wiki:acustus) has sworn to bring back the dragonlords and now has a small flight of young dragons ([Session 20](wiki:session-20), [Day 9](wiki:day-9)).
- Mentioned again in [Session 43](wiki:session-43). Sends us a letter that 4 dragons have been captured by the Titan ([Session 44](wiki:session-44)).
- Possibly sworn to ([Oaths](wiki:oaths)). Quoted in [Summoning the New Gods](wiki:summoning-the-new-gods).

notes.title: Amalthelia
notes.body:
[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)'s grandmother, a heroic nymph. Killed by [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) ([Session 5](wiki:session-5)).

- Shown on the amulet [Versi](wiki:versi) gave Thyphoon: hand in hand with a black-robed figure, walking towards a sunrise. The amulet glowed red-hot and she spoke to Thyphoon: he needs to bring back the dragonlords ([Session 21](wiki:session-21), [Day 9](wiki:day-9)).

notes.title: Chalcia's Essence
notes.body:
[Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan)'s Essence
Wondrous Item, rare

This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. The amount of Chalcia's essence found is: 8.

You can use an action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes on impact and is destroyed. Each creature within a 10-foot radius of where the bead landed must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5d4 force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save, or are partially within the area, are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No attack or other effect can.

An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's walking speed. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.

Notes: Damage: Force, Damage, Control, Combat, Consumable

notes.title: Chimera Island
notes.body:
Constellation of the trickster

> “See those stars that are shaped like a flower? That's
the constellation of the Trickster. There once was
a nobleman who took great pride in the vast rose
gardens that bloomed on his estate. Eventually, these
roses attracted the attention of the great trickster
goddess, whose name has been forgotten.
“The goddess admired the nobleman’s beautiful
flowers, but she mocked his boasts: it was his servants
who deserved the credit, for they tended his gardens.
So the nobleman made the goddess a wager—if he
could grow a field of red roses without the aid of his
servants, then she must agree to marry him.
“She agreed, and for a year the nobleman tended
a plot in his garden with his own two hands: planting
the seeds, cultivating the soil, watering and weeding
every day. It was humbling, back-breaking work for the
vain nobleman, but the seeds eventually took root and
grew. But when the bushes finally flowered, the petals
were not red, but white—the goddess had switched
the seeds to teach the braggart a lesson!”

[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) tells us:
There's a bounty on this island due to the legend that it kills everything that comes near.

notes.title: Cult of Lutheria
notes.body:
The followers of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan). Their priest [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus), a tiefling, sits at the court of King [Acustus](wiki:acustus).

- When Sydon's storm hit [Mytros](wiki:mytros), Chondrus proposed letting 70 children "take the black robe" to soothe Lutheria ([Session 22](wiki:session-22), [Day 11](wiki:day-11)).
- All wine in and around Mytros comes from Lutheria and her followers ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).
- Their temple in Mytros hid a dungeon of sacrifices; their wine is enhanced with the blood. Strongest outside Mytros on [Themis](wiki:themis), where they are the "Death Cult of Lutheria". We exposed them and the king banned them from Mytros ([Session 34](wiki:session-34), [Session 35](wiki:session-35), [Session 36](wiki:session-36), In Vino Veritas).

notes.title: Damon
notes.body:
One of the Dragonlords. Sealed something away behind doors after failing to defeat it.

- Guardian of the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok). [Versi](wiki:versi) tells [Brax](wiki:brax) to talk to him to lift his family's curse ([Session 5](wiki:session-5), [Day 2](wiki:day-2)).
- A graverobber in [Estoria](wiki:estoria) tried to sell us Damon's cursed necklace, stolen from the Necropolis ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)).
- We pay him to enter the Necropolis ([Session 24](wiki:session-24), [Day 16](wiki:day-16)).
- Appeared as a cloaked, skeletal figure in the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple) when Brax went down, zombified the Gygan and handed me a scroll of Raise the Dead ([Session 9](wiki:session-9), [Day 4](wiki:day-4)).

fields.summary: A Corrupted Celestial Boar

notes.body:
# Day 1

A Corrupted Celestial Boar

## Recap

- We enter [Thylea](wiki:thylea) and gather at the Sour Vintage inn, answering the call for heroes ([Session 1](wiki:session-1)).
- On the road through the forest we kill a great winged beast feeding on a horse, and find an order from King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) of [Mytros](wiki:mytros) to spy on the heroes.
- The Great Hunt: with Tenaias we kill an ordinary boar ([Session 2](wiki:session-2)), then the true great boar. [Brax](wiki:brax) lands the killing blow and [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)'s voice threatens us telepathically. [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) resurrects [Atyche](wiki:atyche), and we burn Javon ([Session 3](wiki:session-3)).
- We leave for the temple of the Oracle.

notes.title: Day 10

fields.summary: Traveling to [[Mytros]], we kill [[Hamun Kost]]

notes.body:
# Day 10

Traveling to [Mytros](wiki:mytros), we kill [Hamun Kost](wiki:hamun-kost)

## Recap

- [Brax](wiki:brax) draws from a deck of many things: the Lovers, Temperance and the Devil ([Session 21](wiki:session-21)). Epic verse: Brax the great.
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)'s amulet glows and his grandmother [Amalthelia](wiki:amalthelia) tells him to bring back the dragonlords.
- We find [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) leaning against a tree. In a rotting clearing we find a pit of papers guarded by a skeletal minotaur, and a book by [Hamun Kost](wiki:hamun-kost). I recognize a map of the Sword Coast. Hamun steps out of his tent and Brax obliterates him.
- 18:00: we travel on and camp at a crossroads: north to [Estoria](wiki:estoria), south to [Mytros](wiki:mytros), west to the [Southern Settlements](wiki:southern-settlements). A satyr, Qempas, attacks us; we tie him up. He tells us Mytros is in lockdown, a face was seen in the clouds, [Pythor](wiki:pythor) is rumored to have stepped down, and how to bribe our way in through the Soldier's Gate ([Session 22](wiki:session-22)).

notes.title: Day 11

notes.body:
# Day 11

King Acustus' proposition

## Recap

- We arrive at [Mytros](wiki:mytros). [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) looks at us from the storm and attacks; [Brax](wiki:brax) gets lightning scars ([Session 22](wiki:session-22)).
- At the palace, [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus), [Gaius](wiki:gaius), [Vallus](wiki:vallus), King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) and [Bella the Concubine](wiki:bella-the-concubine) each propose a way to end the storm. We choose Vallus' plan: [The Five](wiki:the-five) sacrifice part of their divinity.
- Vallus tells us to bring the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) to her own harbor, and that Acustus' dragons grew unnaturally fast. The gods perform the ritual and the clouds clear ([Session 23](wiki:session-23)).

The Dream on [Versi](wiki:versi) ([Session 76](wiki:session-76)) shows a group walking into a throne room where two chairs are suddenly empty ([Session 22](wiki:session-22)). A [paradox](wiki:paradox-tokens).

# Day 16

The [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) and the Tomb of [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath)

**16a** - At The Necropolis (Day)

**16b** - The Tomb of [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath) (Night)

## Recap

- We arrive at the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) and pay [Damon](wiki:damon) to enter. [Brax](wiki:brax) gets the Gem of Brightness. We inspect the tombs and find the door of [Telamok Arklander](wiki:telamok-arklander), oathsworn of [Vallus](wiki:vallus) ([Session 24](wiki:session-24)).
- Timeline: winding paths to Telamok, the gravesites, and the tomb of [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath).
- Around 21:00, after a long rest, we enter the tomb. The minotaur Graxis guards it with what look like Xander's axe and shield; we scare him off and loot his lair. Skeletal hoplites, and a rug of smothering and a mimic sarcophagus ([Session 25](wiki:session-25)).
- We kill Graxis. [Atyche](wiki:atyche) is swallowed by a gelatinous cube and freed to [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)'s cackling laugh. Xander gives crowns of the dragonlords to me and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon), tells me [Gaius](wiki:gaius) stole my armor, and gives us the Axe of Xander ([Session 26](wiki:session-26)).

notes.title: Day 17

fields.summary: Traveling back to Mytros

notes.body:
# Day 17

Traveling back to Mytros

## Recap

- In the morning outside the tomb we learn about the [Ultros](wiki:ultros): its last known location is the Dead Falls. We decide to go to [Mytros](wiki:mytros) first ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).
- At a bridge we find Stimfay with dead centaurs and [Amazons](wiki:the-amazons); [Brax](wiki:brax) lures one. Then 2 days of travel.

notes.title: Day 18

fields.summary: On the way to [[Mytros]]

notes.body:
# Day 18

On the way to [Mytros](wiki:mytros)

## Recap

- Still traveling to [Mytros](wiki:mytros) ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).
- The shared timeline puts an encounter with [Hamun Kost](wiki:hamun-kost) here, but [Session 21](wiki:session-21) and [Session 69](wiki:session-69) place it on [Day 10](wiki:day-10).

notes.title: Day 19

fields.summary: Back in Mytros

notes.body:
# Day 19

Back in Mytros

## Recap

- Morning: we arrive in [Mytros](wiki:mytros) and stay at the Siren's Roost. Rumors about [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis), [Aresia](wiki:aresia) and [Themis](wiki:themis) sending teams for the Great Games. [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) sings The Haphazard Harpy's; Ambrosia explains the factions around [Acustus](wiki:acustus), [Vallus](wiki:vallus) and [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).
- Market (Zorin's concoctions), the palace (Atyche talks with the queen), Neurdagon wants the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) found, the story of [Summoning the New Gods](wiki:summoning-the-new-gods), and the great debates with the philosophers ([Session 28](wiki:session-28)).
- Timeline: exploring the city proper, the Great Agora.
- [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) sings The haphazard harpy's at the Siren's Roost ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).

notes.title: Day 2

fields.summary: [[Versi]], the Oracle

notes.body:
# Day 2

[Versi](wiki:versi), the Oracle

## Recap

- We free [Versi](wiki:versi) in the temple of the Oracle ([Session 4](wiki:session-4)).
- Versi gives us the three great tasks ([quests](wiki:quests)) and answers one question each about our fate. [Brax](wiki:brax) and [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) are sent to the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) ([Damon](wiki:damon), [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath)), [Atyche](wiki:atyche) to [Demetria](wiki:demetria) at the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple), and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) learns that [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) killed his grandmother and gets a locket ([Session 5](wiki:session-5)).
- We set out for [Estoria](wiki:estoria) and dream of a taunting [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) ([Session 6](wiki:session-6)).

notes.title: Day 20

fields.summary: Exploring [[Mytros]]: Stygian Row

notes.body:
# Day 20

Exploring [Mytros](wiki:mytros): Stygian Row

## Recap

*No session notes for this day. From the shared timeline:* exploring [Mytros](wiki:mytros), Stygian Row.

notes.title: Day 21

fields.summary: Exploring [[Mytros]]: Bathhouse of Vallus

notes.body:
# Day 21

Exploring [Mytros](wiki:mytros): Bathhouse of Vallus

## Recap

*No session notes for this day. From the shared timeline:* exploring [Mytros](wiki:mytros), the Bathhouse of [Vallus](wiki:vallus).

notes.title: Day 22

fields.summary: Great Games - First Day

notes.body:
# Day 22

Great Games - First Day

## Recap

*No session notes for this day. From the shared timeline:* the first day of the Great Games. The opening (the minotaur sacrifice that [Brax](wiki:brax) stops) is written down in [Session 29](wiki:session-29), together with the long jump.

notes.title: Day 23

fields.summary: Second day in Mytros - Great Games - Long Jump

notes.body:
# Day 23

Second day in Mytros - Great Games - Long Jump

## Recap

- The judges include [Versi](wiki:versi), [Vallus](wiki:vallus) and [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus). [Brax](wiki:brax) stops the daily minotaur sacrifice and fights [Bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi) instead ([Session 29](wiki:session-29)).
- Long jump: Brax first, [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) shared second. Bullbug joins the party.
- At the temple of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), Trellus offers a bounty for the bandits in the grape fields. In the menagerie, Thyphoon dispels the illusion: a spellbook, 50 platinum, and Craig the centaur, captured by Maximus the Merciless.
- At the Neurdagon estate we learn the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) is a Medusa who petrifies nobles. Bounty: 8000 gold.
- Epic verse: The collector had a store

notes.title: Day 24

fields.summary: Third day in Mytros - Great Games - Running

notes.body:
# Day 24

Third day in Mytros - Great Games - Running

## Recap

- The run: [Brax](wiki:brax) first, [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) second; I nearly drop out ([Session 30](wiki:session-30)).
- At the Satyr's Tail, Fryxon points us to Nero, and we agree to meet the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) tomorrow.
- Rumors at the bath house: the great chimera of the Cerulean Gulf took 12 victims.

notes.title: Day 25

fields.summary: Fourth day in Mytros - Great Games - Javelin throwing

notes.body:
# Day 25

Fourth day in Mytros - Great Games - Javelin throwing

## Recap

- Javelin throwing. In the vineyards we meet Boreas, one of the four winds, playing a harp. We ask [Vallus](wiki:vallus) for advice. A dagger with a letter from the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) summons us to the foot of the statue of [Pythor](wiki:pythor) ([Session 31](wiki:session-31)).
- 18:00 at the colossus: [Brax](wiki:brax) breaks off [the sword](wiki:the-sword) in the stone, we destroy the statues guarding the entrance, and [Atyche](wiki:atyche) teleports in. On the next floor we find a strange contraption and run back to the inn ([Session 32](wiki:session-32)).
- Epic verse: The fight at the drunkard's feet

notes.title: Day 26

fields.summary: Fifth day in Mytros - Great Games - Discus throwing

notes.body:
# Day 26

Fifth day in Mytros - Great Games - Discus throwing

## Recap

- Discus: [Brax](wiki:brax) first, [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) second, me and Hatria shared third. In the wine fields we knock out the group with the Boreal Harp, but the harp is destroyed ([Session 33](wiki:session-33)).
- 17:00 tour of the temple of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), with [Vallus](wiki:vallus) disguised as Brunhilda Philona. We find a dungeon full of prisoners and get Trellus to talk: the cult's wine is enhanced with sacrifices' blood, and it is strongest on [Themis](wiki:themis) ([Session 34](wiki:session-34)).
- [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) clear the temple and we free Boreas and his brothers ([Session 35](wiki:session-35)).
- Epic verse: In Vino Veritas

notes.title: Day 27

fields.summary: Sixth day in Mytros - Great Games - Wrestling

notes.body:
# Day 27

Sixth day in Mytros - Great Games - Wrestling

## Recap

- 03:00: a dream of two children who become guardians of Lutheria's temple. We wake up under [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)'s influence ([Session 35](wiki:session-35)).
- Wrestling trials: a drunk bear, Egan and Jorges. The temple of Lutheria is taken down and its high priests commit suicide.
- Massage at the bath house, Vitalis in the gardens, and the vault of [Thylea](wiki:thylea) ([Session 36](wiki:session-36)).

notes.title: Day 28

fields.summary: Seventh day in Mytros - Great Games - Boxing

notes.body:
# Day 28

Seventh day in Mytros - Great Games - Boxing

## Recap

- Boxing against "Smasher", a bear. The queen gives me a paper naming me inheritor of [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) Gyrahaeras / Gareth Hearsay Nydia: 500 platinum remain in the account. Tips at the fish market about sailing ([Session 36](wiki:session-36)).
- Ambrosia explains the relay and offers a sponsorship ([Session 37](wiki:session-37)).

notes.title: Day 29

fields.summary: Eighth day in Mytros - Great Games - The Great Relay

notes.body:
# Day 29

Eighth day in Mytros - Great Games - The Great Relay

## Recap

- We win the Great Relay. The King of Estoria ([Pythor](wiki:pythor)) hands us our medals. 3 fame levels, 8 in total. The Siren's Roost becomes "The Siren's Roost - The Bardian's Bastion" ([Session 37](wiki:session-37)).
- Epic verse: Winning the great games of Mytros

notes.title: Day 3

fields.summary: King [[Pythor]] of [[Estoria]]

notes.body:
# Day 3

King [Pythor](wiki:pythor) of [Estoria](wiki:estoria)

## Recap

- In [Estoria](wiki:estoria), [Pythor](wiki:pythor) tells us his daughter is to be sacrificed at the Rock of Estor. At the [Dragon Shrine](wiki:dragon-shrine), [Aesop](wiki:aesop) tells us the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria) was stolen and asks us to bring it to [Vallus](wiki:vallus) ([Session 6](wiki:session-6)).
- A graverobber tries to sell us [Damon](wiki:damon)'s cursed necklace from the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok).
- We follow the wine trail south to the edge of the Old Wood, are ambushed by goatlings, save [Corinna](wiki:corinna) and meet [Loreas](wiki:loreas) ([Session 7](wiki:session-7)).
- We sneak into the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple).

notes.title: Day 30

fields.summary: Leaving Mytros

notes.body:
# Day 30

Leaving Mytros

## Recap

- Around 06:00 I wake to [Versi](wiki:versi) fighting the girl I took upstairs. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) learns Versi is his aunt, once removed ([Session 38](wiki:session-38)).
- We set out with the King's map to the Dead Falls. We see centaurs fighting bandits and fight wolves at night.

notes.title: Day 31

fields.summary: Back to the Mithral Mines

notes.body:
# Day 31

Back to the Mithral Mines

## Recap

- [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) is gone. At the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines) we see cranium rats, and [Volkan](wiki:volkan) and [Fajra](wiki:fajra) hand us our ordered items ([Session 39](wiki:session-39)).
- The psionic creatures from the Underdark show me visions of Yduld'itherh and [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), then close their portal. I can cast telepathy for 5 days ([Session 40](wiki:session-40), [The Tragedy of the Underdark](wiki:)).
- The story of [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander) and the first war. In the evening, at the Sour Vintage inn, Kyrah is back, and Javon tells us the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) was seen on the river Lethe.

notes.title: Day 32

fields.summary: The Ultros

notes.body:
# Day 32

The Ultros

## Recap

- We beat Zephyrus for the Zephyr Lute and find a gold statuette of Helios. Through the Rapids of the Lethe and the clashing cliffs to the silent waterfall at the Dead Falls, where we find the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) and fight a specter ([Session 40](wiki:session-40)).
- We sail underwater to [Mytros](wiki:mytros). In a dream, [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander) makes us swear the oath ([Oaths](wiki:oaths)) and we kill Davos, Metron and Skathon. I become captain but refuse his powers. King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) calls the Ultros a relic. Level 6 ([Session 41](wiki:session-41)).

notes.title: Day 33

fields.summary: Back in Mytros

notes.body:
# Day 33

Back in Mytros

## Recap

- Outfitting the [Ultros](wiki:ultros): [Pythor](wiki:pythor), [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah), [Versi](wiki:versi), [Loreas](wiki:loreas) and 2 Amazons join, and we recruit a full crew ([Session 42](wiki:session-42), [Crew of the Ultros](wiki:crew-of-the-ultros)).
- The oath of peace ends on day 93.

notes.title: Day 34

fields.summary: Travel to [[Scorpion Island]]

notes.body:
# Day 34

Travel to [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)

## Recap

- In the gardens we ask where dragon eggs can be found: [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island), the Isle of the Fates, and the tower of Praxis ([Session 43](wiki:session-43)).
- We sail from [Mytros](wiki:mytros) to cheers and get a letter from [Aesop](wiki:aesop) about dragons from [Balmytria](wiki:balmytria)'s brood. Kyrah tells the story of the centaur and the scorpion.

notes.title: Day 35

fields.summary: Scorpion Island

notes.body:
# Day 35

Scorpion Island

## Recap

- On [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island) we meet Aresian monks and the drunken centaur Pholon, and go to the obelisk of the Lotus Witch ([Session 43](wiki:session-43)).
- The Lotus Witch, a Sphinx, answers our questions. We fail to save the children. We meet Nessa, and [Brax](wiki:brax) and Pholon have the "bro-dding". We sail for the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) ([Session 44](wiki:session-44)).

notes.title: Day 36

fields.summary: The Isle of the Faiths

notes.body:
# Day 36

The Isle of the Faiths

## Recap

- On the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates), Agave leads us to [The fates](wiki:the-fates). [Atyche](wiki:atyche) gives up endurance to learn about her doom and gets the Robe of the Archmagi ([Session 44](wiki:session-44)).
- More bargains: I learn about [Titan's Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley), [Gardens of Helios](wiki:gardens-of-helios), [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder), [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island) and [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis). [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) gets a dragon egg. We set sail for Fire Island through [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)'s storm. Level up ([Session 45](wiki:session-45)).

notes.title: Day 37

fields.summary: Traveling to [[Fire Island]]

notes.body:
# Day 37

Traveling to [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)

## Recap

- On the way to [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island) we visit the island turtle with its Aresian traders ([Session 46](wiki:session-46)).

notes.title: Day 38

fields.summary: Walk around Fire Island (found the dragon egg)

notes.body:
# Day 38

Walk around Fire Island (found the dragon egg)

## Recap

- Arrival at [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island) ([Session 46](wiki:session-46)). Timeline: meeting [Queen Vita](wiki:queen-vita) and the Tree Climbers, on the way to the volcano.
- We enter the volcano, find my dragon egg and deal with the fire lizards and firewalkers ([Session 47](wiki:session-47)).
- 20:00: we free tree climber prisoners and go to the cave of [Advisor Polyphorus](wiki:advisor-polyphorus) ([Session 48](wiki:session-48)).

notes.title: Day 39

fields.summary: Killed the king of the firewalkers on Fire Island, and started sailing again

notes.body:
# Day 39

Killed the king of the firewalkers on Fire Island, and started sailing again

## Recap

- We kill [King Jamkor](wiki:king-jamkor). [Brax](wiki:brax) throws his trident into the lava, freeing [Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan) ([Session 49](wiki:session-49)).
- Chalcia gives Brax [Chalcia's Essence](wiki:chalcia-s-essence) and tells us [The Birth of the Titans](wiki:the-birth-of-the-titans), [The Creation of the Fey Races](wiki:the-creation-of-the-fey-races) and [The War of the Titans](wiki:the-war-of-the-titans) ([Session 50](wiki:session-50)).
- We meet [Steros the Jancan](wiki:steros-the-jancan) and I remember [How I lost my dragon](wiki:how-i-lost-my-dragon). We wake at 12:00, call [Vallus](wiki:vallus), and [Queen Vita](wiki:queen-vita) thanks us ([Session 51](wiki:session-51)).
- We sail into the storm and, with [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan), dive under the waves ([Session 52](wiki:session-52)).

notes.title: Day 4
notes.body:
# Day 4

[Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple)

## Recap

- Inside the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple) we fight two statues and goatlings and meet a dryad with satyrs ([Session 8](wiki:session-8)).
- [Demetria](wiki:demetria) tells us [Atyche](wiki:atyche) is doomed by [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) herself. The children turn into [Maenad](wiki:maenad)s and a Gygan kills Demetria. [Damon](wiki:damon) appears, zombifies the Gygan and gives us a scroll of Raise the Dead ([Session 9](wiki:session-9), [Session 10](wiki:session-10)).
- We bring the children back towards [Estoria](wiki:estoria). [Corinna](wiki:corinna)'s family gives us a javelin of lightning. We return to [Pythor](wiki:pythor) and drink from the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria), dreaming of the ghost ship [Ultros](wiki:ultros) and the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) ([Session 11](wiki:session-11)).

notes.title: Day 40

fields.summary: Lost on the way to [[Khronos]]

notes.body:
# Day 40

Lost on the way to [Khronos](wiki:khronos)

## Recap

- Timeline: lost while traveling to [Khronos](wiki:khronos). Under the sea we see a merfolk city, then everything goes black, an aurora appears, and we're teleported to another dimension ([Session 52](wiki:session-52)).

notes.title: Day 41

fields.summary: We've skipped a few days and arrive at Khronos.

notes.body:
# Day 41

We've skipped a few days and arrive at Khronos.

## Recap

- On a giant rock island, [Khronos](wiki:khronos) offers to send us back in time. We sacrifice magic items for 46 days, including my Shortbow of Cupidity, and arrive back at [Day 42](wiki:day-42) (relative day -5) at 07:00 ([Session 52](wiki:session-52), Travelling back in time).

notes.title: Day 42

fields.summary: We arrive on The Golden Heart

notes.body:
# Day 42 (-5)

We arrive on The Golden Heart

## Recap

- We arrive at the Golden Heart the evening before and sleep on board. At 08:00 we follow a golden ram to a clearing of apple trees and meditate at the tree of [Thylea](wiki:thylea-titan). She shows [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) a captured Amazon on [Themis](wiki:themis), and shows me [Gaius](wiki:gaius) and Thyphoon hatching dragons. We pick eternal apples, and a Pegasus shows me flashes of murdered lizardfolk ([Session 53](wiki:session-53)).
- Mother Thylea appears and shows us the birth of [The Titans](wiki:the-titans), [Talieus](wiki:talieus-titan)' downfall and [the sword](wiki:the-sword) inside the [Hydra](wiki:hydra) ([Session 54](wiki:session-54)).
- We sail to [Themis](wiki:themis) in disguise. On the beach we find a dead Amazon with a letter from Ranger Theodora about the queen's helm, and we see [Netusia, the Winter Wind](wiki:netusia-the-winter-wind) at a camp. We plan to steal the [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara).
- Epic verse: Still alive - We were on the island of Thylea

notes.title: Day 43

fields.summary: We steal the [[Notos Kitara]]

notes.body:
# Day 43 (-4)

We steal the [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara)

## Recap

- In the evening [Atyche](wiki:atyche), invisible and blessed, disarms [Netusia, the Winter Wind](wiki:netusia-the-winter-wind) and brings the [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara) to [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah). We walk towards the altar and spend the night in Leomund's Tiny Hut ([Session 55](wiki:session-55)).
- Epic verse: How we got the Kitara

notes.title: Day 44

fields.summary: The marble golems on the stone pillars

notes.body:
# Day 44 (-3)

The marble golems on the stone pillars

## Recap

- We hide from a hunting party of [Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) on armored rhinos with basilisks. At 15:00 we reach the altar in a forest of stone pillars, full of petrified men, and destroy the marble golems ([Session 55](wiki:session-55)).
- Epic verse: Battle against the golems on petrified forest pillar

notes.title: Day 45

fields.summary: We killed the [[Hydra]] at the sacred temple

notes.body:
# Day 45 (-2)

We killed the [Hydra](wiki:hydra) at the sacred temple

## Recap

- After a long rest until midnight we enter the sacred temple, the prisoner's tower, and fight Amazons and basilisk puppies ([Session 56](wiki:session-56)).
- We kill the [Hydra](wiki:hydra) and find Titansbane, the blade of [Talieus](wiki:talieus-titan), in its stomach. We free [Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) and recruit the lizardfolk ([Session 57](wiki:session-57)).
- We knock out the fake queen [Leah the Amazon (formerly Sanfac)](wiki:leah-the-amazon-formerly-sanfac), a Medusa whose helmet is a paired sending stone ([Session 58](wiki:session-58)). Darien tells us about the coup by [Sanasm](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm) and her Medusas 25 years ago. The [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) was the fifth of them. We meet [Bront the Jancan](wiki:bront-the-jancan) ([Session 59](wiki:session-59)).
- In the morning [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) grips us in a dream duel and boons the winners. [Erinyes](wiki:erinyes) come for Leah and take her to [Oathbreaker Island](wiki:oathbreaker-island) ([Session 60](wiki:session-60), [Session 61](wiki:session-61)). I loot the emerald eyes of Lutheria's statue ([Session 62](wiki:session-62)).
- On the way to the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) we find the camp slaughtered, Netusia among the dead. A search net lights up the horizon and we fight for the queen's crown ([Session 63](wiki:session-63)).
- Epic verse: Battle against the Hydra in prisoner's tower
- Epic verse: The broken lullaby - the dream duel

notes.title: Day 46

fields.summary: We kill [[Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)]]

notes.body:
# Day 46 (-1)

We kill [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm)

## Recap

- [Brax](wiki:brax) kills the queen. She accepts Lutheria's gift and rises as a [Euryale](wiki:euryale); we kill her again. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) becomes queen of [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) and makes [Darien](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) regent. Fame level 2 ([Session 64](wiki:session-64)).
- We are hailed as leaders. The Amazons will train for the big fight and resume relations in 14 days. Back at the boat at 12:00, we set course for [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island) ([Session 65](wiki:session-65)).
- Epic verse: The crown of the false queen

notes.title: Day 47

fields.summary: We kill [[Malfeshnekor the Chimera]]

notes.body:
# Day 47 (0)

We kill [Malfeshnekor the Chimera](wiki:malfeshnekor-the-chimera)

## Recap

- 06:00: we fight and kill [Malfeshnekor the Chimera](wiki:malfeshnekor-the-chimera) ([Session 65](wiki:session-65)).
- On [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island) we find tended graves, a pedestal showing [Damon](wiki:damon) sealing something away, and Damon's letter about the seventh game and the oath of peace. Inside the volcano a [Death Tyrant](wiki:death-tyrant) is waking ([Session 66](wiki:session-66)).
- We gather the ingredients: the Chimera's heart, bones of three faithful dead, obsidian and our blood ([Session 67](wiki:session-67)).
- 16:00: the ritual seals the Death Tyrant again and the Chimera reforms. We find a treasure in the bay and sail for the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) at 21:00 ([Session 68](wiki:session-68)).
- Epic verse: The Chimera Malfeshnekor and the Tyrant beneath the volcano

notes.title: Day 48

fields.summary: Arrive at [[Island of the Fates]]

notes.body:
# Day 48 (1)

Arrive at [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates)

## Recap

- 07:00: we arrive at the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates). [Mezz](wiki:mezz) offers us a doppelganger of [Gaius](wiki:gaius) on behalf of [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) ([Session 68](wiki:session-68)).
- [The fates](wiki:the-fates) want platinum, not gold, so we can't pay our debt. We sail for the [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder) and pass [Hamun Kost](wiki:hamun-kost)'s ship with its skeleton crew around 17:00. At Yonder the alarm bells ring as soon as we dock ([Session 69](wiki:session-69)).
- Epic verse: Arriving on the Island of Yonder

notes.title: Day 49

fields.summary: *egg hatch?*

notes.body:
# Day 49 (2)

*egg hatch?*

## Recap

- We beat the phalanx with a fireball and 8 giant owls. In the lighthouse I find a soldier's letter to his sister Helena: Gaius prepares for war, the oath of peace fails within two moons, and a horned mage serves the Lady of Dreams. A maddened Gygan bursts out at [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) hurls his javelin at it ([Session 70](wiki:session-70)).
- We visit the burned ruins of Korynthos (14:30) and climb the cliffs above the barracks (16:30) ([Session 71](wiki:session-71)).
- [Gaius](wiki:gaius)' dragon lands on the library; we parasail onto it and kill the guards. [Mezz](wiki:mezz) greets us and [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) offers to join us under truth serum. We attack ([Session 72](wiki:session-72)).
- [Brax](wiki:brax) kills Chondrus. We find 450 platinum and the missing piece of the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera), and set a librarian to research the dragonlords and the Titans' weaknesses ([Session 73](wiki:session-73)).
- Epic verse: Infiltrating the library and barracks

notes.title: Day 5

fields.summary: The killing of the Basilisks

notes.body:
# Day 5

The killing of the Basilisks

## Recap

- Shopping in [Estoria](wiki:estoria). [Henake](wiki:henake), who watched the sacrificial rock for us, is found petrified by basilisks. At the inn we hear about the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines) and the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) ([Session 12](wiki:session-12)).
- The order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) demands we offer ourselves instead, plus 50 oxen. We find the basilisks' lair in the river and learn about [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander) ([Session 13](wiki:session-13)).
- We kill the basilisks (Battling the Basilisks) and find the book of [Gareth Nydia](wiki:yendithas), loyal servant of [Rison Phobas](wiki:rison-phobas) ([Session 14](wiki:session-14)).
- We party for the rest of the day ([Session 15](wiki:session-15)).
- Epic verse: Tragic tale of Henake

notes.title: Day 50

fields.summary: Mezz swears his oath, the Dream on Versi shows the paradoxes, and we board the Ultros

notes.body:
# Day 50 (3)

Mezz swears his oath, the Dream on Versi shows the paradoxes, and we board the Ultros

## Recap
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) talks with [Mezz](wiki:mezz) about what he wants next. Mezz swears the [Oath of Mezz to Yendithas](wiki:oath-of-mezz-to-yendithas). He tells us the other tunnels on the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) lead to other planes (one to the Underdark) and that [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) tracks us through the ripples of our time travel.
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) and [Brax](wiki:brax) carve through a symbol of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) on his sacrificial altar on [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder) with the Tree of Life.
- We set the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) for the Bard, run to the docks of [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder), and [Brax](wiki:brax) gets 20-30 soldiers to fight each other for a place on the [Ultros](wiki:ultros). Ten remain and follow us, led by [Norak](wiki:norak).
- [Volon](wiki:volon) tells Yendithas by telepathy that [Versi](wiki:versi) is doing badly. She is convulsing and repeating "the thread has been cut before the knot", worse since [Gaius](wiki:gaius) died.
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) casts Dream on [Versi](wiki:versi). It shows the [paradoxes](wiki:paradox-tokens) caused by killing [Gaius](wiki:gaius) and [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus). We get 6 tokens.
- We board the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) around 03:00. See [Day 51](wiki:day-51).

notes.title: Day 51

fields.summary: Skipped forward by a paradox token

notes.body:
# Day 51 (4)

Skipped forward by a paradox token

## Recap

- We were on the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) and skipped this day because of a [paradox token](wiki:paradox-tokens). [Volon](wiki:volon) says we were in a half-zombie state.

notes.title: Day 52

fields.summary: Arrival at the Island of the Fates

notes.body:
# Day 52 (5)

Arrival at the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates)

## Recap

- At 12:00 it is suddenly clear day and the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) has arrived at the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates). One [paradox token](wiki:paradox-tokens) is gone.
- The ship has taken damage, apparently from thunder. The eggs are still safe. [Versi](wiki:versi) knows what happened to us.

notes.title: Day 6

fields.summary: To the [[Mythral Mines|Mithral Mines]]

notes.body:
# Day 6

To the [Mithral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines)

## Recap

- We meet [Hukar](wiki:hukar), leader of the centaurs, and learn the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) has been taken by Troglodytes ([Session 15](wiki:session-15)).
- In the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines) we save the centaurs Kaluk and Hirak, get captured and brought before the Troglodyte king [Fotkaro](wiki:fotkaro), and kill them all after solving their three riddles ([Session 16](wiki:session-16), Troglodyte Thunder).
- The centaurs give us 3 potions of heroism ([Session 17](wiki:session-17)).

notes.title: Day 7

fields.summary: The [[Mythral Forge|Mithral Forge]]

notes.body:
# Day 7

The [Mithral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge)

## Recap

- Back into the mines at 10:00. We find a dead cerberus and kill the two-headed dogs eating it ([Session 17](wiki:session-17), Demon Dog Boogie).
- We ride the elevator down and meet [Fajra](wiki:fajra), the fire elemental who *is* the forge ([Session 18](wiki:session-18)).
- We free Fajra by smashing the orbs of cold; she stays a year to keep the forge lit. We level up, deal with the Troglodyte brood mothers and dream of a man with his face sewn shut ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).

notes.title: Day 8

fields.summary: Days of traveling to [[Mytros]]

notes.body:
# Day 8

Days of traveling to [Mytros](wiki:mytros)

## Recap

- At dawn [Gaius](wiki:gaius) of the order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) flies over on a silver dragon; centaurs with smoking black eyes attack us and we scare them off.
- Back in [Estoria](wiki:estoria), three dragonriders of King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) summon us to [Mytros](wiki:mytros). [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) gets them to wait 24 hours ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).

The Dream on [Versi](wiki:versi) ([Session 76](wiki:session-76)) shows a man on a dragon attacking a group of men, and the man suddenly gone: the confrontation with [Gaius](wiki:gaius) ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)). A [paradox](wiki:paradox-tokens).

notes.title: Day 9

fields.summary: Back in [[Estoria]], then setting out for [[Mytros]]

notes.body:
# Day 9

Back in [Estoria](wiki:estoria), then setting out for [Mytros](wiki:mytros)

## Recap

- In [Estoria](wiki:estoria) we wait for the dragonriders. A storm around [Mytros](wiki:mytros) keeps ships away. [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) possesses a woman and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) knocks her out ([Session 20](wiki:session-20)).
- At the [Dragon Shrine](wiki:dragon-shrine), [Aesop](wiki:aesop) tells us about the cold portal's race and about the young dragons of [Acustus](wiki:acustus). We order an amulet of health, the Zaphyre Lute and the Euros Lyre from [Volkan](wiki:volkan), to be made with [Pythor](wiki:pythor)'s hammer at the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge).
- 17:30: we set out for Mytros and camp at the crossroads towards the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) and [Pythoria](wiki:pythoria) ([Session 21](wiki:session-21)).

notes.title: Dead Falls
notes.body:
Falls in the rocky eastern Heartlands, the last known location of the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) ([Session 23](wiki:session-23), [Session 27](wiki:session-27)).

- Through the Rapids of the Lethe and its clashing cliffs, to a silent waterfall. A small underwater tunnel leads to a secret inlet, where we found the Ultros ([Session 40](wiki:session-40), [Day 32](wiki:day-32)).

notes.title: Death Tyrant
notes.body:
A beholder that decomposed into a giant skull with a single red eye, on a pile of dragonlord bones in the volcano of [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island). 500 years ago [Damon](wiki:damon) could not destroy it, only seal it away, with [Malfeshnekor the Chimera](wiki:malfeshnekor-the-chimera) bound by oath as its guardian ([Session 66](wiki:session-66), [Day 47](wiki:day-47)).

- Killing the Chimera weakened the wards: the dead started to stir and the Death Tyrant began to wake ([Session 66](wiki:session-66)).
- We sealed it again with Damon's ritual: the Chimera's heart, bones of three faithful dead (Captain Theron Steelwind, Sister Calista and young apprentice Niklos), seven obsidian shards in a seven-pointed star, and our blood ([Session 67](wiki:session-67)).
- At the end of the ritual it shouted in our heads: *"NOOOOO! YOU WILL NOT CAGE ME AGAIN AFTER 500 YEARS!!"* The door closed and the Chimera reformed ([Session 68](wiki:session-68)).
- Epic verse: The Chimera Malfeshnekor and the Tyrant beneath the volcano.

notes.title: Demetria
notes.body:
Location: the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple).

- [Versi](wiki:versi) sends [Atyche](wiki:atyche) to her to learn how to escape her doomed fate ([Session 5](wiki:session-5), [Day 2](wiki:day-2)).
- Tells us Atyche has been doomed by [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) herself, destined to die by her hands. Not happy about the urn ([Session 9](wiki:session-9), [Day 4](wiki:day-4)).
- Killed by a wildly dancing Gygan in the Mossy Temple. Her Shortbow of Cupidity ended up with me, [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) ([Session 9](wiki:session-9), [Session 10](wiki:session-10)).

notes.title: Dragon Shrine
notes.body:
Shrine in [Estoria](wiki:estoria), kept by the priest [Aesop](wiki:aesop).

- A giant relief of [Balmytria](wiki:balmytria) is inside.
- Someone broke in and stole the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria) two days before we arrived. Broken glass and "purple stains" (wine) on the floor, which we followed to the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple) ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)).

notes.title: Drink from the Bottomless Dragonhorn
notes.body: "To drink from the bottomless dragonhorn for a vision": the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria). We drank from it and dreamt of the ghost ship [Ultros](wiki:ultros) and the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) ([Session 11](wiki:session-11), [Day 4](wiki:day-4)).

notes.title: Enygma
notes.body: Stark raving mad.

notes.title: Erinyes
notes.body:
A race working for the [Furies](wiki:furies).

Rulers of the Erinyes: [Megaera, leader of the Erinyes](wiki:), [Alecto](wiki:), and [Tisiphone](wiki:)

![](media/pasted-image-20241130224404.jpg)

notes.title: Estor Arklander
notes.body:
Captain of the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) in the first war. See the Ultros note for the full history.

- Younger brother of [Telamok Arklander](wiki:telamok-arklander) ([Session 40](wiki:session-40)).
- Killed by a trick of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan). His last descendant is King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) ([Session 13](wiki:session-13), [Day 5](wiki:day-5)).
- The Rock of Estor in [Estoria](wiki:estoria), where sacrifices are made, is named after him ([Session 6](wiki:session-6)).
- After the war he destroyed all gygans. The curse of Estor Arklander ([Session 40](wiki:session-40)).
- In a dream he chose a successor for the Ultros ([Session 41](wiki:session-41)).
- I go down to talk to him ([Session 51](wiki:session-51)).

notes.title: Estoria
notes.body:
City in the Heartlands, ruled by King [Pythor](wiki:pythor).

- We arrive here from the temple of the Oracle ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)). Pythor's daughter is to be sacrificed at the Rock of Estor.
- Home of the [Dragon Shrine](wiki:dragon-shrine), kept by [Aesop](wiki:aesop).
- The wine trail from the shrine leads south out of the city to the Old Wood and the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple) ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Session 7](wiki:session-7)).
- The basilisks' lair is in the river here. We kill them ([Session 13](wiki:session-13), [Session 14](wiki:session-14), [Day 5](wiki:day-5)).
- The order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) is active here and demands sacrifices ([Session 13](wiki:session-13)).
- Dragonriders of King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) summon us to [Mytros](wiki:mytros) from here ([Session 19](wiki:session-19), [Day 8](wiki:day-8)).
- Distances: [Mytros](wiki:mytros)–Estoria 2 days, crossroads–Estoria 0.5 day ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).

notes.title: Euryale
notes.body: Pronounced [_yoor-EYE-ə-lee_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Pronunciation_respelling_key "Help:Pronunciation respelling key")

notes.title: Fajra
notes.body:
Fire elemental held captive by the dwarves in the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge). She *is* the forge: it is so good because of her ([Session 18](wiki:session-18), [Day 7](wiki:day-7)).

- Demanded we break the contract that keeps her there and remove the orb of cold. In return she'd give information, but freeing her means the forge can no longer create mythical/magic items.
- We freed her by smashing the orbs. She stays for a year to keep the forge lit ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).
- Later hands us our ordered items, together with [Volkan](wiki:volkan) ([Session 39](wiki:session-39), [Day 31](wiki:day-31)).

notes.title: Fire Island
notes.body:
Sterrenbeeld “The Prisoner”

-   Active volcano.
-   The 'lizard folk' live here. They make great weapons. (There's several tribes that are warring with each other)
-   **[Versi](wiki:versi) sees a dragon egg there for me!**

Compleet omsingeld door een koraalrif. Een goede captain kan er doorheen navigeren.

Formed around an active volcano, which occasionally belches ash and embers. De laatste tijd redelijk stil; niet altijd. Gevaarlijk om daar in de buurt te komen.

Verschillende tribes met Lizard Folk. Houden van oorlog voeren onderling. De sterkste tribe is zo’n 300 warriors groot - de Fire Walkers. Deze wonen in de vulkaan. Geleid door Jamkor, hun koning.
De lesser tribes zijn naamloos.
Ze aanbidden een nameless god ([Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan)) waarvan ze denken dat die onder de vulkaan leeft. De god wordt verder nergens in [Thylea](wiki:thylea) erkend.
Vytha, de lizard queen, is de mortal enemy van Jamkor.

**Key Locations**
- [x] In de throne room: Jamkor, de lizard king. Hij is blut.
- [x] De sleeping chambers: 12 gemstones ter waarde van 10gp each. Some of the gems zijn covered in blood.
- [x] De chamber of worship: een standbeeld van [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan). De 3 ogen van het standbeeld zijn emeralds ter waarde van 500gp each.
- [ ] De cyclops cave: een smith genaamd Steros. Opgeleid door Sydon zelf. In principe onpartijdig.
- [ ] In de cave zitten heel veel mechanical contraptions, genaamd “Figures of Wondrous Power”. Onduidelijk wat er is, maar er kan “van alles gebouwd worden”.
- [x] In de king’s chambers ligt nog wat treasure, in een pit met een bronze lid er bovenop. 400 gold pieces, 1100 silver pieces, 2 emeralds worth 500 gold pieces, sapphire worth 1000 gold pieces.
- [x] In “The Blind Elder” woont Polyphorus, een blinde cyclope.
- [x] In “The Salamander Cave” zit een nest met salamandereieren. 1 is een drakenei!

De tribe ‘firewalkers’ wordt nu al honderden jaren beschermd door een pagan god. Deze zou hen genoeg kracht en middelen geven om de rivaliteit te winnen.
Normaal wisselen de tribes regelmatig van power.
Alle tribes: de waterbreathers, de treeclimbers, de firewalkers. De firewalkers zijn in power. De andere twee bevinden zich constant aan andere kanten van het eiland en roteren beide door.

[Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan), godess of swiftness, alone escaped the wrath of Sydon and [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan). She was trapped on Fire Island.

The firewalkers built their fortress on top of the caldera.
There is a main entrance that is well guarded.
There is also a back entrance that is well hidden, and might be gone.

**NPCs**
- [King Jamkor](wiki:king-jamkor)
- [Advisor Polyphorus](wiki:advisor-polyphorus)
- [Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan)

notes.title: Fotkaro
notes.body: King (or former king) of the Troglodytes in the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines). We were brought before the Troglodyte king and killed them all after solving their three riddles ([Session 16](wiki:session-16), [Day 6](wiki:day-6), Troglodyte Thunder).

notes.title: Furies
notes.body:
Judge, Jury and Executioner relating to oathbreaking and similar.

> [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus), the priest of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan): there is only one power I fear more than the lady of dreams - the Furies. Megara, and her sisters are not to be trifled with. Those who disrespect the law of [Thylea](wiki:thylea) soon learn this.

They have a lookout in the tower of Praxys.

They have [Erinyes](wiki:erinyes) working for them.

notes.title: Gaius
notes.body:
The commander of the order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan).
Practically the sworn enemy of [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas).
Has my gear!

Killed by [Brax](wiki:brax) ([Session 75](wiki:session-75)). His death caused a paradox, see [Paradox tokens](wiki:paradox-tokens).

- At court during Sydon's storm, suggested flattening the [Temple of the Five](wiki:temple-of-the-five) ([Session 22](wiki:session-22), [Day 11](wiki:day-11)).
- Sent Braeca, the head guard of Sydon ([Session 5](wiki:session-5)).
- Flew over us on a silver dragon on the way back from the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines), while centaurs with smoking black eyes attacked us ([Session 19](wiki:session-19), [Day 8](wiki:day-8)).

notes.title: Gardens of Helios
notes.body:
Sterrenbeeld: The Chariot

Surrounded by enormous cliffs en by clouds and mist.

Anyone landing faces a long climb up to the plateau-like top.

Claimed by the Sun God, Helios. Noone has seen him for a long, long time.

Most of the island is shrubs and grassland, with a sizable forest in the center. A cyclops clan used to live here for many centuries, along with a hundred giants. They keep a herd of elephants.

Voor het komen van de dragonlords werd Helios aanbeden, tegenwoordig niet meer zo.

**Notable locations**

Palace of Helios: hier woont Helios en z’n guard, Tolyphemus. Treasure: 40.000 gold pieces in coins en jewels. Ook een “Beautiful Golden Chariot of Dawn” uit de legendes, waarmee Helios het mainland bezocht, getrokken door paarden.

In the treasure horde van Helios: een Instant Fortress, die de “Gifted One” nodig heeft.

notes.title: Hamun Kost
notes.body:
A tattooed man with a camp in a clearing where nature rots, on the road from [Estoria](wiki:estoria) to [Mytros](wiki:mytros). His papers lay in a pit guarded by a skeletal minotaur, including a book he wrote. When called, he stepped out of his tent. [Brax](wiki:brax) was offended, attacked him and obliterated him ([Session 21](wiki:session-21), [Day 10](wiki:day-10)).

- After the time jump we pass his ship on the way to the [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder): red sails with a spiral of 8 dots around a red star, a deck crewed by skeletons, and him sailing it himself. Everyone except me remembers him then ([Session 69](wiki:session-69), [Day 48](wiki:day-48)).
- The shared timeline puts an encounter with him on [Day 18](wiki:day-18), but Sessions 21 and 69 put it on Day 9–10.

![](media/sign-of-hamun-kost.jpg)

![](media/hamun-kost.jpg)

notes.title: Henake
notes.body:
We paid him to keep watch on the stone in [Estoria](wiki:estoria) where sacrifices are made. He was petrified by basilisks before he could spend the gold, and we brought him back to the temple ([Session 12](wiki:session-12), [Day 5](wiki:day-5)).

- We can send him to the temple of [the five](wiki:the-five) to have him unpetrified ([Session 51](wiki:session-51)).
- Song: Tragic tale of Henake. More in Inspiration.

notes.title: Hergeron (Titan)
notes.body: One of [The Titans](wiki:the-titans), the god of Strength and Valor. Second eldest brother. Imprisoned by [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) beneath a great tower after losing a duel ([The War of the Titans](wiki:the-war-of-the-titans)).

notes.title: Horn of Balmytria
notes.body:
Horn of the dragon [Balmytria](wiki:balmytria), kept in the [Dragon Shrine](wiki:dragon-shrine) in [Estoria](wiki:estoria). The "bottomless dragonhorn" from our [quests](wiki:quests).

- Stolen from the shrine two days before we arrived. [Aesop](wiki:aesop) asked us to give it to [Vallus](wiki:vallus) ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)). It must be returned to her, and given willingly to no one else.
- Incantations: "Afthonta" generates food and drink, "Omichi" creates 60 feet of mist.
- We drank from it and dreamt of the ghost ship [Ultros](wiki:ultros) and the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) ([Session 11](wiki:session-11), [Day 4](wiki:day-4)).

notes.title: How I lost my dragon
notes.body:
- I remember being in a battle with the brothers Telamok (Telamok Arklander), against the Fae Creatures, near the end of the first war
- Before I knew it, the wing of my dragon was ripped by a whole group of spears, and we dropped to the ground in a tailspin
- The last thing I remember is crashing on the earth, and everything going black... And the next thing I know is traveling away from Versi, back to [Thylea](wiki:thylea).
- Some things I remember in between: [Versi](wiki:versi) took care of me for 500 years. She has lived for millennia, and she enjoys life, even though she's turned against her father [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan). She's lived a lonely life... But during the battle of the dragonlords against the titans, she allied with the dragonlords, and served as a sort of "medic" during the battles. When she saw me lying on the field, she was instantly in love, and she did everything she could to save me. She had to put me in statis in her temple, to heal over the last 500 years. But when the prophesy came to her, she saw I had to step up.

notes.title: Hukar
notes.body: Leader of the centaurs near the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines). Friends(?) with Kaluk and Hirak. Told us the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) had been taken by Troglodytes ([Session 15](wiki:session-15), [Day 6](wiki:day-6)).

notes.title: Hydra
notes.body:
We saw this Hydra in a vision. It holds [The Sword](wiki:the-sword) that can free [Talieus - The Bald, Blind Titan](wiki:talieus-titan).

Saw in a vision during [Session 54](wiki:session-54).

notes.title: Icarus
notes.body: Silver dragon of King [Acustus](wiki:acustus). We found him snoring on a huge pile of silver coins (38,786 of them) in the royal garden of [Mytros](wiki:mytros). He has been in Mytros for 20 years ([Session 23](wiki:session-23), [Day 12](wiki:day-12)).

notes.title: Island of the Fates
notes.body:
Constellation: The Bard

Characters:
- [The fates](wiki:the-fates)

The other tunnels here lead to other planes of existence, one of them to the Underdark ([Mezz](wiki:mezz)).
We left [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder) on [Day 50](wiki:day-50) and arrived here on [Day 52](wiki:day-52) at 12:00.

notes.title: Island of Yonder
notes.body:
Ooit een ancient capital van de Gygan empire. Ze waren hier al honderden jaren (duizenden?) voor de dragonlords. De meesten zijn uitgewipet tijdens de first war.

De order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) heeft daar een thuisbasis gemaakt. Ze hebben de bases van de Gygans weer in gebruik genomen.

Het is gigantisch moeilijk aan te meren op het eiland. Er is eigenlijk maar 1 aanmeerplaats, wat dan ook vol in het zicht zal zijn van alles en iedereen op het eiland.

Waarschuwing: wees voorbereid voor je hier heen gaat, met een hele goeie nachtrust

Buiten, bij de garrison of soldiers, loopt Marcion , een captain.

In de barracks kan loot gevonden worden ter grootte van zo’n 300 gold pieces in de verschillende chests.

In de prison cells zijn 2 notable prisoners: Enygma (blijkbaar is hij een “Enygma”) en Mykhael.

In de commander’s quarters zijn verschillende brieven, en zo’n 240 gold pieces aan treasure. Ook een brilliant blue sapphire ter waarde van 1000 gold pieces. Hier vinden we ook [Gaius](wiki:gaius). Hij wil nog wel eens rondlopen. Hij kan ook gevonden worden in de Temple of Sydon.

In de Great Library is de gehele geschiedenis van heel [Thylea](wiki:thylea) te vinden in de vorm van boeken. Alles bij elkaar zo’n 100.000 gold pieces aan treasure, maar “wat moeilijk te verplaatsen”. De tien meest waardevolle boeken zijn 1000gp each. De kennis in de boeken is nog veel meer waard dan de boeken zelf - we kunnen er gebruik van maken om de geschiedenis van Thylea te achterhalen.

In de Sleeping Quarters ligt Enygma’s Spellbook. Daar staat de volledige lijst van alle **Sorcerer’s** spells in. (Michel heeft gezegd dat het sorcerer is, niet wizard! Herinner hem daar aan)

In de Laboratory zitten veel potions.
- 2 potions of clairvoyance.
- een potion of mindreading.
- een potion of superior healing.
- potion of longevity.
- potion of heroism.

In [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus)’ Appartments woont Chondrus. Een bronze bowl en een gilded chest met het stuk van de Antikythera, carefully wrapped in white cloth. Chondrus’ Spellbook en 3 rings worth 250gp each en 450 platinum pieces in coins. Ook verschillende interessante letters.

[Day 50](wiki:day-50) ([Session 76](wiki:session-76)): [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) and [Brax](wiki:brax) carved through one of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)'s symbols on his sacrificial altar with the Tree of Life. 20-30 soldiers stood at the docks. [Brax](wiki:brax) got them to fight each other for a place on the [Ultros](wiki:ultros), and ten remained, led by [Norak](wiki:norak). We left from here for the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates).

notes.title: Island Turtle
notes.body: A giant turtle with a market of Aresian traders on its back. We visit it on the way to [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island) ([Day 37](wiki:day-37), [Session 46](wiki:session-46)). We met the Marid [Shazum](wiki:shazum) here. It moves, so it has no pin on the map.

notes.title: Islands
notes.body:
**Islands**

-   'The Bear': Mainland [Thylea](wiki:thylea)
-   'The Gygan': [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder).
    -   Part of Antikythera is here.
    -   **[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) wants to go here for our friend of the cult, [Gaius](wiki:gaius)
-   'The Prisoner': [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)
    -   Active volcano.
    -   The 'lizard folk' live here. They make great weapons. (There's several tribes that are warring with each other)
    -   **[Versi](wiki:versi) sees a dragon egg there for me!**
-   'The Heart': goemouses to the island 'the golden heart'.
    -   Where 'the heart of Thylea' is.
-   'The Trickster': [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island)
    -   There's a highly aggressive Chymera on this island. King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) has set a bounty on its head of 1000 gold pieces.
-   'The Bard': [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates)
    -   **[Atyche](wiki:atyche) wants to go here.**
- 'The warrior': The island of the exiles
    - Straya mate!
    - Sent here if you make a big boo-boo
- 'The Centaur': [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
    -   **[Brax](wiki:brax) wants to go to.**
-   'The Queen': Indigo Island
    -   A large collection of barbarian warriors.
    -   A place of travel for barbarians to learn new things.
    -   The birthplace of all barbarians in Thylea.
    -   Indigo Tribes: there are multiple. Shipwrecked on the Thylea thousands of years ago, helped by the natives, and sailed to and sailed to indigo island. They fought on the side of the natives in the first war.
    -   They like fish.
- 'The Twins': The island of [Themis](wiki:themis):
    - Home of [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons).
    - 'Calimero?'
    - [Bront the Jancan](wiki:bront-the-jancan) is imprisoned here
- 'The Ant': [Titan's Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley).
    - 3 perfectly molded green hills.
    - Encompassed by a giant glass dome.
    - Can be bypassed by teleportation magic.
    - _Must be avoided at all cost._
    - Rumored to be the home of Thylea's greatest treasure.
    - Sealed away by [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan) as a result of the [The War of the Titans](wiki:the-war-of-the-titans)
    - Known by all fishermen, for the legend says that it is the home of Thylea’s greatest treasure.
    - Inhabited by the [Myrmekes](wiki:myrmekes)?

The next ones are out of reach:
-   'Titan': probably [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)?
-   'The dreamer': [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis)
    -   probably [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)?
    - Island of the oathbreaker here as well?
		- The Island of the Oathbreakers
	    - Daar is iemand van [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) z’n backstory.
-   'The Centaur': [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
    -   Something something monk/cleric.
-   'The Chariot': [Gardens of Helios](wiki:gardens-of-helios)
    -   Thyphoon wants to go here. Instant fortress.
-   ‘The Spear’: [Typhon](wiki:typhon)

notes.title: Kentimane (Titan)
notes.body:
One of [The Titans](wiki:the-titans), the most powerful of them. Husband and eternal guardian of [Thylea](wiki:thylea-titan), the Great Mother, and father of the other Titans. Usually depicted with one hundred heads and one hundred hands.

A titan who sealed away a god as a result of the first war of the gods (see [00 - All Islands](wiki:00-all-islands)).

notes.title: Khronos
notes.body:
A being of time who lives on a giant rock island in another dimension, reached after we dived under the waves with [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan) and got lost ([Day 40](wiki:day-40), [Session 52](wiki:session-52)). It's my guess that he is a god; the notes don't say what he is.

- Offered to send us back in time. We sacrificed magic items for 46 days, including my Shortbow of Cupidity and [Brax](wiki:brax)'s deck of many things, and arrived back at [Day 42](wiki:day-42) (relative day -5) ([Day 41](wiki:day-41), [Session 52](wiki:session-52), Travelling back in time).
- His home is the [Realm of Khronos](wiki:realm-of-khronos).

notes.title: King Jamkor
notes.body:
Now pro-Seidon. Formerly a devotee of [Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan), but that was too abstract to him.

Current king of [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island). Belongs to the tribe of the firewalkers.

Used to

notes.title: King Pythor of Estoria

fields.summary: A doomed sacrifice, a stolen dragonhorn, and Lutheria's whispers.

notes.body:
A doomed sacrifice, a stolen dragonhorn, and Lutheria's whispers.

Days: [Day 2](wiki:day-2), [Day 3](wiki:day-3).

notes.title: Kyrah
notes.body:
One of [The Five](wiki:the-five) Gods: the trickster Goddess of Music and poetry. A poet.
- The swiftest of all the gods: she can disappear in the blink of an eye and travel great distances with each step.
- Her voice is said to be more beautiful than any musical instrument.
- Very few shrines to her, except among bards, who revere her as the Muse.
- Already travelling with us on [Day 1](wiki:day-1) and resurrected [Atyche](wiki:atyche) ([Session 2](wiki:session-2), [Session 3](wiki:session-3)).
- Told us the ship in our dream was the ghost ship [Ultros](wiki:ultros) ([Session 11](wiki:session-11)).
- Hyperventilated in the elevator of the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines) until [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) kissed her ([Session 18](wiki:session-18)).

notes.title: Lady of Coins, Moxena
notes.body: > I have no patience for those who sow chaos in the name of doing good. One must always ask: who benefits? - [Vallus](wiki:vallus)

notes.title: Leah the Amazon (formerly Sanfac)
notes.body: One of the Medusa Amazon's of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan).

notes.title: Lift the Curse on Brax's Family
notes.body: [Versi](wiki:versi) tells [Brax](wiki:brax) to talk to [Damon](wiki:damon) at the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) to lift his family's curse ([Session 5](wiki:session-5), [Day 2](wiki:day-2)). Nothing is recorded yet about whether it was lifted.

notes.title: Loreas
notes.body:
A satyr. We met him around the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple) ([Session 7](wiki:session-7), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)).

- Finds [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) outside the palace in [Mytros](wiki:mytros) with a white chrysanthemum and joins the party ([Session 42](wiki:session-42), [Day 33](wiki:day-33)).
- Part of the [Crew of the Ultros](wiki:crew-of-the-ultros).
- Introduced to Nessa at the wedding preparations ([Session 44](wiki:session-44)).

notes.title: Lutheria (Titan)
notes.body:
One of [The Titans](wiki:the-titans): Goddess of Death and Lady of Dreams. Twin sister and wife of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan). One of the two remaining titans.
- A beautiful, black-eyed woman who sleepwalks through the underworld, greeting the spirits of the dead. Her crystal scythe harvests the souls of those who displeased her in life; the power of [Talieus](wiki:talieus-titan) is bound to it.
- Commands her followers to live without remorse: drink, dance and feast, because any day could be their last. Mother to the fey races of [Thylea](wiki:thylea), whom she strongly favors.
- Rarely worshipped by settlers, but honored with feasts because Sydon demands it. Every poured drink needs a libation to her.

Keeps track of us because of the ripples in the time continuum from our time travel; she knows where we are active ([Mezz](wiki:mezz), [Day 50](wiki:day-50)).
- Appeared in our dream as a maniacally laughing woman who taunts us ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 2](wiki:day-2)).
- Doomed [Atyche](wiki:atyche) to die by her hands ([Session 9](wiki:session-9)).
- Killed [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander) with a trick ([Session 13](wiki:session-13)).
- Destroyed the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) with the cerberus she bred ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).

notes.title: Maenad
notes.body:
- Monsters, "the raving ones".
- Transformed into fae creatures.
- Goatlings are possibly halfbreeds between Maenads and [Satyrs](wiki:the-satyrs): head of a goat, human hands, more goatlike than Maenads ([Session 6](wiki:session-6)).
- The children at the [Mossy Temple](wiki:mossy-temple) transformed into Maenads ([Session 9](wiki:session-9), [Day 4](wiki:day-4)).

notes.title: Makhaila
notes.body:
Leader and captain of [Vallus](wiki:vallus)' guard of [Amazons](wiki:the-amazons), 13 in total ([Session 23](wiki:session-23)).

- [Atyche](wiki:atyche) sends her a message to come and clean up the temple of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) ([Session 34](wiki:session-34), [Day 26](wiki:day-26)).

notes.title: Malfeshnekor the Chimera
notes.body: Lives on [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island)

notes.title: Mezz
notes.body:
A shapeshifting messenger of [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus), met in the library on [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder). Offered the party the services of a Doppelganger to impersonate [Gaius](wiki:gaius).

From the [Blasted Wasteland](wiki:blasted-wasteland), taken there by [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus).

Swore the [Oath of Mezz to Yendithas](wiki:oath-of-mezz-to-yendithas) on [Day 50](wiki:day-50) ([Session 76](wiki:session-76)). Says the other tunnels on the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) lead to other planes. One goes to the Underdark, which is how he travelled from the island to [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder). Suspects [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) would have given accurate directions to the [Nether Sea](wiki:nether-sea), but would still have passed everything on to [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan).

notes.title: Mikhael
notes.body: Has fancy white gear, a top hat with bronze gears, all kinds of gears on his armor. From outside of Thylea.

notes.title: Mossy Temple
notes.body:
Temple at the edge of the Old Wood, south of [Estoria](wiki:estoria). Home of [Demetria](wiki:demetria). The spreadsheet also mentions an Ancient Glade here.

- The goatlings that took the children come from here ([Session 7](wiki:session-7), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)).
- Guarded by 2 statues. Inside are goatlings, a dryad "on a diplomatic mission" and some satyrs ([Session 8](wiki:session-8), [Day 4](wiki:day-4)).
- Plants found here: Ethereum (essence of ether, poison), Aconite (assassin's blood, poison), Sunril berry bush (healing).
- [Demetria](wiki:demetria) is killed here by a Gygan, and the children turn into [Maenad](wiki:maenad)s. [Damon](wiki:damon) appears ([Session 9](wiki:session-9)).
- We met [Loreas](wiki:loreas) the satyr around here ([Session 7](wiki:session-7), [Session 42](wiki:session-42)).

notes.title: Mythral Forge
notes.body:
Is in the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines)

- A key component in the victory 500 years ago that settled the oath of peace. Built on/near a deposit of Mithril and Adamantine. Destroyed by [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) with the cerberus she bred ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).
- Taken over by Troglodytes ([Session 15](wiki:session-15)).
- The fire elemental [Fajra](wiki:fajra) *is* the forge. We freed her; she stays a year to keep it lit ([Session 18](wiki:session-18), [Session 19](wiki:session-19), [Day 7](wiki:day-7)).
- [Volkan](wiki:volkan) can craft here with the hammer of [Pythor](wiki:pythor): a rod of lordly might, a luckblade (10 days, 20,000 gold and an orb of stormmetal), mithril chain and mithril weapons, and the Instruments of the Muse: Zaphyre Lute, Euros Lyre, Boreal Harp and [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara) ([Session 20](wiki:session-20)).
- One of our [quests](wiki:quests): to shape the silver fires of the lost forge.

notes.title: Mythral Mines
notes.body:
Dwarven mines at the Great Falls of Arkelon: follow the Arkelon River to the waterfall, the mines are at its foot. Holds the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge). In the Mithral Mountains.

What we heard in [Estoria](wiki:estoria) ([Session 12](wiki:session-12), [Day 5](wiki:day-5)):
- Only one entrance.
- Critical in the war against the titans, until [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) stopped it. Now some lesser creatures live there.
- A lift that needs a code word or it becomes very hot; maybe stairs as an alternative. The password is "Darastrix", draconic for dragon ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).
- Right path to the forge, left to the store rooms.
- A quest to bring back dwarven skulls for 10 gold each (never followed up).

What we found ([Day 6](wiki:day-6), [Day 7](wiki:day-7)):
- Taken over by Troglodytes, led by [Fotkaro](wiki:fotkaro) ([Session 15](wiki:session-15), [Session 16](wiki:session-16), Troglodyte Thunder).
- A giant pit to the north with a dead cerberus and two-headed dogs ([Session 17](wiki:session-17), Demon Dog Boogie).
- The elevator down to the forge and [Fajra](wiki:fajra) ([Session 18](wiki:session-18), [Session 19](wiki:session-19)).
- We return on [Day 31](wiki:day-31) to pick up our ordered items from [Volkan](wiki:volkan) and [Fajra](wiki:fajra) ([Session 39](wiki:session-39), [Session 40](wiki:session-40)).

notes.title: Mytros
notes.body:
The capital city of [Thylea](wiki:thylea) and home of the Great Games. Named after the goddess [Mytros](wiki:mytros-god); links to `[[Mytros]]` mean the city, links to `[[Mytros (God)]]` mean the goddess.

- Ruled by King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) and Queen [Vallus](wiki:vallus), its patron goddess. [Gaius](wiki:gaius) of the order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) flies over it on his dragon almost daily ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).
- Founded by Telamok, the elder of the two Arklander brothers ([Session 40](wiki:session-40)).
- Distances: Mytros–[Estoria](wiki:estoria) 2 days, crossroads–Mytros 1.5 days ([Session 27](wiki:session-27)).

## Places
- The Siren's Roost, run by Ambrosia. After we won the Great Games: "The Siren's Roost - The Bardian's Bastion" ([Session 37](wiki:session-37)).
- The palace, the Great Agora (market), the gardens, the bath house and the vault of [Thylea](wiki:thylea) ([Session 28](wiki:session-28), [Session 36](wiki:session-36)).
- The [Satyr's Tail](wiki:satyr-s-tail), a pub on Stygian Row ([Session 29](wiki:session-29), [Session 30](wiki:session-30)).
- The Colossus of [Pythor](wiki:pythor), where the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) hides ([Session 32](wiki:session-32)).
- The temple of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), taken down after we exposed its dungeons ([Session 34](wiki:session-34), [Session 35](wiki:session-35)).
- The [Temple of the Five](wiki:temple-of-the-five) ([Session 51](wiki:session-51)).
- Mount Volkan, where the Great Games are held ([Session 29](wiki:session-29)).

## Our visits
- [Day 11](wiki:day-11)–[Day 12](wiki:day-12): Sydon attacks as we arrive; [The Five](wiki:the-five) sacrifice part of their divinity to clear the storm ([Session 22](wiki:session-22), [Session 23](wiki:session-23)).
- [Day 19](wiki:day-19)–[Day 29](wiki:day-29): the Great Games, the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) and the cult of Lutheria.
- [Day 33](wiki:day-33): back with the [Ultros](wiki:ultros), assembling the [crew](wiki:crew-of-the-ultros) ([Session 42](wiki:session-42)).

notes.title: Mytros Besieged

fields.summary: Gaius on the road, Hamun Kost in the woods, and the city saved from Sydon's storm.

notes.body:
Gaius on the road, Hamun Kost in the woods, and the city saved from Sydon's storm.

Days: [Day 8](wiki:day-8), [Day 9](wiki:day-9), [Day 10](wiki:day-10), [Day 11](wiki:day-11), [Day 12](wiki:day-12).

notes.title: Mytros (God)
notes.body:
One of [The Five](wiki:the-five) Gods: the Goddess of Dawn, called by some the "Silver Queen". Not to be confused with the city of [Mytros](wiki:mytros), the capital, which carries her name.

- The most benevolent of the Five, and the patron goddess of the most important kingdom in [Thylea](wiki:thylea).
- Widely credited with the survival of the city during the destruction and aftermath of the First War. She is said to appear to her priests as a warrior queen clad in shimmering golden armor.
- Ascended to the heavens after a cataclysmic battle with [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) and [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), and no longer walks among mortals.
- The most powerful of the Five Gods, and the source of most priestly magic in Thylea.
- Wife of [Volkan](wiki:volkan). Mother of [Pythor](wiki:pythor) and [Vallus](wiki:vallus) (her oldest daughter).

notes.title: Necropolis at Telamok
notes.body:
[Damon](wiki:damon) is the gatekeeper; we paid him to enter. The tomb of [Telamok Arklander](wiki:telamok-arklander) is behind a door in the cliffside ([Session 24](wiki:session-24), [Day 16](wiki:day-16)).
[Brax](wiki:brax) had a quest here, as did [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) (to find [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath)).
In the mithral mountains.
Toms filled with the remnants of the last dragonlords.
- A graverobber stole [Damon](wiki:damon)'s cursed necklace from here, taking "a sneaky route" ([Session 6](wiki:session-6)).

notes.title: Nether Sea
notes.body:
The third and last of the three great seas: the Cerulean Gulf, the Forgotten Sea, and the legendary Nether Sea. Visiting all three is a quest, after the three great tasks ([quests](wiki:quests)).

## What we know
- The portal to it is [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis), the whirlpool called "the ravaging mouth", kept open by two of [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan)'s hands.
- After the first war [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) took control of the Nether Sea and captured the souls there to recuperate her strength ([Session 43](wiki:session-43)).
- Lutheria forced the titan [Talieus](wiki:talieus-titan) to wander it eternally, dragging her throne-ship across the waves by a chain ([The Creation of the Fey Races](wiki:the-creation-of-the-fey-races)).
