- The oath to captain the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) binds our fate to the ship "even were she to sail into the maw of the Nether Sea" ([Oaths](wiki:oaths)).
- Until a gear of the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) was fixed, we could not reach islands numbered above 10 (Nether Sea, Forgotten Sea) ([Session 43](wiki:session-43)). It was fixed for the Forgotten Sea in [Session 75](wiki:session-75). Nothing is recorded yet about the Nether Sea.
- [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) knows the Nether Sea ([Session 72](wiki:session-72)). [Mezz](wiki:mezz) suspects he would have given accurate directions, but passed everything on to Lutheria ([Session 76](wiki:session-76)).

notes.title: Netusia, the Winter Wind
notes.body: We found them on day -5 on [Themis](wiki:themis). One of [The Satyrs](wiki:the-satyrs).

notes.title: Norak
notes.body: The strongest looking of the 20-30 soldiers standing at the docks of [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder). After [Brax](wiki:brax) had them fight each other for a place on the [Ultros](wiki:ultros), ten remained, and Norak told us they would follow ([Day 50](wiki:day-50), [Session 76](wiki:session-76)). We traveled on to the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) after this.

notes.title: Notos Kitara
notes.body: One of the Instruments of the Muse. Can be crafted by [Volkan](wiki:volkan) at the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) (500gp, 6 days). Has Zone of Truth and Magic Circle, on top of the shared jump, invisibility and levitate ([Session 20](wiki:session-20)).

notes.title: Oath of Brotherhood
notes.body: An oath of brotherhood with [Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi) and [Volon](wiki:volon).

notes.title: Oath of Fellowship
notes.body: The oath of fellowship between the four of us. Nothing more is written down about it yet.

notes.title: Oath of Mezz to Yendithas
notes.body:
> I, Mezz, swear an Oath of Servitude to Yendithas Gyrahaeras. 
> 
> I will not knowingly or intentionally give aid to either Lutheria or Sydon, or known accomplices of either of them.
> 
> If Lutheria, Sydon, or a known accomplice of them should seek me out, I will make this known to a member of the fellowship (meaning Atyche, Brax, Thyphoon or Yendithas) as soon as reasonably possible. I will do the same for other sources of harm intended to them that I learn of as well. I will not allow harm to come to them through inaction or silence on my part.
> 
> This oath ends on one of two conditions: either Lutheria is vanquished, or when Yendithas has been dead for one full week. Should Yendithas, after their death, be resurrected, the oath continues as if they had not died.
> 
> In return, we will do our best to keep them as safe as anyone else aboard the Ultros, and to enable them to improve their skills and connections while serving us, thus improving their outlook on a better life after their servitude.

notes.title: Oath of the Horn
notes.body:
About the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria):
- Give it back to [Vallus](wiki:vallus).
- Do not willingly give the horn to _anyone_ else than the goddess Vallus.
- (Sworn to [Aesop](wiki:aesop)?) He asked us to bring it to Vallus ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)).

notes.title: Oath of the Ultros
notes.body:
To captain the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) with honour:

> "Even though we might sail into the mouth of the Nether Sea, I bind my fate to that of the Ultros."

In a dream, [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander) makes us swear it ([Session 41](wiki:session-41), [Day 32](wiki:day-32)).

notes.title: Oath to Kill the King of Fire Island
notes.body: To kill the king of [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island), [King Jamkor](wiki:king-jamkor). We agreed with the lizardfolk queen to attack the firewalker king ([Session 46](wiki:session-46)), and killed him on [Day 39](wiki:day-39) ([Session 49](wiki:session-49)).

notes.title: Oath to Versi
notes.body: To return to [Versi](wiki:versi).

notes.title: Oaths
notes.body:
The oaths we swore, and the ones sworn to us. One note each.

- [Oath of Fellowship](wiki:oath-of-fellowship)
- [Oath to Versi](wiki:oath-to-versi): to return to her
- [Oath of Brotherhood](wiki:oath-of-brotherhood) with [Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi) and [Volon](wiki:volon)
- [Oath of the Horn](wiki:oath-of-the-horn): give the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria) back to [Vallus](wiki:vallus)
- [Oath of the Ultros](wiki:oath-of-the-ultros): to captain the [Ultros](wiki:ultros) with honour
- ~~[Oath to Kill the King of Fire Island](wiki:oath-to-kill-the-king-of-fire-island)~~
- [Oath of Mezz to Yendithas](wiki:oath-of-mezz-to-yendithas)

Our debt of 420 platinum to [The fates](wiki:the-fates) is now a quest: [Pay Our Debt to the Fates](wiki:pay-our-debt-to-the-fates).

notes.title: Paradox tokens
notes.body:
Given to us by the DM on [Day 50](wiki:day-50) ([Session 76](wiki:session-76)) after the Dream on [Versi](wiki:versi). Six tokens, one for each of 6 paradoxes. Killing [Gaius](wiki:gaius) and [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) left two empty spots in each of three events:
- [Day 8](wiki:day-8), the confrontation with [Gaius](wiki:gaius) ([Session 19](wiki:session-19)).
- The games, somewhere on days 22-29 ([Session 29](wiki:session-29)).
- [Day 11](wiki:day-11), the throne room ([Session 22](wiki:session-22)).

How they work:
- They are used to skip us forward in time at random. It is not clear how.
- The skips change when the Oath of Peace ends, but it will still end.
- For each paradox we fix for [Gaius](wiki:gaius) or [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus), one token is gone.

One token was used on the way to the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates), skipping [Day 51](wiki:day-51) ([Day 52](wiki:day-52)).

notes.title: Party Name - The Holy Fainted Bras
notes.body:
[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon), [Brax](wiki:brax), [Atyche](wiki:atyche) and [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas), with [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) and [Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi) as their companions.

Fame level 2!

notes.title: Pay Our Debt to the Fates
notes.body:
We owe 420 platinum pieces to [The fates](wiki:the-fates) (see [Session 45](wiki:session-45) and [Session 48](wiki:session-48)).
- Not 4200 gold. **420 PLATINUM. NOT GOLD. IN PLATINUM PIECES.**
- On [Day 48](wiki:day-48) we couldn't pay, because they want platinum and we brought gold ([Session 69](wiki:session-69)).
- On [Day 49](wiki:day-49) we found 450 platinum in [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus)' apartments ([Session 73](wiki:session-73)).

notes.title: Pythor
notes.body:
One of [The Five](wiki:the-five) Gods: the God of Battle.
A son of [Mytros](wiki:mytros-god) and [Volkan](wiki:volkan). Brother of [Vallus](wiki:vallus).
Appeared to the settlers during the First War and fought tirelessly against the centaurs and gygans that threatened to overwhelm the city of Mytros. His praises were sung for centuries after. Said to have walked among the settlers in mortal guise, taking women to his bed and fathering demi-god children.
A few centuries ago he became king of [Estoria](wiki:estoria) by overthrowing a mad tyrant.
His daughter: [Anora](wiki:).
His wife was taken by the evil dragon [Hexia](wiki:).
Has been a mess for about 50 years before we meet him.
- [Volkan](wiki:volkan) can craft with his hammer at the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) ([Session 20](wiki:session-20)).
- Rumored to have stepped down and disappeared ([Session 22](wiki:session-22)); he gave his throne to his daughter ([Session 42](wiki:session-42)).
- His daughter is to be sacrificed at the Rock of Estor ([Session 6](wiki:session-6), [Day 3](wiki:day-3)). We drank from the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria) after returning to him ([Session 11](wiki:session-11)).

notes.title: Pythoria
notes.body: Reached by a less-traveled road from the crossroads between [Estoria](wiki:estoria) and [Mytros](wiki:mytros), where the road to the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) also splits off. We camped at that crossroads ([Session 21](wiki:session-21), [Day 9](wiki:day-9)).

notes.title: Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)
notes.body: Became a [Euryale](wiki:euryale) in the end.

notes.title: Queen Vita
notes.body: The queen of the tree climbers of [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island). Now the queen of the whole island.

notes.title: Quests
notes.body:
Our quests, one note each. The overview on the site is built from their `status`.

- [The Three Great Tasks](wiki:the-three-great-tasks), given by [Versi](wiki:versi) ([Session 5](wiki:session-5)):
	- [Shape the Silver Fires of the Lost Forge](wiki:shape-the-silver-fires-of-the-lost-forge) ([Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge), [Session 19](wiki:session-19))
	- [Claim the Weapons of the First Dragonlords](wiki:claim-the-weapons-of-the-first-dragonlords)
	- [Drink from the Bottomless Dragonhorn](wiki:drink-from-the-bottomless-dragonhorn) ([Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria), [Session 11](wiki:session-11))
- [Visit the Three Great Seas](wiki:visit-the-three-great-seas): the Cerulean Gulf, the Forgotten Sea and the legendary [Nether Sea](wiki:nether-sea)
- [Pay Our Debt to the Fates](wiki:pay-our-debt-to-the-fates)
- [Lift the Curse on Brax's Family](wiki:lift-the-curse-on-brax-s-family)
- Where each of us wanted to go ([00 - All Islands](wiki:00-all-islands)):
	- [Take the Fight to Gaius on Yonder](wiki:take-the-fight-to-gaius-on-yonder)
	- [A Dragon Egg on Fire Island](wiki:a-dragon-egg-on-fire-island)
	- [Atyche's Fate on the Island of the Fates](wiki:atyche-s-fate-on-the-island-of-the-fates)
	- [Brax to Scorpion Island](wiki:brax-to-scorpion-island)
	- [Thyphoon to the Gardens of Helios](wiki:thyphoon-to-the-gardens-of-helios)

notes.title: Realm of Khronos
notes.body:
A giant rock island in another dimension, home of [Khronos](wiki:khronos). We got there after diving under the waves with [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan): a merfolk city under the sea, then darkness and an aurora ([Day 40](wiki:day-40), [Session 52](wiki:session-52)).

- Khronos sends us back in time to [Day 42](wiki:day-42) (relative day -5) ([Day 41](wiki:day-41), [Session 52](wiki:session-52)).
- The map pin is only a placeholder: it is not a place on the map of [Thylea](wiki:thylea).

notes.title: Rison Phobas
notes.body:
One of the dragonlords ([Session 14](wiki:session-14), [Day 5](wiki:day-5)).

- Loved and compassionate.
- Second in command and lifelong rival of [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath), who was authoritarian.
- Survived the war and died a natural death later on.
- [Gareth Nydia](wiki:yendithas) (me) was his loyal servant. Perhaps lovers?

notes.title: Rumours and open questions
notes.body:
What we've heard but not confirmed, and the questions we still have. Once something is confirmed, it moves to its own note.

## Rumours
- [Titan's Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley) is rumoured to hold Thylea's greatest treasure. Every fisherman knows the legend ([00 - All Islands](wiki:00-all-islands)).
- The island of the constellation 'Titan' is probably [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)'s, and 'The Dreamer' ([Charybdis](wiki:charybdis)) probably [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)'s ([Islands](wiki:islands)).
- Someone from [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)'s backstory is on the Island of the Oathbreakers ([Oathbreaker Island](wiki:oathbreaker-island)).
- [Titan's Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley) may be inhabited by the [Myrmekes](wiki:myrmekes) ([Islands](wiki:islands)).
- The great chimera of the Cerulean Gulf took 12 victims (rumour at the bath house, [Day 24](wiki:day-24), [Session 30](wiki:session-30)).

## What's coming
- The oath of peace ends on day 93 ([Day 33](wiki:day-33), [Session 42](wiki:session-42)).
- A soldier's letter on Yonder: [Gaius](wiki:gaius) prepares for war, the oath of peace fails within two moons, and a horned mage serves the Lady of Dreams ([Day 49](wiki:day-49), [Session 70](wiki:session-70)).
- [Gaius](wiki:gaius)' letter to [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan): Sydon's fleets have been readied for the invasion ([Session 75](wiki:session-75)).
- [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) tracks us through the ripples of our time travel ([Mezz](wiki:mezz), [Day 50](wiki:day-50)).

## Open questions
- What happens to the [Paradox tokens](wiki:paradox-tokens) when the oath of peace ends, and how do we fix the paradoxes?
- How do we reach the [Nether Sea](wiki:nether-sea)? The [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) now reaches the Forgotten Sea, but nothing is recorded about the Nether Sea.
- Who or what is [Khronos](wiki:khronos)?
- When did we meet [Hamun Kost](wiki:hamun-kost): [Day 10](wiki:day-10) (Sessions 21 and 69) or [Day 18](wiki:day-18) (the shared timeline)?
- Will the dragon eggs hatch? ([Day 49](wiki:day-49))

notes.title: Satyr's Tail
notes.body:
A pub on Stygian Row, the bad neighbourhood of [Mytros](wiki:mytros). Frequented by the satyr Qempas ([Session 22](wiki:session-22)).

- Full of drunk, pirate-y types. The satyr Fryxon points us to Nero, who sets up a meeting with the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) ([Session 30](wiki:session-30), [Day 24](wiki:day-24)).
- Base of the Cult of the Snake ([Session 29](wiki:session-29)). [Atyche](wiki:atyche) recruits crew here invisibly ([Session 42](wiki:session-42)).

notes.title: Scorpion Island
notes.body:
Sterrenbeeld: The Centaur

Characters:

- Lotus Witch
- Pholon

notes.title: Session 1

fields.summary: We gather at the Sour Vintage inn, kill a winged beast, and find a scroll from King Acustus ordering the heroes to be watched.

notes.body:
We enter [Thylea](wiki:thylea)!

The continent knows of the coming of heroes who will pick up

Many people come to the call, to the sour vintage inn

We start our quest near this inn.

Tom: [Brax](wiki:brax), a barbarian.
Pascal: [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)
Julia: [Atyche](wiki:atyche) 
Erik: [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas)

We start our quest, traveling through the forest.
We dispatch of a great-winged beast feasting on a horse
At the horse, we find a scroll, which contained an order to figure out about the heroes and report back to [Mytros](wiki:mytros)' king, [Acustus](wiki:acustus).

notes.title: Session 10

fields.summary: Damon zombifies the Gygan and hands us a scroll of Raise the Dead; Demetria's Shortbow of Cupidity comes to me.

notes.body:
- We kill more goatlings
- I'm given a magic shortbow (see previous session)
- Books, conjuration
- Scrolls transmutation

notes.title: Session 11

fields.summary: We bring the children back, get a javelin of lightning from Corinna's family, and drink from the Horn of Balmytria, dreaming of the Ultros.

notes.body:
We travel to [Estoria](wiki:estoria), with the children.
We avoid a headless giant.
We get to the Orchard of [Corinna](wiki:corinna)'s family.
They give us a javelin of lightning (now used by [Typhoon](wiki:thyphoon))
We return to the king ([Pythor](wiki:pythor)).
We drink from the [Horn of Balmytria](wiki:horn-of-balmytria).
We dream of....
- Clear blue morning sky
- we're on a galley
- The other sailors (15) are dead, skeletal
- We're the captain
- We have a strange medaillon that projects the stars in our hands (the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera))
[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) tells us: that was the Ghost Ship [Ultros](wiki:ultros).

"The bard, the centaur, the bear & the nymph".
- Later note: these are constellations. But I don't know in what context they were mentioned here.

notes.title: Session 12

fields.summary: Shopping in Estoria: Henake is found petrified by basilisks, and we hear about the Mithral Mines and the forge.

notes.body:
We go to the market.

We sell an autographed pack of... "stuff"? And we buy a lot of things.

We get 5 healing potions.

In the temple (of Balmytria?), [Typhoon](wiki:thyphoon) practices a "godly trance"

[Henake](wiki:henake) has been petrified by basilisks. We bring him back to the temple. In an earlier session, though I apparently did not write it down, we convinced him to keep watch near the stone where sacrifices are made. The Tragic tale of Henake is about this event.

We go to the inn, listening for rumors.
- We hear about halflings that need help, a few hours "off camp"?, southern gates (not entirely sure what I meant here).
- A giant being stormed into the mines. Cerberus and death dogs?
- Dragonlords attempted to free the place (in the past, or do they mean the dragonriders that are around now that belong to the king of [Mytros](wiki:mytros)?)
- We talk to the dwarves, they've mined in the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines). 

We hear that the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) has been overrun by... Centaurs? From the Dwarves. (Later: it was Troglodytes, see [Session 15](wiki:session-15).) More details:
- The Mythral Mines are in the Great Falls of Arkelon, near the Arkelon River.
- There's only one entrance.
- These mines are/will be/were critical in the war to defeat the titans. 
- [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) prevented this from happening further.
- Some lesser creatures are now in the Mythril Mines.
- There's a lift that needs a code-word or it will become very hot. There should be a clue nearby. There might also be stairs to use instead of the elevator.
- If you follow the Arkelon River to the waterfall, then the mines are at the foot of the waterfall.
- Follow the right path to the forge, or the left for the store rooms.

"Follow order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) to sacrificial place". Who followed that? Notes are unclear.

We receive a quest (that we never followed up on, actually), to return dwarven skulls for 10 gold each from the mines.

notes.title: Session 13

fields.summary: The order of Sydon demands sacrifices; we find the basilisks' lair and learn about Estor Arklander.

notes.body:
- We go to talk to the order of Sydon
- They demand we offer ourselves instead (instead of what? IIRC, some woman?). Oh, plus 50 oxen.
- We go back to our room, and get some of the good wine
- We find the Basilisk's Lair in the river.

We learn that [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander):
- was killed by a trick of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)
- his last descendant is King [Acustus](wiki:acustus)

notes.title: Session 14

fields.summary: We kill the basilisks and find the book of Gareth Nydia, loyal servant of Rison Phobas.

notes.body:
- We kill the basilisks (song: Battling the Basilisks)
- We read the history book (what book? likely loot in the lair of the basilisks), some parchment falls out. We learn:
	- It's a dragonlord's book. Of [Gareth Nydia](wiki:yendithas), who we later learn is actually me ([Yendithas](wiki:yendithas)).
	- His nickname was "hearsay". Reason being that "Gareth Hearsay Nydia" was an anagram of my full name. Tricky DM!
	- Was a loyal servant of [Rison Phobas](wiki:rison-phobas). Perhaps lovers?
	- "A direct descendant of Yendithas". Well, that's a lie, we now know.

[Rison Phobas](wiki:rison-phobas) was:
- Loved
- Compassionate
- The 2nd in command of, and a lifelong rival of, [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath), who was authoritarian.
- Survived the war, and died a natural death later on.

notes.title: Session 15

fields.summary: We party, then meet Hukar's centaurs, who tell us Troglodytes have taken the Mithral Forge.

notes.body:
- We party for the rest of the day
- [Brax](wiki:brax) and [Typhoon](wiki:thyphoon) have a mock fight
- We party all day

The next day:
- We meet [Hukar](wiki:hukar)
	- They are the leader of the centaurs
	- he is friends(?) with Kaluk and Hirak.
- We learn that the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) has been taken over by Troglodytes.

notes.title: Session 16

fields.summary: In the Mithral Mines we are brought before the Troglodyte king Fotkaro, solve his three riddles, and kill them all.

notes.body:
- We continue on into the mountain
Note: this is what happens in the mines themselves. 
- We save 2 centaurs from Troglodytes, Kaluk and Hirak. They have no other information for us.
- After a short rest, we go back in. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)'s axe and the bodies (of the Troglodytes?) are gone.
- We're attacked by Troglodytes again. [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) is knocked unconscious and we're taken to the king of the troglodytes. 
	- [Fotkaro](wiki:fotkaro) is/was the "former king of Troglodytes". Not certain if I wrote "former" since we killed him here or if Fotkaro was a previous one.
- They're all killed after we solve their riddles three.
Song: Troglodyte Thunder.

notes.title: Session 17

fields.summary: The centaurs give us potions of heroism, and we kill the two-headed dogs feeding on a dead cerberus.

notes.body:
- [Brax](wiki:brax) goes apple dumping in the horribly stinking pool. Why? No idea anymore.
- We return to the river and call the centaurs.
- They give us 3 potions of heroism, made from their own blood.
- We rest and continue at 10:00.
- We go back into the cave, to the north.
- We find a giant pit.
- The cerberus is found dead, with some smaller 2-headed dogs eating it.
- We kill the doggies.
Demon Dog Boogie is about this, I think.

notes.title: Session 18

fields.summary: We ride the elevator down and meet Fajra, the fire elemental who is the forge.

notes.body:
We prepare to enter the elevator.
- We drench ourselves
- Brax goes into the elevator first and comes back safely.
- We go in. [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) starts hyperventilating, and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) snaps her out of it by kissing her thoroughly.
- We get to the bottom.
- We find a fire lady who was captured there by the dwarves: [Fajra](wiki:fajra).
- She _is_ the forge.
- A "small" cerberus comes out and is killed with the help of Fajra.

[Fajra](wiki:fajra) is:
- A fire elemental
- "the forge" -> the reason the forge is so good is because of her.
- demands:
	- we break the contract that keeps her there
	- we remove the frost ball ("orb of cold").
- If we meet her demands, she will give us information.
- However, by freeing her, we can't create mythical / magic items in the forge.

notes.title: Session 19

fields.summary: We free Fajra; on the way back Gaius flies over on his dragon, and dragonriders summon us to Mytros.

notes.body:
- We free [Fajra](wiki:fajra).
	- Brax goes down in the process of smashing the orbs.
- Fajra will stay for a year to keep the forge lit
- We level up!
- We get loot!
- We go back through the mines.
- We kill the "brood mothers" of the Troglodytes, if I recall correctly.
	- [Atyche](wiki:atyche) and [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) move the younglings back through "the cold portal"
	- Isn't this where I got my Telepathy? I haven't written it down.
- We go back to the campsite along the river.
- There, we dream again.
	- It's black and we hear a feminine voice
	- we see ourselves walk a path in a beautiful valley. A man with his back to us. We hear birds. "Kennis is de zwaarste last voor stervelingen. Het is pijn, macht." The man turns around and is fearful, pained. Blood pours from his eyes. His mouth, eyes and nose are sewn shut. He's clawing at his face.
	- Atyche is the first to wake.

We learn that the password for the elevator (in the [Mythral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines)) is "Darastrix", draconic for dragon.
We learn that the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge) was a key component in the victory 500 years ago, settling the oath of peace.
It's built on/near a deposit of Mithril and Adamantine.
It was destroyed by [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) with the cerberus she bred.

- The next day we continue and see dark clouds coming to us
- Not clouds - it's [Gaius](wiki:gaius) of the order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) on a silver dragon.
- Some centaurs with smoking black eyes storm us as Gaius takes off again.
- We scare them off.
- Back in [Estoria](wiki:estoria), we're greeted by 3 dragonriders from [Acustus](wiki:acustus), who summons us to [Mytros](wiki:mytros).
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) convinces them to wait for 24 hours.

notes.title: Session 2

fields.summary: Guided by Tenaias, we hunt and kill what turns out to be an ordinary boar.

notes.body:
We learn that we're not the first party to travel with Tenaias.
We find a boar, trap it, and kill it with the help of killstealer Tenaias.
[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) is already traveling with us at this point, and goes for a bit of a walk.
These appear to have been simple boars?

notes.title: Session 20

fields.summary: In Estoria Lutheria possesses a woman, Aesop tells us about Acustus's young dragons, and we order instruments from Volkan.

notes.body:
- We're back in [Estoria](wiki:estoria).
- The dragonriders had been sent ("Tarkon"? No idea who that is)
- A storm has been raging on the seas around [Mytros](wiki:mytros).
	- This prevents any ships from going there.
- [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) possesses a woman, and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) knocks her out.
- We go back to the [Dragon Shrine](wiki:dragon-shrine) in Estoria.
- We ask [Aesop](wiki:aesop) about the cold portal we saw in the [Mithral Mines](wiki:mythral-mines).
	- "Legends from prehistory about the race. They "crawled from the earth""
	- We ask about the dragons: "Acustus has sworn to bring back the dragonlords. He's been working on it for years, and now has a small flight of dragons"
		- It's expected that the return of dragonlords will be what saves Thylea.
		- The dragons look adult, but are very curious about everything - I estimate them to be quite young in mind.
- One of the dwarves we talk to again remembers the Troglodytes
- We learn that [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath) always had a large collection of weapons.
- With the hammer of [Pythor](wiki:pythor), he could make, at the forge:
	- A "rod of lordly might"
	- A "luckblade"?, would cost 10 days, 20.000 gold, be a magical sword and take an orb of stormmetal.
	- He could also make:
		- mithril chain (5 days, 50 gold, mithril ingot)
		- mithril weapons (5 days, 200 gold, mithril ingot)
	- We order:
		- Amulet of health, will take 5 days
		- Zaphyre lute, will take 1 day
		- Euros' lyre, will take 2 days
		- Right now, it's day 11, and he will still need to travel to the forge

Possible other items Pythor could make at the [Mythral Forge](wiki:mythral-forge):
- Instruments of the Muse
	- Take an action to cast a spell, once per day
	- They increase spell save dc by +2
	- Each has jump, (greater?) invisibility and levitate
	- The unique ones:
		- Zaphyre Lute (50gp, 1 day): also has Hold Person and Conjure Elemental
		- Euros Lyre (100gp, 2 days): also has Counterspell (3rd level) and Sleep (4th level)
		- Boreal Harp (200gp, 4 days): also has Control Weather and Conjure Animals
		- [Notos Kytra](wiki:notos-kitara) (500gp, 6 days): also has Zone of Truth and Magic Circle

notes.title: Session 21

fields.summary: Brax draws from a deck of many things, Amalthelia speaks through Thyphoon's locket, and Brax obliterates Hamun Kost.

notes.body:
- We decide to start traveling to [Mytros](wiki:mytros). As we start, it's 17:30 in-game.
- We set camp at a crossroads that would go to the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok) and [Pythoria](wiki:pythoria). Both are less-traveled roads.
- We set camp at 21:30.
- In the morning, [Brax](wiki:brax) catches some fish.
- Brax decides to draw cards from the epic deck (where did he get this? Can't remember): a deck of many cards.
	- He draws the lovers: Brax is instantly naked and loses all his trophies. Apparently, he has a 15 inch dong. (Song: Brax the great)
	- He draws Temperance: nothing changes apparently. (I believe this results in him no longer being able to taste alcohol or get drunk)
	- He draws the devil: shrieking laughs all around, and his charisma drops from 9 to 8.
- He fashions new clothing for himself.
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) has an amulet that starts to glow red-hot and shows markings.
	- There's a heroic nymph on one side.
	- The nymph is hand in hand with a black-robed figure walking towards a sunrise
	- The nymph is Thyphoon's grandmother.
	- She starts speaking to Thyphoon (was this in a vision, or on the medaillon itself?):
		- She's [Amalthelia](wiki:amalthelia).
		- She tells him he needs to bring back the dragonlords
- We start traveling again (day 12)
- We find a big clearing near the bend. Nature starts rotting in the distance.
- We find [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) again, leaning against a tree (she always tends to disappear).
- We find papers in a pit, guarded by a skeletal minotaur. There's a book authored by [Hamon Kost](wiki:hamun-kost). We take them with a mage hand.
- [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) somewhat recognizes a map on the ground (it's the sword coast, of the "main world", where Yendithas is from - all other party members originate from [Thylea](wiki:thylea)).
- A tattooed man steps out of the tent when called (Hamon)
- [Brax](wiki:brax) is offended and attacks him. Hamon is obliterated.

notes.title: Session 22

fields.summary: We capture the satyr Qempas, arrive in Mytros under Sydon's storm, and hear the court's proposals to end it.

notes.body:
- We continue our travel at 18:00
- We set up a camp at a crossroads.
	- North: to [Estoria](wiki:estoria)
	- South: to [Mytros](wiki:mytros).
	- West: to the [Southern Settlements](wiki:southern-settlements) (not entirely sure how this works, but it's in the notes)
- "[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) twilight" (in the notes, no idea what that's about)
- A satyr jumps from the trees and attacks us
- We get his panflute and tie him up. We drag him to the fire.
- He introduces himself as Qempas
	- He frequents the [Satyr's Tail](wiki:satyr-s-tail), a pub(?) on Stygean Row (which is the bad neighbourhood, like "Harlem").
	- He has a contact, Zenthyr, a ginger human who can be bribed, and is a guard at the gate.
- He tells us that [Mytros](wiki:mytros) is in lockdown.
- He tells us they saw a face in the clouds ([Sydon (Titan)](wiki:sydon-titan)?)
- He tells us about a rumor that [Pythor](wiki:pythor) stepped down and disappeared.
- He tells us about the Soldier's Gate to enter. There's a rotating guard of 2 captains and 12 soldiers. He tells us to bribe one, then past the Harper Bridge. Ask if "ale has been served for breakfast". Pay 50 gold pieces per person. It will take a few hours, so bring a cloak.
- We arrive at Mytros.
- We see Sydon look at us from the storm, and he attacks us.
- Brax is hit in the shoulder and gets lightning scars.
- We get to the palace.
	- There's a tiefling from the [Cult of Lutheria](wiki:cult-of-lutheria), called [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus).
	- [Gaius](wiki:gaius), the commander of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan).
	- [Vallus](wiki:vallus), the goddess of wisdom
	- King [Acustus](wiki:acustus).
	- A naked woman ([Bella the Concubine](wiki:bella-the-concubine)).
- Acustus asks us to make a decision to get rid of the storm.
	- Option 1: if we're strong enough to change the weather ourselves, we should.
	- Option 2: [Gaius](wiki:gaius) suggests we flatten the [Temple of the Five](wiki:temple-of-the-five) to appease [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan).
	- Option 3: [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) says they need new recruits to soothe [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), so we could let 70 children "take the black robe".
	- Option 4: [Bella the Concubine](wiki:bella-the-concubine) suggests we make an offer to Sydon himself. According to Acustus, this would take a "Hecatomb" (100 oxen) - equivalent to 10.000 gold pieces.
	- Option 5: [Vallus](wiki:vallus) steps forward. She summoned the other of the 5 who are still alive - [Pythor](wiki:pythor), [Volkan](wiki:volkan) and [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) ([Mytros](wiki:mytros-god) is dead). A sacrifice of their strength could counter [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan).

We end up choosing option 5, but that happens in [Session 23](wiki:session-23).

Some more details that are in a diagram in my notes:
- [Volkan](wiki:volkan), god of forges, is partner of / married to [Mytros](wiki:mytros-god), goddess of dawn.
- Their children are:
	- [Pythor](wiki:pythor), god of battle
	- [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah)
	- [Vallus](wiki:vallus), goddess of Wisdom

notes.title: Session 23

fields.summary: The Five sacrifice part of their divinity to clear the storm; Vallus gives us the map to the Ultros and we meet Icarus.

notes.body:
[Vallus](wiki:vallus) tells us that her plan (see [Session 22](wiki:session-22)) would cost the five some of their divinity.

- More sacrifices would give them more power (again).
- We convince them.
- We postpone for an hour to talk with Vallus.
	- Vallus tells us that Acustus also wants to find the [Ultros](wiki:ultros). If we find it first, we should take it to the personal harbor of [Vallus](wiki:vallus) instead to keep it safe.
	- We also learn that [Makhaila](wiki:makhaila) is the leader/captain of Vallus' Amazon guards.
	- There are 13 amazons in total there.
	- She warns us that going to the Ultros is likely dangerous.
	- Apparently, Acustus has a hard time sleeping.
	- Vallus does not know how Acustus got his dragon.
	- Acustus has had the dragons for over half a year.
	- Normally, it takes 400-500 years for a dragon to grow - so these are almost certainly unnatural (we later learn that [The fates](wiki:the-fates) had a hand in this).
	- Acustus is trying to found a "new order of" dragonlords.
	- Acustus is (one of the last) descendants of [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander), who was the Captain of the Ghostship [Ultros](wiki:ultros).
	- She warns us of danger on the road to the Ultros, and tells us to return when we complete the third labor (see [quests](wiki:quests)).
	- We need the Ultros to reach the [Nether Sea](wiki:nether-sea), and the [Antikythera](wiki:antikythera) to navigate there.
	- The ultros was last seen at the [Dead Falls](wiki:dead-falls) in the eastern heartlands.

- The gods perform a ritual
- The clouds clear
- We get the map to the ultros
- We're escorted out to the royal garden.
- There's a huge pile of silver coins outside. A snoring, silver dragon is on top of it ([Acustus](wiki:acustus)' dragon).
	- Name: [Icarus](wiki:icarus).
	- There's 38786 silver coins (why did I write this down).
	- He's been in [Mytros](wiki:mytros) for 20 years.
- We summon food "by the gods"?
- I change my order at [Volkan](wiki:volkan) to:
	- Boreal Harp
	- Euros' Lyre
- We travel to the crossroads with [Volkan](wiki:volkan).
- It will take 1.5 days to travel [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok), where we will arrive either at the end of the 15th or the start of the 16th day (google sheets timelines says we actually enter the Necropolis on the 16th, likely check notes of [Session 25](wiki:session-25)).
- As we go on, it becomes colder.
- We see more stone hands (of [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan)) along the road.

notes.title: Session 24

fields.summary: Harpies attack us on the road, and at the Necropolis at Telamok we pay Damon to enter.

notes.body:
- We encounter a bunch of harpies and fight them (epic verse: The haphazard harpy's).
- We arrive at the [Necropolis at Telamok](wiki:necropolis-at-telamok).
- We pay [Damon](wiki:damon) to enter.
- Brax gets the "Gem of Brightness".
- We inspect many of the tombs.
- We move over to one of the doors in the cliffside.. It says:
	- [Telamok Arklander](wiki:telamok-arklander), oathsworn of [Vallus](wiki:vallus).
	- The door is 10x10 feet.
	- "Death awaits any who would desecrate the great warrior within".

notes.title: Session 25

fields.summary: In Xander's tomb we scare off the minotaur Graxis and fight skeletal hoplites and a mimic sarcophagus.

notes.body:
We enter the tomb of [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath).... Around 9 in the evening, after a long rest.

Large, bronze statue of a male Minotaur.

A possible maze is behind the minotaur, [Brax](wiki:brax) takes the lead.

A giant Minotaur comes around the corner, Graxis. He seems to be guarding the tombs. He holds an axe and shield, which seem to be the same Xander had been using.

[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) tries to convince him to let us through. His face goes from neutral to a grimace.

We scare him off, and follow his smell to his lair.

-   600 copper pieces
-   254 silver pieces
-   115 gold pieces
-   6 pieces of jewelry at 25gp each

After that, there are skeletons in very old armor, ancient hoplites and phalanxes.

Eventually, we find a round room with a sarcophagus and a rug, depicting Xander dominating a race of bull-headed minotaurs, with one making a peace offering.

-   The rug and the sarcophagus are mimics! Or the rug is a huggy rug of smothering, rather.

notes.title: Session 26

fields.summary: We kill Graxis and reach Xander, who gives us two dragonlord crowns and his axe, and reveals Gaius stole my armor.

notes.body:
We continue on.

We kill the minotaur as he crashes through the wall.

Going onward, [Atyche](wiki:atyche) is slorped by a gelatinous cube. We hear a cackling laugh like from [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) and Atyche is freed.

[Brax](wiki:brax) does not want to

We find Xander.

-   Happy to see us
-   Happy that Graxis is dead
-   Content that [Damon](wiki:damon) will defend his crypt

Question: can he help us recover the Dragonlords?

-   He gives us two crowns of the dragonlords, one to me, one to [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)

He must tell me something else:

-   My set of armor was stolen from Xander tens of years ago.
-   Was stolen by [Gaius](wiki:gaius)

He gives us an awesome axe

-   Axe of Xander
-   It's more intelligent than me

notes.title: Session 27

fields.summary: Leaving the Necropolis, we lure a Stimfay at a bridge and arrive at the Siren's Roost in Mytros amid rumours of the Great Games.

notes.body:
We stand outside the tomb in the morning.

-   Amulet of health should be done on the 19th day.
-   Lyre should be done on the 21th
-   Final item I ordered on the 25th

**Afstanden**:

-   [Mytros](wiki:mytros)-Estoria 2 dagen
-   Kruispunt-Estoria 0.5 dag
-   Kruispunt-Mytros 1.5 dag
-   Kruispunt-Nekropolis 0.5 dag

**Ultros Exposure**

-   Map of the last known location
-   Dread Falls, rocky wastelands of the eastern (heartlands?)
-   [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) unleashed his fury against the Ultros to drag it down
-   Magic of the Ultros was too powerful
-   Several years after the end of the war, it disappeared

So we decide to go to Mytros first.

We exit the Nekropolis and walk to the crossroads, and it gets warmer noticeably.

We come across a bridge where we see Stimfay and some dead Centaur and [Amazons](wiki:the-amazons). [Brax](wiki:brax) manages to lure one of the Stimfay!

We then travel on for 2 days

**Morning of the 19th day**

We arrive in Mytros

We go to the Siren's Roost, which is a very, very expensive inn, with the most expensive clientele.

Brax is taken aside by the guard of the Siren's Roost and told of some children that have been taken by the cult?

Geruchten in de kroeg:

-   Schip van [Aresia](wiki:aresia) naar [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island) vol warrior monks opgeslokt door de whirlpool '[Charybdis](wiki:charybdis)'
-   Team uit Aresia heeft hun beste team gestuurd voor de spelen van Mytros
-   Amazones van [Themis](wiki:themis) hebben ook een delegatie gestuurd

The Great Games entail:

-   Nearly as violent as the campaigns, bloodthirsty barbarians (the spectators)
-   In honor of the oath of peace
-   Marathon
-   Wrestling
-   Boxing
-   Discus throwing
-   Javelin throwing
-   Jumping
-   Doping definitely allowed (magically)
-   7 days, every day another competition

[Gaius](wiki:gaius) flies over the city on his dragon basically daily

_"On this good morning, your city has been blessed. Since the guardians of [thylea](wiki:thylea) have come here to rest!"_

_Kom toch hier, goede mensen, en treur nu niet meer, de bardians of Thylea zijn eindelijk hier. Na de domper van die sirens verdienen jullie een lied!_

[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) sings "The Haphazard Harpy's"

Taken aside by Ambrosia as it is quite harsh against Sydon in the last bit

-   There are those who follow Sydon, due to king [Acustus](wiki:acustus)
-   Those who are in-between
-   Queen [Vallus](wiki:vallus) and her 'followers'
-   All wine in and around Mytros comes from [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) and her followers
-   **[Lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) has victims in groups that are literally petrified?**

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) wint armpjedrukken met een neppe half-god

notes.title: Session 28

fields.summary: Trading jewels and meeting the court, we learn how the five new gods were summoned.

notes.body:
We're currently at the market, going into 'zorins concoctions'.

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) gave me 6 jewels, worth 150 gold

-   we trade 2 for a paperweight for Thyphoon's clairvoyance

Er komt een runner aan om ons uit te nodigen voor de great debates, met de great philosophers: Ser Tosca, Polta, Alteose, Agrastoi

We go on to the palace, where [Atyche](wiki:atyche) has a private conversation with the queen.

In the meantime, the main Amazon has a talk with [Brax](wiki:brax) about the bird.

... Neurdagon is very interested in finding the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) (Neurdagon estate)

[Vallus](wiki:vallus) is nieuwsgierig naar waar de cult van [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) bezig mee is, zonder bende schoppen.

### [Summoning the new gods](wiki:summoning-the-new-gods)

The civilized people, led by the dragonlords, they conquered the children of [Thylea](wiki:thylea-titan) and kept being routed.

Armies of Gygans and ... cried out to the titans for aid, begging them to destroy the dragons.

[Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) and Lutheria joined the battle on the side of the natives. Sydon struck them with wind and lightning to force them to the ground, where Lutheria could reach them.

In the last stand, the silver dragon [Balmytria](wiki:balmytria) fought fiercely. On her death, the twins spit on her corpse, creating a hole in the universe. 5 celestial beings were summoned by this.

The 5 pledged themselves to protect the new races, creating a new balance in the fight.

We go to the debate hall and talk to the philosophers.

They give us some books (1gp each):

-   ???? of Ser Tosca
-   Dialogues of Polta
-   Mathematica
-   Alttrose Metafysica

After reading all 4 books, you get proficiency in arcana.

notes.title: Session 29

fields.summary: Brax refuses a minotaur sacrifice and wins the long jump; the Lady of Coins is unmasked as a Medusa behind the Cult of the Snake.

notes.body:
[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) scries the menagerie, and sees that the collector is frozen in place.

We eat in the inn (rations), then travel to mount volkan for the games.

-   [Versi](wiki:versi) is one of the parties that will be a 'judge' for the games?
-   Akmides
-   [Vallus](wiki:vallus), the queen
-   [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) (the priest of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) that's a councellor to the king). Noone in a wide circle around him.

Every day, a Minotaur is sacrificed to open the games. [Brax](wiki:brax) disagrees and storms in. Vallus declares that no sacrifice will be made, but instead, Brax will fight [Bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi) (the other minotaur).

The candidates are:

-   Cy, a warrior monk from [Aresia](wiki:aresia), known for great achievements in the previous games. Has a mage.
-   Egan, an old competitor from Estoria, dozens of victories in his name. Has a mage.
-   Falana, a bard and fan favorite of the youth of [Mytros](wiki:mytros).
-   Hatria, amazon from [Themis](wiki:themis).
-   Jorges, a cool dude. Arrogant, pompous, member of the order of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan). From Mytros. Has a mage.
-   Leyland, from Mytros. Fan favorite. Multiple victories.
-   Pancras, a nymph. Has an acolyte
-   Spira, who has been out of the running due to an injury in the great games 5 years ago. Acolyte.

The event today is Jumping.

Mage/Priest is the better option for doping, Acolyte the lesser.

Qualification is needed for any game.

Day 1: long jump. Both Thyphoon and Brax qualify! Brax achieves first place, Thyphoon a shared 2nd.

The minotaur that Brax saved offers to join us.

-   He has no real bloodlust, will always do a non-lethal knockout
-   Has been robbed by bandits once. Did not kill them, for which he got the respect of a local family, who raised him.
-   Was sold as a slave when the family was attacked, so does NOT like Sydon.
-   Likes food. A lot.

Bullbug joins the party!

We go to the temple of Lutheria and enter.

Trellus tells us that there are likely bandits in the grape fields. If we bring them in alive, we will get 2000 gold pieces. For their heads, 1000. He will also show us how the wine is made, in that case.

We then head back to the menagerie. Thyphoon discovers that everything there, except for the Centaur, emits magic. Conjuration, illusion and transmutation fromt he collector, transmutation from all other animals.

Thyphoon casts dispell magic, revealing that everything was an illusion (song: The collector had a store). We open the chest that remains, showing a spellbook with _all_ mage spells, and 50 platinum coins.

We also find a lot of proofs of purchase of minotaurs to one **Maximus**.

**Craig**, the centaur we just freed, describes that he was captured by a half-warrior, half-slavemaster. A lot of armor, a large horn from one shoulder. Dented, scratched, a lot of dried-up blood. Hair in a knot, asian features. Kyra describes him as **Maximus the Merciless**.

We go to court. They start an investigation in this whole thing, which will take several days.

Afterwards, we go to the Neurdagon estate, and try to convince them to let us in. He lets us in under the 'oath' of friendship.

He tells us that **everyone who was petrified by the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) was a noble family**. (She's Robin Hood) She is a **Medusa**. Behind the Cult of the Snake, based from the Satyr's Tail.

Apparently, Neurdagon is a Minotaur Trader. He really likes Maximus, who always buys Neurdagon's minotaurs.

He places a reward of **8000 gold pieces** for the head of the **Lady of Coins**.

notes.title: Session 3

fields.summary: We kill the true great boar while Sydon threatens us, Kyrah resurrects Atyche, and we set off for the Oracle.

notes.body:
We find the true great boar and kill it.
When [Brax](wiki:brax) kills it, we receive a telepathic message, threatening about a dark force (it's [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)'s voice).
[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) resurrects [Atyche](wiki:atyche).
Javon has died, and we burn him ritually.
We leave for the temple of the oracle.

notes.title: Session 30

fields.summary: We place in the footrace and arrange to meet the Lady of Coins.

notes.body:
Recap...

-   [Brax](wiki:brax) won the games
-   We freed Craig
-   Court process started with 'Saul Goodman' against the 'Collector'

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) scries the cellar of the order of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), where he sees a lot of priests brewing wine.

Tellus and Septia are taking notes (temperatures, etc.)

[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) decides to join in the run as well.

We arrive at the games

Yendithas starts to pull ahead, but then quickly becomes exhausted and almost drops out. Thyphoon and Brax both place.

In the real round, Brax becomes 1st, Thyphoon becomes 2nd due to one of the other contestants falling out in the last stage

Stygean is the Thylean name for Tiefling.

we go to the Satyr's tail. We find a lot of drunk people, pirate-y types.

We go to talk to a satyr called Fryxon. He's not the owner of the tail.

He points us to two persons who might know more about the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena), who start walking out. We stop them. Nero and ...

Julius, a guy with a stump, suddenly smacks the bar with his stump.

We talk with Nero and stuff outside and agree to meet the lady of coins tomorrow.

Next, we go to the bath house.

Rumors:

-   aboard one of the merchant ships, the great chimera of the cerulean gulf took 12 victims
-   Ekoh, an Oread, is calling for war with Erasia again. After 500 years, she's still trying to get her betrothed back.

We stop at 5PM when leaving the baths.

notes.title: Session 31

fields.summary: Javelin at the games, wine in the vineyards, Boreas of the Four Winds, and a summons to the statue of Pythor.

notes.body:
We gaan terug naar de Siren's Roost

Gesprek met [bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi) aan tafel:

-   Ziet z'n adoptie ouders als z'n echte ouders
-   Vond ravotten met de andere animals op de farm erg leuk
-   Vooral de kleinere plaatsen aangedaan, de steppes

Javelin: 120 + (d20+(dex OR ath OR acr))*3

We play the javelin throwing.

We go to the vineyards

-   We meet 'Boreas', playing a harp
-   One of 'the four winds'
-   Others: Zephyrus, Boreas,

We go to [Vallus](wiki:vallus) to ask her for advice on what to do: can we use them to bring down the cult? (also, we ask her for her wisdom on the money we took from the menagerie)

We go back to the roost, there's a dagger with a letter on the door of [Brax](wiki:brax) and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)'s door. [Lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) demands us to go to the foot of the drunkard (the statue of [Pythor](wiki:pythor)).

notes.title: Session 32

fields.summary: At the Colossus of Pythor we destroy two reconstituting guardians, teleport inside, then flee.

notes.body:
Recap 31:

-   We threw spears
-   We went to the vineyard
-   We got an invitation to meet the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena)

18:00

We go to the lady of coins at the feet of the statue of Pytor.

We arrive at the statue. There is a 'path' going into the feet of the statue, and there's a rock with a sword in it beneath the statue.

[Atyche](wiki:atyche) flies around the statue to search around. She sees the eyes glow, and victims of the lady of coins around the top.

[Brax](wiki:brax) breaks off [the sword](wiki:the-sword) in the stone, finding a _'stanley knife'_ off which pieces of mithril break off.

The statues next to the entrance come alive when Brax leans against them. We break one, but it reconstitutes itself. (Song: The fight at the drunkard's feet)

Eventually, we break both down to dust.

Atyche teleports inside the statue through the keyhole, and after dispelling the magic, we get inside.

On the next floor up, we find a strange contraption. We run! And go back to the inn, as we have no real reason to go on.

notes.title: Session 33

fields.summary: Brax wins the discus; we recover the Boreal Harp in the wine fields, and it is destroyed.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We had been invited by the [lady of coins](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena)
-   We went to the colossus of [Pythor](wiki:pythor), looking for her
-   No footsteps around the statue, but there was a sword in a rock with a letter from the lady herself.
-   [Atyche](wiki:atyche) found the lady behind the windows at the very top of the statue
-   We teleported inside the foot and opened the stone door
-   At the first level we found some Minotaurs that started attacking us. At that point, we left.

Pythor-ordered items:

-   Health: Done on day 22
-   Euros Lyre: day 21
-   Boreal Harp: day 25

Full moon on night of day 24-25

We can keep the money we found in the magical menagerie on day 32

**The end of day 22, 23:00 bedtime**

We have shared breakfast downstairs. Ambrosia warns us for Leyland.

We go to the arena

Today: discuss throwing

-   (2d20kh1 + (ath/dex/acro (max 3))) * 3 + 90

First place (mithral): [Brax](wiki:brax)

Second place (adamantine): [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon)

Shared third place (bronze): [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) and Hatria (and the crowd goes wiiiiiild)

Afterwards, we go to the wine fields to try and take out the group with the Boreal Harp.

We knock everyone there out with minimal damage, but the harp was destroyed by the enemy.

[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) does not seem very sad about the destroyed harp.

**We end the day at 15:00**

notes.title: Session 34

fields.summary: Delivering captured bandits to the temple of Lutheria, we find a hidden dungeon of prisoners and interrogate Trellus.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We threw spears
-   We went to the vineyard

**This session**

-   We throw the unconscious bodies on the cart and take them to the temple of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)
-   They offer for us to be present at the offering as well
-   We will be paid on the day of the offering
-   We convince them and [Vallus](wiki:vallus) to take Vallus along on the tour. Covername: _Brunhilda Philona_.
-   17:00: we arrive at the temple for the tour.
    -   We could convert to Lutheria during the offering
    -   We go into the distillery
    -   [Brax](wiki:brax) sees quite some 'red' on the floor, either wine (doubtful) or blood(!), near a trapdoor. He tastes it: it's blood.
    -   We go into the wine cellar
    -   While we distract Trellus, [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) finds a room hidden behind a magic door that looks like a wall
    -   We find a ton of loudly crying people in a dungeon (song: In Vino Veritas). Vallus confirms that this should certainly be enough to get a small army to clean up the cult of Lutheria.
    -   We force the tourguide (Trellus) to drink truth serum, and we start questioning him.
        -   He refuses to talk; We intimidate him into talking.
        -   He knew of the dungeons. The cult of Lutheria owes its monthly sacrifice to this dungeon, and would likely have been gone for centuries without it.
        -   He knows us from visions of Lutheria
        -   The cult is pretty much in every city of Tylea, but apart from [Mytros](wiki:mytros), the strongest position is the island of [Themis](wiki:themis) (the island of [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons)). Apparently, the queen of the Amazons is a follower of Lutheria. There, they are called the 'Death Cult of Lutheria'.
        -   According to Trellus, the best way to hit the cult would be by damaging its image.
        -   Lutheria actively makes those who make wine apart from the cult mad/insane.
        -   The wine the cult makes is 'enhanced' with the blood of the sacrifices.
        -   Apparently, when [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus) came of age, he sought out Lutheria in person, something that people normally don't survive. Has much power, works together very closely with the cult of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan), 'observer'
        -   Someone (pay more attention!) from the cult of Sydon regularly visits 'The Isle of Yonder'
        -   Chondrus would likely be able to tell us where to find Lutheria.
        -   He thinks Lutheria's worst fear would be to lose Sydon.
    -   [Atyche](wiki:atyche) sends a message to Makela, the leader of the Amazons that defend Vallus.

notes.title: Session 35

fields.summary: After a dream of Lutheria, the temple of Lutheria is torn down and its priests are dead.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We've had some dealings with the cult of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)
-   Discovered prisoners beneath the cult of Lutheria and exposed the cult
-   Called in [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) to clear out the temple
-   We freed Boreas and his brothers, asked them to give the instruments back, in return for the wine-temple

**Today**

-   Evening of day 24

We go to sleep

-   Around 3 AM, we fall in a very deep sleep
-   We see mountains
-   Dark, slowly becomes lighter. We recognize mount Volkan
-   We see 2 young children (boy + girl) walking down a path. 12, 13 years old. Holding hands.
-   They see the city of [Mytros](wiki:mytros) after a few minutes
-   They don't get into the gates; Climb over the wall.
-   Few weeks later, they're begging on the streets.
-   Few months later, he tries to get a job, but fails.
-   They beg to the skies for help. They hear Lutheria's laugh. She says they will know prosperity if they go to Lutheria's temple.
-   They do so. They're dressed in black. 20 years later, we see them as temple guardians.
-   We see them receiving us at the temple.
-   Next, we see them in a cell, with a black figure whispering something in their ears.

We wake up, once again under influence of Lutheria. [Atyche](wiki:atyche) runs away, [Brax](wiki:brax) is petrified, I'm seething with rage and smack everything.

Brax goes out to train for the next games, the rest of us go back to bed.

Brax smears himself with his own shit to gain the "stench" ability.

The games:

-   First trial for bronze: a drunk bear. Brax, Atyche, [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) and [Bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi) place themselves.
-   Adamantine trial: Egan. Beaten by Yendithas, Bullbug and Brax.
-   Mithril trial: Jorges. Beaten by Brax

We go to the spa afterwards. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) goes to the library.

-   We hear that the temple of Lutheria has been taken down
-   They're apparently no longer welcome in Mytros
-   The high priests committed suicide

notes.title: Session 36

fields.summary: Boxing at the games; I claim my inherited 500 platinum from the vault of Thylea.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We won some great games stuff
-   [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) went researching about the dreams
-   We heard a decree by the king about the cult of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) being banned.

**Today**

-   I get a massage at the bath house.
-   We go to the gardens.
-   We see 'Vitalis' in the gardens, sitting and farting loudly.
    -   We go back to ask him about some things.
    -   "er zit iets op je gezicht... Oh nee, het is je hele gezicht! Net alsof er een peuk is uitgedrukt in een asbak"
    -   Hij wil eten, wijn, bier en dat soort dingen om vragen te beantwoorden.
-   We gaan naar de vault of [Thylea](wiki:thylea). Thyphoon wisselt z'n geld in, [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) vraagt naar z'n bankrekening. Ze willen er niks over vertellen zonder bevestiging dat hij inderdaad een afstammeling is van.
-   We go to bed semi-early and wake up in time for the games.
-   Today: boxing! The opponent this time is 'smasher', also a bear.
-   I get a paper stating I'm the inheritor(?) of Yendithas Gyrahaeras / Gareth Hearsay Nydia from the queen
-   We go to the fish market.
    -   A dwarf gives us the tip to go to the DockYard for a blessing when we go to sea
    -   He once found an island on top of a giant tortoise
    -   An offering of a 'black oxen' should give us a very calm sea.
-   Back to the bank, there is indeed a bank account. After paying 500 years of services, 500 platinum pieces remain.

notes.title: Session 37

fields.summary: We win the Great Relay, gain three fame levels, and accept Ambrosia's sponsorship of the inn.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We met Vitalis in the gardens
-   We went to the fish market to get some information about sailing (expensive animals as sacrifice)
-   We got an official paper stating I'm the inheritor of [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas), getting me some 500 platinum pieces.

**Today**

-   We go back to the Siren's Roost. We get offered a reserved table.
-   Ambrosia sits down next to us, asking about our plans for the relay.
    -   Part 1: beach run. 300 foot over the beach. (Yendithas)
    -   Part 2: underwater swim under an ice lake on mount vulkan. ([Atyche](wiki:atyche))
    -   Part 3: cliff climb. ([Bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi))
    -   Part 4: fire dash. ([Brax](wiki:brax))
    -   Part 5: harpy cages. Evade the harpies. ([Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon))
    -   Points are earned per leg, max 2 points per leg. Making mistakes costs you points.
    -   Any person getting to 0 hp results in all of us dropping out.
-   She also offers us a sponsorship deal of 1000 gold pieces and a 'night of pleasure'.
-   We get up early and go to the relay.
-   Boreas and his crew are also cheering for us in the crowd
-   We win the relay! (Song: Winning the great games of Mytros)
-   Afterwards, King Estoria comes in on his dragon, and hands us our medals
-   **We gain 3 fame levels, for a total of 8**
-   We take the sponsorship deal with Ambrosia of the Siren's Roost - now "The Siren's Roost - The Bardian's Bastion"

notes.title: Session 38

fields.summary: A chaotic morning (Versi turns out to be Thyphoon's aunt), and we set out for the Ultros.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We did great in the games
-   We were offered a ton of gold to name the Siren's Roost after us

**Today**

-   While sleeping upstairs, I get scared awake by a loud noise in the tavern below. The lady is gone, I'm alone in the room, around 6.
-   I try to wake the rest in their rooms, and succeed.
-   Sneaking down the stairs, I see a ton of broken glasses, chairs, everything has been thrown around and broken. I see two humans in the midst of the wreckage
-   The one on top is [Versi](wiki:versi), the one on the bottom is the girl I took upstairs last night. She seems jealous.
-   I try to console her, then finally extricate from her embrace, promising to visit her the next time we're near. I then go downstairs to Ambrosia to discuss the damage.
    -   In the meantime, [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) talks to her and discovers Versi is his aunt, once removed.
-   I apologise to Ambrosia and give her 20 platinum pieces.

_Main quest recap_

-   The king gave us a map to the known last location of the Ultros
-   The location is the Dead Falls
-   Was captained by ...
-   [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) attempted to smash the vessel

We start the actual journey.

We see some bandits and centaurs fight.

We fight against a number of wolves at night.

Then we wake on the 29th day.

notes.title: Session 39

fields.summary: Cranium rats near the Mithral Mines; we collect our ordered items from the quarrelling Volkan and Fajra.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We were woken roughly in the inn
-   We went on to the Mithral Mines. Next stop: Dead Falls, the Ultros.
-   On our way, we watched some centaurs butcher bandits
-   We ended the session at a fight against some dire- and dreadwolves.

**Today**

The start of the 30th day.

[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) has not returned, and won't respond to a sending. We travel to the Mithral mines without her.

When we enter the mines, we see a weird rat with its brains visible watching us. I do not notice them, but remember some myths after [Brax](wiki:brax) told me about the rats. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) and [Atyche](wiki:atyche) together muster up enough religious knowledge to know more: they likely released psyonic abilities on Brax. The race that lives in the Underdark is known to experiment with these abilities.

We arrive at the (quarreling) [Volkan](wiki:volkan) and [Fajra](wiki:fajra). They hand us the amulet of health, the Euros Lyre and the Boreal Harp.

notes.title: Session 4

fields.summary: We free Versi the Oracle in her temple.

notes.body:
Apparently, the first "Corona-Session"!

We free [Versi](wiki:versi) in the temple.

notes.title: Session 40

fields.summary: We commune with psionic creatures, take the Zephyr Lute, run the Lethe past the Dead Falls, and board the Ultros, triggering a specter fight.

notes.body:
**Recap**

-   We've had a battle with wolves and a zombie-like wolf during our rest on the way to the mithral mines.
-   [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) was still gone after this night, and has not reappeared somewhere during the day.
-   We went down with the elevator (Darastrix) and found a quarreling Volkan and Pasha.
-   We saw the psyonic rats on our way there.
-   We took our ordered items (Boreal harp, amulet of health for [Atyche](wiki:atyche), what else?)
-   The psyonic rats seem to be coming from the 'underdark portal'.
-   Then we found a floating tentacle brain and a floating eye-thing.
-   Floating eye-thingy tried to make contact

**Today**

-   We decide to go back to communicate
    
-   I look at the hawkbrainthing. My head starts to feel warm, and the glow of the cranium rats becomes one blanket of colors.
    
-   I repeat the word to the eye tentacle thing
    
-   I start seeing visions in the blanket
    
    -   A large city, inhabited by octopus-like people
    -   A large number of creatures like these walk around in the city
    -   The vision transforms as if time speeds up. More and more technology appears. Until a giant worm-like creature comes from the distance, wiping out a large section of the city. A war between the worm and the creatures breaks out, going on for weeks. They manage to fend off the worm.
    -   The worm works its way upwards, until it turns light. I see dwarf bodies, and a large three-headed creature. The worm kills the three-headed creature. The tunnels are devastated by the worm, until it breaks out of the cave system. I once again hear "Yduld'itherh".
    -   I try to ask if they are here to help fight Yduld'itherh. They project that they are too few to help now.
    -   I try to ask them if they intend to stay here. They seem to tell that they intend to return to the Underdark, to the small settlements they have there.
    -   They seem to tell that they are here merely to warn us, to prevent another civilization from suffering the same fate.
    -   They could close the portal.
    -   We ask them if they could offer any information or other help against the titans.
    -   They project more visions. I see [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) in her true form with her scythe. She sits on a throne in their city in the Underdark. First in harmony, which resulted in the prosperity of the city. I seem to see Lutheria summoning the worm and driving it to the city. The tentacle-people attack Lutheria with their Psyonic abilities, failing somewhat. Next, they attack with swords, which almost seem to pass through her. She seems immune to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, from non-magical attacks.
    
    The colors become static and fade, and they all return through the portal. The portal disappears. (Song: [The Tragedy of the Underdark](wiki:))
    
    After research, apparently I can now cast telepathy at will for the coming 5 days.
    
    We go on towards the Ultros. King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) gave us the map to the last known location: rocky eastland the Deathlands. It was captained by Estor Arklander.
    
    -   We saw his tomb in Telamok.
    -   Oathsworn of Kyrah.
    -   Carvings depict a man slaughtering unarmed dryads and satyrs. They were clearly afraid. His dragon companion begged him for their forgiveness.
    -   Estor and the first war: Telamok and Estor were the most ruthless. Telamok was the elder of the two. He swore his protection to all who swore their allegiance to him. He intended to utterly dominate the original creatures from [Thylea](wiki:thylea). He found the place that became [Mytros](wiki:mytros). War was his tool, to secure the future. Estor cared little for this, no desire to rule. He just wanted battle. War was the only way he could satisfy his cruelty. Telamok expanded into the Gygan territory, sending Estor in to subdue them. Estor instead subdued, then slaughtered all of them after their surrender. Afterwards, he pushed his soldiers on to the towns where the defenseless Gygan non-warriors lived, and slaughtered all of them. Only a few Gygans escaped. After this, his dragon abandoned him. Lutheria afterwards realized how dangerous the newcomeres were, and she unleashed [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) from his vow, starting a the first war between the newcomers and the Fae.
    
    Soon, we encounter a Gygan that seems to not want to fight. We try to pass it; [Brax](wiki:brax) does smell more Gygans further away from the road. Likely around 3 of them. We pass by them safely.
    
    We set camp at a clearing. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) and Brax set out to collect some pelts, Atyche practices with her bird.
    
    We contact [Vallus](wiki:vallus) to see if she knows about Kyrah. She does not, but she does not think we should worry.
    
    Around evening, we arrive at the sour vintage inn. Apparently, they now advertise as being the place where _we_ first met. This appears to have been Kyrah's doing - who we find at the inn!
    
    We see Javon near a statue of Taneias. Brax gives him some gold for Taneias' family. Atyche charms him to get him off our backs. **He tells us that the Ultros has been spotted in a canal somewhere in the area.** He points us to the people who told him. Those people say that they saw the Ultros, but no people on it. It was going further land inwards. They saw it around midnight. Op de rivier 'de Lethe'. 1 day's travel northward.
    
    Somewhere during the night, I'm approached by someone and given a bag with 2 Knucklebone Dice, having a skull where there'd normally be a 6.
    
    ### Weekend sunday
    
    We continue towards dead falls. The map leads us to a secret inlet near the dead falls, but we go northwards and walk by the river instead.
    
    We come upon a clearing with Zephyrus, the satyr of the summer wind. He's holding the Zephyre Lute. He starts to tell us a story.
    
    -   This is a hidden shrine to the god Helios, and Zephyrus is its protector.
    -   We start a fight to get the lute. Atyche flies in, invisible, and grabs the lute from his hands.
    
    Zephyrus tells us, after we caught him, that if we believe in the gods so much, we should navigate to the constellation 'The Chariot'.
    
    The magic that was cast on the clearing seems to slowly fade now that zephyrus no longer has the lyre.
    
    Brax finds a gold statuette of the god Helios, a man with long golden hair, and a sealed clay tube, hidden in the temple.
    
    We return to the river, and find the Rapids of the Lethe. We travel through the canyon towards the dead falls themselves. The cliff faces seem to have horrific faces, only visible when not looking at them. The cliffs start to smash together, and we narrowly escape. Atyche flies up and over to make it, BB is nearly crushed, Brax makes an herculean effort to keep the cliffs apart to give the rest of us more time.
    
    We're in a cave with the waterfall, which strangely doesn't make any sound. There's a small undewater tunnel that goes to a secret inlet! Brax digs through it. Thyphoon makes some harnesses from rope, and we follow him with some difficulty.
    
    We stumble upon the Ultros. It's an awesomely 3d printed ship. There are ethereal oarmen at the oars, and we hear faint whispering in what seems to be common. There are around 70 crewmen.
    
    There's an ethereal drummer at the back of the lower deck. She says "are you ready to travel to Mytros?"
    
    In the back, we also find a cabin with hammocks. They seem to be swaying in another rhythm than the ship is. One even seems to be sagging; we do not see anyone in it, however. There's also an ornate box in this room, which is locked. Lastly, there's a ladder going further down, where there's even more empty boxes and crates.
    
    The captains room, at the front, seems to be pristine and clean. There's a journal on a desk.
    
    -   Continues from the story of estor and the first war. Telamok became ruler of Mytros, Estor destroys all gygans.
    -   The curse of estor Arklander.
    -   His dragon abandoned him, but he still continued his rampage on his magical ship.
    -   Sydon attempted to smash it with waves but could not.
    -   Next, lutheria tried. She would give him and his crew eternal life if he would stop his rampage. He slit the throats of his officers as a blood sacrifice to Lutheria. They had sex. When lutheria left the next morning, his crew rose to their feet again, and he knew they were immortal. However, wounds would still damage them, and they could still feel pain. They attempted to break the curse after centuries, but failed. Though their bodies rotted away, their spirits remained to crew the Ultros.
    -   We dispel the lock on the box. We find 16 onyx gemstones. They emit magic. When removed from the box, a specter spawns. Roll for initiative!

notes.title: Session 41

fields.summary: We defeat the ghosts of the treacherous crew and sail into Mytros, where Acustus dismisses the ship as a relic.

notes.body:
**Last time**

-   Party in the sour vintage inn
-   Battle against Zephyr of the summer wind
-   Travel to the ravine to find the Ultros.
-   We fought against a Specter

**This week**

The storage area has empty crates, barrels, etc.

We talk to the ghostly drummer lady. She misses her eyes.

We tell her we want to travel to [Mytros](wiki:mytros).

It starts to row, traveling underwater to go out of the cave. We end up in the middle of the cerulean gulf, and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) expects us to arrive in the middle of the day.

We dream. We're under a strange sky, standing on the top of the ship. Long, gray dreadlock-ed man (Estor) is at the front of the ship. He calls us.

He tells us that he expects to become immortal.

He is honoured to have fought as our captain. He chooses a successor. He points to all of us, and one of us can prove ourselves to become the captain.

He says that we have to swear an oath to the Ultros to have it obey our commands.

-   I swear upon my life's blood that I shall captain the Ultros with honour.
-   Even were she to sail into the maw of the nether sea, my fate shall be bound to hers.

He says that three of the crew have tried to (something bad, betray?). We need to find and destroy them to become the captain.

-   Davos the quartermaster
-   Metron the navigator
-   Skathon the first mate

We turn around, and see six specters, looking like shipmates. Someone is at the rudder. It's Davos, and we kill him.

Next we find Metron, the navigator, in the closest quarters downstairs. He seems to be on another plane, only projecting his image. We delete him from this plane once he arrives.

We find the last foe in the captain's quarters. He takes possession of [Brax](wiki:brax). We knock him out and kill Skathon's ghost.

We wake up on the ship. We see Estor on his throne, applauding us slowly but proudly. He recognises I have been the most valuable in combat, bestowing me with the title of 'captain', but only if I accept his powers. After a fierce discussion with Brax, I refuse the power. He leaves angrily, but we _can_ control the ship, it seems.

We enter through the gates of Mytros. Queen [Vallus](wiki:vallus) is waiting for us, but a silver dragon comes at us. King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) steps off of it, congratulating us on taking command of the Ultros, but saying it is a relic - we need dragons, not an ancient ship. The ghosts all disappear, including Estor.

**Level 6!**

notes.title: Session 42

fields.summary: We outfit and crew the Ultros, recruit Pythor, Kyrah, Versi and Loreas, and gather intel on the islands.

notes.body:
**Last session**

We found the Ultros and took control.

We arrived back in [Mytros](wiki:mytros), where King [Acustus](wiki:acustus) declared that the Ultros is a 'relic of bygone days'.

Apparently, we only have _2 months left_ until the oath of peace ends!

**This session**

Day 33. _The oath ends on day 93._

The Ultros gets 4 ballistae and 2 rowboats. Awesome statblocks!

We get 4 goats and 2 white cows as sacrifices. A quiver of +1 arrows, 6 potions of healing, 4 potions of climbing, 4 potions of resistance.

We need at least 50 oarsman to move at its normal pace.

We go to [Vallus](wiki:vallus).

She tells us a lot - but one of the things is that, in the gardens of Helios, [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) will find something to continue his epic path. 'Instant fortress'?

She has also summoned her fellow 'gods' to join us.

-   [Pythor](wiki:pythor), god of battle. He has given his throne to Enora, his daughter.
-   [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah), goddes of music.

**Pythor joined your party!**

**2 Amazonians joined your party!** (The ones that helped us after the cult of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan))

An ornate bronze chest with a heavy lock is given by Vallus to Kyrah, who holds it _very_ tightly.

Before we can leave the palace, we bump into [Versi](wiki:versi). She also offers her help.

She gets a vision!

-   She sees dragon eggs, spread around the continents and islands.
-   They can be found by the right people.
-   There is one at the constellation 'the prisoner'.

**Versi joined your party!**

A bit later, just outside the palace, we find someone with a white chrysanthemum, who walks towards Thyphoon. It's Loreas, the satyr we met at the Mossy Temple.

-   He has some goatlings accompanying him that seem well-learned by now.
-   He goes down on his knees. (Eehmm....)
-   He is willing to give an oath of protection. (Aaaah...)
-   Thyphoon does not want the oath to be sworn, but it still happens.

**Loreas joined your party!**

500gp to craft the mithril half plate. So in 3-4 days, he could craft the half plate.

A mithril bar would cost 1000gp (at grymmicks armory)

I buy a simple piece of breastplate (medium armor)

We go around the pubs to recruit people and send them to [Brax](wiki:brax) and Thyphoon. We send [Atyche](wiki:atyche) in invisibly to the Satyr's Tail as well.

Brax and Thyphoon vet the people coming in, until we have a full crew.

**The outfit of the Ultros v2.0**

Crew:

-   The bardians (4)
-   [Bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi)
-   Kyrah
-   Pythor
-   Versi
-   Loreas
-   2 Amazons
-   Volon
-   65 sailors.

Weapons: 4 ballistae

**Islands**

-   'The Bear': Mainland [Thylea](wiki:thylea)
-   'The Gygan': island of Yonder [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder)
    -   Part of Antikythera is here.
    -   **[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) wants to go here for our friend of the cult. ([Gaius](wiki:gaius))**
-   'The Prisoner': [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)
    -   Active volcano.
    -   The 'lizard folk' live here. They make great weapons. (There's several tribes that are warring with each other)
    -   **Versi sees a dragon egg there for me!**
-   'The Heart': goes to the island 'the golden heart'.
    -   Where 'the heart of Thylea' is.
-   'The Trickster': [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island)
    -   There's a highly aggressive Chymera on this island. King Acustus has set a bounty on its head of 1000 gold pieces.
-   'The Bard': [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates)
    -   **Atyche wants to go here.**
-   'The warrior': The island of the exiles
    -   Australia mate!
    -   Sent here if you make a big boo-boo
-   'The Centaur': [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
    -   **Brax wants to go to.**
-   'The Queen': Indigo Island
    -   A large collection of barbarian warriors.
    -   A place of travel for barbarians to learn new things.
    -   The birthplace of all barbarians in Thylea.
    -   Indigo Tribes: there are multiple. Shipwrecked on the Thylea thousands of years ago, helped by the natives, and sailed to and sailed to indigo island. They fought on the side of the natives in the first war.
    -   They like fish.
-   'The Twins': The island of [Themis](wiki:themis):
    -   Home of [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons).
    -   'Calimero?'
-   'The ant': Titan's Folley.
    -   3 perfectly molded green hills.
    -   Encompassed by a giant glass dome.
    -   Can be bypassed by teleportation magic.
    -   _Must be avoided at all cost._
    -   Rumored to be the home of Thylea's greatest treasure.
    -   Sealed away by [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan) as a result of the first war of the gods (so not the war of the dragonlords)
    -   Known by all fishermen, for the legend says that it is the home of Thylea’s greatest treasure.
-   'Titan': probably [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan)?
-   'The dreamer': [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis)
    -   probably Lutheria?
-   'The Centaur': [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
    -   Something something monk/cleric.
-   'The Chariot': [Garden of Helios](wiki:gardens-of-helios) .
    -   Thyphoon wants to go here. Dragon egg?
-   ‘The End’: [Titan’s Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley)
-   ‘???’: the Island of the Oathbreakers
    -   Daar is iemand van Thyphoon z’n backstory.
-   ‘The Spear’: [Typhon](wiki:typhon)

**On Sailing**

-   If we sacrifice a goat, we will have a safer travel.
-   If we sacrifice enough to Sydon, we can travel faster. (100gp of livestock for -1 days for the strong, favorable winds)
    -   Can likely be improved with 'control weather' as well without an offering.

**Oproep voor zeelui**
