Oproep aan alle zeilers, dekschrobbers of krijgers met zeebenen met een voorliefde voor avontuur of het voortbestaan van intelligent leven op Thylea! De Bardians of Thylea zijn vandaag aangemeerd in de haven van Mytros, met het legendarische schip de Ultros! Gooi je ale achterover en haast je naar de Ultros - je zult wel herkennen waar je moet zijn aan het grote aantal legendarische figuren! - en meld je vandaag nog aan! _We need you!_

notes.title: Session 43

fields.summary: After a feast-oracle we sail off with Aesop's letter about captured dragons, reach Scorpion Island and climb the Lotus Witch's obelisk.

notes.body:
**Vorige sessie**

-   Aangekomen in [Mytros](wiki:mytros)
-   Een party verzameld
-   Een lading info gekregen over eilanden (in de Global Information Sync)

**And now...**

-   Nog 2 maanden voor de Oath of Peace afloopt
-   We moeten nog een tandwiel fixen voor de Antykithera, tot die tijd kunnen we niet naar alles hoger dan 10 genummerd (nether sea, forgotten sea)
-   Gaan eerst naar het [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates)(?)
-   Een soort van ‘magische zee’ - eilanden verplaatsen en de stromingen zijn fucky

Waar gaan we eerst heen?

-   Scorpion Island

We gaan eerst naar de gardens.

-   8 GP voor een feestmaal
-   “Op welk van de eilanden van [Thylea](wiki:thylea) zijn er een of meerdere drakeneieren te vinden?”
    -   Langverloren drakeneieren worden gevonden door het **lot**, door **vuur en vlam**, en op **grote hoogtes**, zullen deze gevonden worden.
        -   [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)
        -   Isle of the Fates
        -   Tower of Praxis - The tower of Seidon
-   [Brax](wiki:brax): “Wat kan ik het beste doen om te zorgen dat we dit overleven als Bardians zijnde - het hele ordeal met de gods?”
    -   Follow the path
    -   Trust in each other

We gaan terug naar de docks, en het valt ons op dat ook in de straten een aantal standbeelden van soldaten van [Acustus](wiki:acustus) zijn bijgeplaatst.

We sail away, being saluted by the roaring cheers of the collected crowd!

I climb in the mast and sing a song to control the weather in a positive way

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) sees a black dot on the horizon...

-   It comes flying to us. Probably from somewhere between Mytros and the sour vintage inn.
-   We hear some singing coming towards us once it gets closer...
-   She throws a letter
    -   Hail to the oracle’s chosen ones.
    -   As the keeper of the dragons shrine, I have a favor to ask of you. Many believe that all the dragons of [balmytria](wiki:balmytria)’s brood were killed alongside her in the first war, five hundred years ago. However, my research indicates that the other four dragons may have been captured by the titans. If this is true, then they must be found and rescued.
    -   I beg you to be watchful on your journey. As the Oracle’s chosen few, I believe that these dragons would rescue you, so long as you hold to the ideals of their former masters. May the fates guide you,
    -   Aesop, keeper of the dragon shrine.

[Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) asks us if we even know what the constellation of the centaur stands for.

-   These two groups of stars are sometimes called the “centaur and the scorpion”. A centaur came across a scorpion in the mud. It begged for help, but the centaur trotted away out of fear. A branch fell in the puddle and helped the scorpion escape, after which the scorpion went after the centaur. It stung it in the throat, which then accidentally killed the scorpion.
    -   If the scorpion had not sought revenge, or if the centaur had helped, they both would have lived.

We sleep...

We arrive at [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island).

The next day, we find an island edged by sandy beaches and calm waters. Mostly flat, grasslands cover the island, along with some shrubs.

There is one structure - an ominous, black, stone tower. _Scorpion Island._ We think.

After just a single day?

[Versi](wiki:versi), [Pythor](wiki:pythor) and Kyrah stay on board.

Bulbug follows us.

At the island, we are greeted by two Aresian warriors, clothed in red. _Aresian Monks._

They tell us that any centaur that fails to bond to a (sentient) creature turns into a mindless scorpion. We see it as our duty to kill these mindless beasts. It’s a curse by the _lotus witch_.

There are no pink lotuses here, but there’s a giant field of yellow flowers.

It rarely if ever storms here.

There are roaming groups of centaurs. They do not build structures.

The obelisk we see is in the north part, the scorpions in the south part. There’s also a field of yellow flowers there.

The warriors have 2 more days to finish their task.

We go towards the obelisk.

Bob spots something coming from our north. It’s a drunken centaur, called Pholon .

Brax fights him as a welcome, and wins handily.

He tells us that the obelisk is the home of the Lotus Witch .

He made a bond with someone shipwrecked on the island. He bonded with Alysia. She fell ill later, dying 2 weeks ago. That means he is no longer bonded and safe from the curse... Which is why he returned here.

The wine he drinks heals him. The flowers growing here, dried and crushed, have a healing (and addictive) effect.

Brax agrees to “marry” him tomorrow evening if we do not manage to break the curse.

We arrive at the obelisk, and don’t immediately see a way to enter it.

The obelisk is around 200 feet tall. The field of flowers itself is 200 feet in diameter around the obelisk.

When we step into the field of flowers, the time seems to speed up extremely... And a doorway appears.

We get sucked into the doorway. Behind us, it looks like a bookcase - a very solid one at that.

There are a load of toddlers, babies and other young kids.

The oldest - Leander - comes to us. He seems about 5 years old.

He tells us they all came into the gateway and failed the riddles of the lotus witch, causing them to be cursed.

We walk up the spiral staircase in the middle.

Behind the first window, we see a flowing green landscape with elfish characters going to a stonehenge-like structure for a ritual. I recognize it from the mainland, where there’s a legend about another plane - one called ‘_Elysium_’ - which represented pure good. It smells like milk and honey.

Behind the second window, we see a sort of misty cavern, with fiery walls. A chain of manacled prisoners is being taken to help clear out the cavern. “_The planes of tartarus_”. (chaotic, neutral and lawful evil)

Behind the third window, we see the _astral plane_. Clouds, sunrays, flying humanoids that are debating with each other. (lawful alignments)

The fourth window shows us another cavern, but this one has a flowing sea of mist or milklike fluid. Skulls are bobbing up and down in the river, and a small boat waits at its banks. (River Styx) Thousands of insectoid creatures walk along the river to torture their victims. (_Hades_)

At the fifth window, we see a gigantic battle with thousands of humanoids. They look like more boring versions of Thylean centurions. A huge statue on wheels of a horse is being pushed to the city.

The sixth window: we see the ultros in a bay, a black obelisk on that island. It’s the only window that has glass in front of it. We see it from very high up, like a bird flying miles high.

The final, seventh window, shows giant buildings around a crossroads. It’s a bizarre building style - made from metal, gray stone and a lot of glass. A race of helmeted people march through the city. There are flying, scooter-like vehicles that they fly on.

We arrive at the top of the tower.

The walls are covered with hieroglyphics, as if carved with ancient tools. And there’s a sphinx.

She has answers for us... But first, we have to answer her questions about the history of Thylea.

No rhyme or riddles though!

Questions:

-   Who was the first of the dragonlords?
    -   [Xander Huorath](wiki:xander-huorath), hopefully
-   What was the name of Xander’s dragon?
    -   Balmytria?
-   Which two titans sprang from the same seed?
-   Who was the cruelest of the dragonlords?
    -   Estor Arklander

And we can ask our questions!

Brax:

-   Why am I here?
    -   One of your forefathers was cursed by something he caused. She can’t tell exactly what the curse entails, but she can point him towards the place where the curse started. The island [Typhon](wiki:typhon).
    -   He is also given a belt of fire-giant strength. Which he apparently needs to survive a dive in a volcanic heart, to free himself of his curse. On Typhon!

Thyphoon:

-   Wat vindt ik bij het constellation The Chariot?
    -   Het eiland [Gardens of Helios](wiki:gardens-of-helios).
    -   De zonnegod houdt zich hier schuil, al wordt er al jarenlang gedacht dat deze dood is. Hij wordt niet meer aanbeden, waardoor hij een groot deel van zijn krachten verloren is. Maar er zijn nog wat afgezanten op Thylea die hem aanbidden.

[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas):

-   Hoe komen Acustus en zijn metgezellen aan ogenschijnlijk eeuwenoude draken die loyaal aan hen zijn?
    -   Die zijn geschonken door [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) aan zijn trouwe aanhangers. Hoe de draken zo snel volgroeid zijn, hoewel ze nog mentaal jong zijn: de enige wezens die daar iets mee te maken kunnen hebben zijn “wezens die letterlijk het lot kunnen veranderen” - [The Fates](wiki:the-fates).

Bulbug:

-   Wat is er gebeurd bij het afsluiten van de Oath of Peace?
    -   De oath verbied mij om bepaalde details te vertellen. Maar ik kan wel dit vertellen:
    -   With the arrival of [the five](wiki:the-five) gods, the titans faced an existential threat. They were badly weakened by the first war, and much of divine power sapped away. Joined by five gods’ power, armies nigh unstoppable. Dragonlords made final voyage, great battles fought over land and water. Eventually centaur armies broken and gygans eliminated. Sydon and [lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) had little left to fight with, but were still gods. Lutheria took control of the nether sea and captured the souls there to recuperate her strength. Sydon took control of the seas. In this way, they forced a stalemate, in the hopes they might recover. While the titans consolidated, they stroke a revenge blow. They slaughtered most of the dragonlords, including Estor, captain of Ultros. This is largely unaccounted. Both sides were threatened with annihilation. Tired, both met beneath the tree, and made a bloody handshake, agreeing to a truce for 500 years. Mytros, goddess of dawn, sealed this oath with most of her power. [Damon](wiki:damon) saw this done, and carried the scrolls with oaths and bodies of fallen dragonlords back to the cities.

notes.title: Session 44

fields.summary: We fail to save the cursed children, 'wed' Brax to Pholon, and at the Island of the Fates Atyche learns her doom.

notes.body:
**Vorige sessie**

-   We hebben de Ultros gepakt naar eiland 1: Scorpion Island.
    -   Onderweg nog een brief gekregen van Aesop dat er nog 4 draken zijn gevangen door de Titan
    -   I calmed the waves with my ‘magic instrument’
-   Roeiboot naar het eiland gepakt
    -   Aresian priests tegen gekomen die ons vertelden dat we niet mochten bemoeien met de Aresian Monks die proberen scorpions (cursed centaurs) te slopen. Ze moeten voor zonsondergang terug zijn en een scorpion gekilld hebben.
    -   We zijn afgereisd naar de Obelisk op het eiland.
    -   Onderweg een centaur (Pholon) tegen gekomen die terug is gekeerd naar het eiland omdat z’n mate overleden is, en hij nu alsnog verandert in een scorpion.
-   We arriveren bij de obelisk
    -   De tijd begint razendsnel te veranderen zodra we in het veld gele bloemen rond de obelisk stappen.
    -   We vinden een magic door de obelisk in.
    -   Binnen vinden we kleine kinderen die werken om drugs te maken van de gedroogde gele bloemen. Leander waarschuwde ons ertegen om binnen te komen (te laat!)
    -   We klimmen de toren op en zien allerlei andere dimensies/plaatsen/tijden.
    -   We vinden de Lotus Witch, een Sphinx.

**En nu...**

Dag 34

Nog steeds op [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)

We staan nog voor de Lotus Witch...

[Atyche](wiki:atyche) haar vraag:

-   Waar op [Thylea](wiki:thylea) zouden we nog een machtige ally kunnen vinden die zich bij onze groep zou kunnen aansluiten?
    -   DM: de Lotus Witch is heel erg gefocust op geschiedenis, dus of ze behulpzaam gaat zijn... _Julia overtuigt Michel dat dit best kan_
    -   Op [fire island](wiki:fire-island), in het hart van een vulkaan, schijnt een blacksmith te zitten die door [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) zelf is opgeleid. Het gerucht gaat dat hij neutraal staat naar het hele gebeuren vat de oath of peace betreft, maar ik weet niet of hi jonz emetgezel zou kunnen worden. Het is wel iemand di eheel krachtig is. [Steros the Jancan](wiki:steros-the-jancan)

Dat waren al onze vragen.

Op zoek naar een uitweg...

-   De kamer is rond. Achter de Sphinx is een groot raam. Er staan wat bookcases en een slaapvertrek.
-   Het window heeft geen glas, groot genoeg om de Sphinx naar buiten te laten vliegen.
-   De sphinx zegt dat de uitweg door het raam heen is.
-   We springen uit het raam met feather fall - maar staan instant op de grond.

En realiseren ons buiten dat we de kinderen hadden willen helpen.

-   We gaan proberen of we iets door de deur heen kunnen gooien zonder zelf weer het bloemenveld in te lopen.
-   ... We failed and run from our responsibilities.

We walk back to the ship.

Onderweg zien we allemaal kleine vogeltjes die zich centreren rond de plaats waar Atyche heen wijst - ze duiken achter een boom en komen daar niet meer weg.

-   We horen gefluister achter de bomen...
-   Er komt een vrouwelijke centaur achter weg, die belaagd wordt door vogeltjes.
-   Ze is jong, net iets voor de puberteit.
-   Ze stap schaapachtig achter de boom vandaan.
-   Blijkbaar was ze op zoek naar Pholon.
-   Haar naam is Nessa, the Centaur.
-   We nodigen haar uit om mee te gaan naar het schip om de bro-dding te zien.

We bereiden uitgebreid de wedding voor. Atyche haalt [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) op, en vertelt tegen Loreas the Satyr dat hij opgehaald gaat worden door [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) voor “de bruiloft”.

-   We hebben tot nu toe officieel meer tijd besteed aan de bro-dding dan we hebben besteed om de kinderen in de obelisk te redden.
-   Hij overtuigt Loreas, die nu _erg_ sip is, mee te gaan om Nessa te ontmoeten.

“Hipple happle, we need a chapel!”

-   They are wed
    
-   (Prepared for the Bro-dding:
    
    “The Broath” ([Brax](wiki:brax) and Pholon)

Nessa en Loreas worden geintroduceerd.

**End of the island.**

We besluiten om naar [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) te gaan.

We slachten nog een bull.

**Dag 35**

Ik krijg hoofdpijn tijdens mijn shift.

Na mijn shift beginnen er dolfijnen langs de boot mee te zwemmen, samen met wat whales - met een squid/babykraken in de bek.

Na een dag koppijn die steeds erger wordt (het was de aflopende telepathy buff), en een poging om met Milk of the Poppy het probleem op te lossen (na een powernap), cast Thyphoon “Dispel Magic” en lost het probleem op!

We arrive at the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates).

Steep cliffs all around, except for a small bay where we might be able to get ashore.

We see little worth of vegetation. Small pools everywhere with frogs and the like. The island is dominated by a large rock formation, where we see a number of cave entrances.

There’s also some ruins of a great tower at the south cliff, visible from where we near the bay.

<we eten lekker grieks tussendoor en gaan na het eten nog even verder>

**Day 36**

We willen als eerst naar een toren.

Thyphoon parkeert de boot achteruit in. We zijn enkele planken kwijt.

Het is onmeunig rotweer, maar we beklimmen een trap in de rotsen om naar boven te komen.

_This crumbling tower is built to a large proportion. Must have been built by giants. The skeletal remains of the former inhabitants are scattered around the plans. All skeletons, besides their giant size, have skulls with a single central eye socket and six arms._

The ruins are several hundred years old. Atyche finds several (6-7) scroll cases in the ruins. Nothing seems magical around the place.

The first case is opened and read.

-   This used to be the homebase of Gygans. That changed around the first war, where you see images of people on dragons who spread death and despair on the mainland. They bully the Thylean people away. This island was their (Gygan’s) last stronghold. A giant ship arrived, carrying a mad captain. _The scroll ends in a spattering of blood._

We look at the pond in the center of the island.

-   It’s a large pit with a small, fetid pond in the center. There is one large tunnel with 3 smaller entrances around it.
-   We see a large, shadowy figure with glowing eyes (2) looking at us from the largest cave.
-   We wave at it. Out comes a half-amazon-woman, half-snake, slithering out into the rain. She’s unarmed. Her name was Agave.
-   She welcomes us to the [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates) .
-   We follow her into the tunnel.
-   The tunnel is damp.
-   The tunnel slants downwards.

The tunnel is filled with egg sacs containing wormlike creatures, the size of a dog. The faces look humanoid. The egg sacs are glowing. Note: they do not look like Agave.

Eventually, we enter a large cave smelling of rotten eggs. In the center is a yellow pool of ichor, with small humanlike things swimming in them. They look like smaller versions of what was in the egg sacs. Filthy linen rags are lying everywhere in the cave. They seem like things that have been woven by [the Fates](wiki:the-fates).

In the corner are three hideous women, weaving on a loom made of dragon bones.

They seem to currently be weaving us arriving in [Mytros](wiki:mytros) with the Ultros, sailing out to Scorpion Island.

The women have stopped weaving and turn to us.

-   One introduces her as Granny Morta of the Fates. She introduces the others as Nonna of the Fates and Decema of the Fates. The latter two look increasingly more normal compared to Granny, who looks positively hideous and ragged. Where Granny acts like a witch, Decema reacts more bashfully, almost flirtingly.
-   As she starts speaking, she snips one of the threads on a loom. She regularly does this during the conversation.

Atyche talks to Granny to figure out why she’s doomed.

-   They say that everything that happens on Thylea is in their grasp. But a question will cost.
-   It will cost her... Her speed, endurance or mental resilience. They’re gracious enough to even let her choose...
-   Atyche picks her endurance.
-   They seal the deal with a bloody handshake.

_So you want to know what’s going on with your doom. What really happened on that terrible day, where your parents died. To know that, we will go back further. We start with a scene between Sydon and [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan). After centuries of love, a giant fight broke out between the titans, after a game of “the royal game”, or Twenty Squares. Lutheria had to watch from the sidelines how the arrogance of her beloved cost him game after game. Suddenly, we see the loom having a sudden stitch in it - timejump! (Apparently, this was around the Oath of Peace?) After this game she was seething, turned her back on her brother. Started getting interest in the races and folks of Lutheria, jumped from dream to dream. When she found sea nymphs she got a plan. She’d make Sydon jealous by spending a night with a ..., a far descendant (Nerites ) of Sydon. He was caring. After influencing his dreams for months, she offered sex. Thanks to his own godly descent, he was able to refuse - which Lutheria could not stand. She chose to transform him into an Oyster and give him back to the sea, so Sydon would always have a lover of Lutheria in his domain, without knowing it. That way, he could also never tell anyone what happened. After this embarrassing adventure, she restored her bond with Sydon, who was unaware. In the meantime, Nerites dwelled in the sea, unaware of time. He got glimpses of what happened around him, but saw and heard nothing. This lasted for dozens of years. After a hurricane of Sydon, he was stranded, and found by Medea who was collecting ingredients for potions. She found a weird pearl inside the oyster, which gave her a weird feeling. She decided to cast “Detect Magic” and found that the oyster gave off magic. Using her knowledge of potions and magic, she managed to dispel the magic, and restored the oyster to a wonderfully beautiful man - love at first sight. Immensely happy together, their perfect other halves, Medea was getting worried. Meritus started to get dreams, nightmares, until someone knocked at the door. Someone in the village came because they got a message from Lutheria, and they’re now collecting a sacrifice by going door-to-door to prevent the entire village from dying. The sacrifice that is demanded is that the firstborn child of every family will have to be sacrificed to Lutheria in half a year. Instead, they plan to flee instead of making the sacrifice. Somewhere in a while, Nerites wakes up with a scream in his ears from Lutheria, while Medea’s waters break - and Atyche is born. Early. Under a bad constellation. Lutheria decides to come collect the sacrifice instead of waiting for it to happen - but instead of doing what she asked, she murders everyone except the firstborns. In the blood of her parents, Atyche is placed on the ground, and she gets three marks of blood on her forehead - one with each of their blood (father, mother and herself), signifying the three times she will die to repent for her parent’s sins. Until then, she can not die._

Which means: she has one free death (until going down, not until failing the saving throws) remaining. After that, the death is for real.

Followers of Lutheria will explicitly attempt to kill Atyche. Only when Lutheria is the one killing her, the curse will be lifted.

Atyche can pull the artifact of her choosing from the loom of the Fates. She gets the Robe of the Archmagi.

Apparently the Fates were the ones to seal the Oath of Peace.

_**The consequence: disadvantage on constitution based checks and saves.**_

notes.title: Session 45

fields.summary: We bargain with the Fates for lore, artifacts and a dragon egg, then set sail through Sydon's storm.

notes.body:
11 juni 2022

**Last Time (Q44)**

-   We certainly did not save the children at the witch
-   We met Nessa, a friend of Veulon
-   We broathed [Brax](wiki:brax)
-   _Day 36_
-   We arrived at [the Fates](wiki:the-fates)

**Today**

We stand in front of the Fates…

Brax kiest voor “zn applause” om z’n rage te kunnen delen met ons.

-   We krijgen “bolstering presence”.

[Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) wil graag meer info over eilanden…

-   Wat het inhoudt, welke schatten… Waar de schatten liggen en wie er zijn.
-   Low info: (1,3,5) m’n memory opgeven, m’n manhood of m’n geluk.
-   Gedetailleerde info: (1, 4, 11) m’n sight, m’n hope of m’n monetary value.

Ik kies voor monetary value.

-   800 platinum schuldig
-   379 afbetaald, brax legt er ook 1 bij.

We kiezen: [Titan’s Folley](wiki:titan-s-folley) , [Garden of Helios](wiki:gardens-of-helios) , [Island of Yonder](wiki:island-of-yonder) en [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island) .

-   Island of Yonder:
    -   Ooit een ancient capital van de Gygan empire. Ze waren hier al honderden jaren (duizenden?) voor de dragonlords. De meesten zijn uitgewipet tijdens de first war.
-   Ik krijg ook gratis [Charybdis](wiki:charybdis) er bij.

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) pakt een stuk papier, dat hij van lijk van Heleka geloot heb - de sea hag die [Versi](wiki:versi) gevangen en gemarteld had.

-   _I bid you now make good upon the oath of service that you once swore me. You know the secret ways through the forgotten sea, to the cave where my daughter dwells. Find her, and bring her to Praxis, unharmed, and I will release you from your oath. [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan), lord of all._

Thyphoon vraagt naar info over z’n backstory.

-   4, 5, 6 (z’n strength, luck of body).
-   Hij kiest… Z’n luck.
-   Mij komt het gevoel bekend voor van telepathie dat Thyphoon krijgt.
-   Z’n contact vraagt meteen om z’n hulp, heeft direct door dat het Thyphoon is. Zit gevangen op het “Eiland van de Oathbreakers”. Sea hags gaan een oath of fellowship aan met Sydon. De mijne was het leveren van nymfen aan Sydon. Dat ging goed tot jij kwam, ik wou je niet offeren.
    -   Als je een oath breekt wordt je gehaald door de [Erinyes](wiki:erinyes). Je krijgt “The Curse of the Treacherous” - afflicts those that break powerful oaths or who neglect guests(?). Arenes worden gedispatched vanaf hun locatie op de Tower of Praxis. Je kunt niet van ze ontsnappen. Zodra ze je beet hebben Plainshiften ze naar het eiland van de oathbreakers.

Dus… Waar gaan we als volgende heen?

-   The prisoner - fire island: ei voor Yendithas

<We bbq’en>

We realiseren ons dat we nog een drakenei te vinden hebben hier. Thyphoon cast “Find Object” en vindt het drakenei ergens achter de Fates.

Blijkbaar is het een ei die voor Sydon wordt getraind…

We zouden in een paar dagen het ei groot kunnen krijgen. Dat kost:

-   In een paar dagen: een minor price.
-   In een paar dagen, maar dan _echt_ volwassen: nog steeds een minor price…?

Brax betaalt 1 memory (disadvantage op history, arcana, etc.)

-   We worden gevraagd om draken te corrupten met onze krachten en die zo snel mogelijk strijdbaar te maken in de oorlog die gaat komen. Mentale capacities spelen geen rol, alleen loyaal zijn en “mechanisch” werken.

We lopen terug naar de Ultros. Op de terugweg naar de Ultros verandert de Find Object opeens naar de Ultros. Blijkbaar heeft [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) hem in het kistje…

We moesten er zelf achter komen.

[Vallus](wiki:vallus) heeft dit ei gered van [Acustus](wiki:acustus). Dit ei was aan hem gegeven door Sydon, een van z’n laatsten.

We set sail to Fire Island.

-   Chalcya, the godess of swiftness, alone escaped when sydon and [lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) destroyed their other brothers and sisters. She escaped to an island of fire, pursued by Sydon, and hid deep in the island. But they did not leave her alone there, instead trapping her in the island.

Thyphoon bedekt z’n ei in zo veel mogelijk ijs en gaat ermee in de hold van het schip zitten. Ik vertel hem verhalen over jonge draken en kom bij hem zitten.

Ik neem de tweede shift aan het roer, Thyphoon de 3e, [Atyche](wiki:atyche) de 4e.

We are woken by Sydon shouting and making the weather absolutely horrible.

HEED MY WARNING MORTALS. YOUR QUEST IS DOOMED. YOUR WEAPONS WILL FAIL. YOUR GODS WILL PERISH AND YOUR SHIPS WHILL SHATTER UPON THE ROCKS. YOUR CITIES WILL DROWN AND YOUR NAMES FORGOTTEN. YOU SEEK TO CHALLENGE THE TITANS BUT THERE IS NO POWER THAT CAN STAND AGAINST THE LORD OF STORMS!

Thyphoon takes the rudder and fights to keep control. Brax helps the oarsmen. Atyche keeps the egg safe. I try to control the weather to improve the conditions.

**WE LEVEL UP**

We take new shifts to sleep, and start Day 37 at 12 in the morning.

notes.title: Session 46

fields.summary: We trade at the giant Island Turtle's market, meet the lizardfolk queen, and agree to attack the firewalker king.

notes.body:
**Last Session Q45**

-   We talked more with [The Fates](wiki:the-fates).
-   Most of us made a bargain with them. [Brax](wiki:brax) made two.
-   We found a [The fates](wiki:the-fates)

**This session**

Day 37

We krijgen de keuze uit een paar opties:

-   Niks doen, snel doorreizen
-   Een van 2 random sea encounters
    -   Op de docks hebben we gepraat met Sam, en hij vertelde ons over een “Island Turtle”.
    -   We hebben eerder een aantal dolfijnen zien zwemmen; Daar kunnen we meer over leren.
-   We go with the island turtle!

We awake fully rested.

On our way to Fire Island, we come upon a great swimming turtle, the size of a small island. We see Aresian Ships in a small harbor on the turtle. On the trading post, we see weird, jabba-the-hutt like people. [Shazum](wiki:shazum) along with some sea-nymf-like creatures are among them.

They tell us they travel various planes to trade. Some Aresians are already trading over there - around 12 aresian monks and a martial master captain.

We are offered some delicious drinks!

Inside, there’s a ton of weapons and armor. Apparently, _all_ common equipment from the PHB. Also a lot of potions - clairvoyance, gaseous form, healing, longevity, water breathing…

-   25gp for a normal healing
-   100gp for a greater healing

We see more smaller turtles around us! “Normal-sized” giant turtles. On one of these is a small hut.

I’m buying:

-   2 healing potions (2x25gp)
-   climber’s kit (25gp)
-   net (1gp)

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) bought a lot of weapons, mostly.

Brax also bought a lot of food and some more.

Brax and [Atyche](wiki:atyche) went to one of the turtles, with the hut on it. They went in and got out just in time.

Inside, they found a Trident of Fish Command!

The giant turtle left, and the baby turtles swam away again.

It’s now around 4 in the afternoon.

On Day 38 , we arrive at [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)

It’s surrounded by Coral Reefs. We know that the one simple passage through

We go to the island with Volon and [Bullbug](wiki:bullbug-sisi).

Brax smells a lizard coming towards us.

Several lizards arrive. We’ve apparently been prophesied to arrive here. They’re with the queen (Queen Vytha ). We follow them to their queen (we hope).

Chit, one of the lizardfolk, says they are a Shaman.

We end up telling them we will go to the firewalkers for them, to try and defeat the king.

On our sendoff, she kills one of her sons, and he is roasted and served up. Apparently, this is a great honor.

The firewalkers built their fortress on top of the caldera.

There is a main entrance that is well guarded.

There is also a back entrance that is well hidden, and might be gone.

They will guide us to the possible back entrance.

It is now approximately 2 in the afternoon. We will arrive after around 5 hours.

notes.title: Session 47

fields.summary: Through a secret back entrance we enter the caldera, find my dragon egg, and fight fire lizards.

notes.body:
De eerste sessie na _lang_

## Recap vorige sessies
We're trying to protect the oath of peace, which is running out.
We performed a number of great labors to prove ourselves as the heroes of the prophesy (killsteal cough)
We found the long forgotten ship The Ultros. I did not sell my soul.
We also found some things aboard the ship:
- 6 burnished dragon coins
- 75 silver pieces
- 35 gold pieces
- Small leatherbound journal
	- Gives a detailed account in Xander's role starting the first role 500 years ago
We used the Antikythera to navigate to a number of islands.
- We got information from [the fates](wiki:the-fates)
- We got broathed at [Scorpion Island](wiki:scorpion-island)
- We just arrived on [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)

## This session
*Starting at [OOTD Day](wiki:) 38.*

Chit brought us to the entrance of the volcano (secret back entrance).

Quick time travel back: [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) asked for poisons. The ... point him to the Calena Major.
On the way to the volcano, they find 30 doses of poison

Back to the entrance with Chit!
We wen through the tunnel to the Caldera.
When we get to the lava, [Brax](wiki:brax) transforms into a bull, and we continue on to the first cave mouth - where we see the dragon egg.

When entering the cave, we encounter fire lizards and salamanders guarding the eggs. *A couple of the eggs are broken open.*

[Polyphorus](wiki:advisor-polyphorus) voorbij de King's Chamber

notes.body:

- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon): this is not the same Oracle that he knows..? What is my task?

notes.title: Session 51

fields.summary: In the Cyclops Cave we meet the smith Steros, and I remember how I lost my dragon 500 years ago.

notes.body:
2023-07-29

**Last Session

- Minor loredump
- Senna weigerde te slapen
- Location: [Fire Island](wiki:fire-island)
- [Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan) destroyed the queen's chamber, along with it the queen and the statue of [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan).

**This session**

- We go to the sleeping chambers
- We find the 12 gemstones with a total worth of 120gp. Some are covered in blood.

- Natural twenty to slit the throat of one of the lizardfolk that's sleeping in the second sleeping chambers.
- The rest of the group turns on me and sends the lizardfolk away.
- I'm bound to the salamander cow that [Brax](wiki:brax) has semi-tamed and ride it from there on out.

We go to the Cyclops Cave, on the other side.
- We find [Steros the Jancan](wiki:steros-the-jancan), the smith, working on a mechanical goat at a table.
- He tells us that if we free his father, [Bront the Jancan](wiki:bront-the-jancan), he will move to a great forge to demonstrate his craft.
- Steros attempts to cast a magical effect on me with his lens, which [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) interrupts.

I'm asked about my past and what I know of how I lost my dragon...
- [How I lost my dragon](wiki:how-i-lost-my-dragon)
- I remember being in a battle with the brothers Telamok (Telamok Arklander), against the Fae Creatures, near the end of the first war
- Before I knew it, the wing of my dragon was ripped by a whole group of spears, and we dropped to the ground in a tailspin
- The last thing I remember is crashing on the earth, and everything going black... And the next thing I know is traveling away from Versi, back to [Thylea](wiki:thylea).
- Some things I remember in between: [Versi](wiki:versi) took care of me for 500 years. She has lived for millennia, and she enjoys life, even though she's turned against her father [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan). She's lived a lonely life... But during the battle of the dragonlords against the titans, she allied with the dragonlords, and served as a sort of "medic" during the battles. When she saw me lying on the field, she was instantly in love, and she did everything she could to save me. She had to put me in statis in her temple, to heal over the last 500 years. But when the prophesy came to her, she saw I had to step up.

We wake up on Days 39, at 12 in the afternoon.

I call [Vallus](wiki:vallus).
- I ask her about the Amazons.
- [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons)
- Vallus has a hard time to say how they feel about Bront and such.
- She gives a tip: [Atyche](wiki:atyche) should take the word, as they do not like men much. Also, go with as little people as possible.
- She does not expect her relations to her guard to worsen if we go there to try to do something...
- Asking her how things go in Mytros, with king Acustus:
	- Lately, there has been an increased threat from the underground cult, keeping [Acustus](wiki:acustus) busy.
	- However, she is still not happy about it, as they are still *her* people getting petrified...
	- We can send [Henake](wiki:henake) to the temple of [the five](wiki:the-five) as well, to have him be unpetrified.
- She does ask if we have seen [Gaius](wiki:gaius) recently. He has not been in [Mytros](wiki:mytros) recently, apparently.

[Queen Vita](wiki:queen-vita) is very happy that we've defeated [King Jamkor](wiki:king-jamkor).

We return to the boat, and see that 5 miles out of the island, there's still a heavy storm.
I decide to go down and talk to [Estor Arklander](wiki:estor-arklander), former captain of the Ultros.

If we navigate the constellation of the Bear (Mainland Thylea), and we concentrate on a specific spot on that island, we will arrive there.

notes.title: Session 52

fields.summary: Beneath the storm we are taken to Khronos, who sends us back in time for the magic items we sacrifice.

notes.body:
2023-09-22

**Last Session

-   What did we do...

**This session**

*We talk way too much about work before we get started*

The Ultros sails straight towards the storm...

And with the help of [Kentimane](wiki:kentimane-titan), we dive down into the waves.

Down under the sea, we see a Merfolk city!

Note to use: **we should ask [Vallus](wiki:vallus) about this**

At some point, everything turns _extremely_ pitch black and we see nothing... Until we see an aurora (borealis). We haven't drifted from our course!

Scratch that - we've been teleported to another dimension. ***Fuck***.

We've all lost our magic...

We end up on a giant rock island with a huge throne. As we ascend the stairs (690 of them) to the throne, a giant humanoid figure appears. It holds a staff with a giant hourlgass on the end. It's [Khronos](wiki:khronos).
"When you entered my realm, you've seen vision of things that can happen, could have happened, or will happen. I've been waiting for your arrival for a long time now - and I have to provide you with an annoying choice: I have seen _a ton_ of variations of your adventures - and it's extremely important for the fate of [Thylea](wiki:thylea) that your adventures be succesful."
Hij biedt aan om... Ons met z'n allen, Ultros and all, terug te sturen in de tijd? De oath of peace eindigt op de ochtend van de 60e dag van "ons avontuur".
Hoe ver hij ons terug kan sturen, ligt er aan hoe veel magic items wij betalen die hij omzet in "the sands of time".
Rules on time travel:
- We can NEVER see ourselves in another timeline.

Worth of items:
- 1 day for uncommon items
- 3 days for rare items
- 8 days for "very rare" items
- 10 days for "legendary" items
Every next visit, the worth will be halved.

So we sacrifice...
- 3 charms of vitality (24 days total)
- 10 arrow +1's (10 days total)
- Potion of heroism (3 days)
- Bow of cupidity (1 day)
- Deck of many things (8 days)
For a grand total of... 46 days!

We arrive back at day (-5), at 07:00, at... Somewhere? (Song: Travelling back in time)

notes.body:
2023-11-24

**Last Session

- We went straight into a giant Tsunami

**This session**

Recap/retro

We go to The Heart! We arrive there on the evening before day -5.
We explain to the crew that they must *not* interact with anything outside of the ship, or else the universe as they know it will be eaten by black ravens.

We end up on an island, crowded by an oak tree forest. A small crows of deer, unafraid, make their way to your vessel.

![](media/whatsapp-image-2023-11-24-at-22-00-34.jpg)

It is night. We see fireflies everywhere. We decide to sleep until 8 o'clock in the morning.

*Day -5, 8 o'clock in the morning*

I enter the island carrying my egg in the egg-baby-sling, packed in a layer of leather, straw and some hottened rocks.

we follow a golden ram onto the island, after all animals on the beach called it.

![](media/golden-ram.jpg)

- We see all kinds of small, green fruits on the trees.
- We end up on a clearing with a lot of apple trees.
- The others start meditating at the tree; I see energy flowing from them to the tree. I see [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) react even more strongly to it. Finally, I decide to join them.

Thyphoon asks [Thylea](wiki:thylea-titan) how we can "befriend?" [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons). It's very dark where they're captured.

![](media/whatsapp-image-2023-11-24-at-22-00-39.jpg)

I ask Thylea if any dragons will hatch within the next 7 days.

![](media/gaius.jpg)

We go back, and collect some fruit on the way back.

When we leave(?) the forest, we see a Pegasus coming down from the sky.

- He no likey me

notes.title: Session 54

fields.summary: A vision of the Titans and the Hydra; we sail to Themis in disguise and find a slain Amazon's letter about the queen's cursed helm.

notes.body:
2023-12-15

**Last Session

- We went to the golden heart
- We picked golden apples, which are essentially goodberries
- We asked the tree:
	- Which dragons will hatch in the next 7 days ([Gaius](wiki:gaius) and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon))
	- How can we befriend [the amazons](wiki:the-amazons) (we saw  a captured Amazon on [Themis](wiki:themis))
- We can apparently dip the golden apples at the forge

**This session**
Day -5 in the afternoon.
We plan to go to the Amazons - [Themis](wiki:themis).

Mother [Thylea](wiki:thylea-titan) appears in front of us, we touch her and get a vision (song: Still alive - We were on the island of Thylea)
- A small plant grows and grows, until it becomes a giant tree on an island. Until the island is surrounded by thousands of hands - grabbing for one of the fruits of Thylea, yeeting them in the water.
- Time passes, and the fruits sprout into Titans. They build the islands. Most start to blur, but one jumps out: 200 feet tall, bald, ... It creates all of the Fae races, filling Thylea with wealth. 
- Thyphoon tracks [Chalcia](wiki:chalcia-titan) - she looks identical to [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah)... What the fuck?
- More and more time passes. Thylea is bustling with life - thousands of years before the dragonlords arrive. [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) and [Sydon](wiki:sydon-titan) start a war against the other titans
- They go to "some person" and say something.... And, with great effort, and insect-like race is created. The "other person" regrets what he did. The other titans work together to cull the plague of insects, and put it under the dome.
- The power of that other titan is taken, and given to Lutheria as a ... scythe. Lutheria gouges out his eyes, and he is reduced to pulling a giant boat.
- Timejump! A giant sword rises from the ground, glowing brightly. That sword could potentially free that other titan! [The sword](wiki:the-sword) disappears, and in its place a giant reptile-like beast appears from the shadow of the sword. It's a fucking [Hydra](wiki:hydra). It has "the sword" in its belly.
	- [Brax](wiki:brax) focusses on the Hydra: he sees it in a "slice of cake"-shaped cave. In the outer part of the pie, there is a shallow bit of water. In one of the corners on the outside is a bronze plate with intricate runes.

We prepare for [Themis](wiki:themis).
Brax is dressed up like a woman.
I apply some makup and loosen my hair to look more female as well.

![](media/minotaur-trixie-realistic.jpg)

The island we see ahead of us is certainly the largest of the ones we've seen so far.

We convince Kyrah to come along!

We talk to the Amazons we have on board.
- Years ago, the Amazons also lived on Indigo Island. But: during the first war, they lost. Badly. Because of it, they decided that they lost due to men, and moved to a new colony - the Island of [Themis](wiki:themis). 

We get off board and go to land. Our plan is to go to the temple we saw on our way here.
Thyphoon sees a pretty dead Amazon on the beach. He also notices "festival music" (folk music). And... Men laughing?
[Atyche](wiki:atyche) flies there.
She sees [Netusia, the Winter Wind](wiki:netusia-the-winter-wind), one of [The Satyrs](wiki:the-satyrs).

The other three of us go to the dead body. 
We find a letter.

> μεδ Γυαρδiαν Χαλλiστα,
> 
> Uνδερ θε ωατχηφυλ ευεσ οφ θε μοον, I πεν θεσε ωορδσ ωiθ α ηεαρτ βοθ υiγiλαντ ανδ ηεαυυ. Ουρ λανδ ωηiσπερσ σεχρετσ, υετ θευ ρεμαiν χλοακεδ iν θε δενσε μiστ οφ υνχερταiντυ. I ηαυε πατρολλεδ θε τρεαχηερουσ εαστερν βαυ, ωηερε θε σεα γνασηεσ iτσ τεεθ αγαiνστ θε σηορε, ανδ μυ θουγητσ αρε ασ τυμυλτυουσ ασ θε ωατερσ.
>

Υετ, ωηατ λiεσ βενεαθ iτσ λυστρουσ συρφαχε, ωε δαρε νοτ qυεστiον. Θε αiρ αρουνδ θε θρονε iσ ηεαυυ, λαδεν ωiθ αν υνσποκεν τρυθ, ασ iφ Λυθερiα ηερσελφ ωατχηεσ θρουγη υνσεεν ευεσ.
> 
> Θε χρεατυρεσ οφ Θεμiσ, ευερ αττυνεδ το θε ηεαρτβεατ οφ θε iσλανδ, ηαυε βεγυν το αχτ μοστ πεχυλiαρλυ. Θε γiραφφεσ στρετχη θεiρ νεχκσ τοωαρδσ θε ηεαυενσ ασ iφ σεεκiνγ χουνσελ φρομ θε γοδσ, ανδ θε ρηiνοχεροσεσ παυσε μiδ-στρiδε, σνiφφiνγ θε αiρ φορ α σχεντ ωε χαννοτ δετεχτ. Ευεν θε στiμφαυ χiρχλε υνεασiλυ, θεiρ μεταλλiχ φεαθερσ χατχηiνγ θε συν iν ανξiουσ γλiμμερσ.
> Iν ουρ σαχρεδ δυτυ, ωε ρεμαiν υiγiλαντ, υετ α σηαδοω ηανγσ ουερ ουρ χαμψ. Ρυμορσ οφ φορεiγν υεσσελσ, μερε πηαντομσ iν θε φογ, ηαυε ρεαχηεδ μυ εαρσ. Ωε μουε ωiθ θε στεαλθ οφ θε πανθερ, βυτ ουρ ευεσ αρε ευερ δραων το θε ηορiζον, σεεκiνγ θε υνκνοων.

> Θε Γρεατ Γαμε ενδυρεσ, α δανχε οφ στρενγθ ανδ χυννiνγ. Υετ, iν θε qυiετ μομεντσ, I φiνδ μυσελφ πονδερiνγ θε υνσεεν θρεαδσ θατ ωεαυε θρουγη ουρ φατε. Ωηατ μυστερiεσ δο θε γοδσ χονχεαλ φρομ θεiρ μορταλ χηiλδρεν? Ανδ ωηατ πρiχε μυστ ωε παυ φορ θε κνοωλεδγε ωε σεεκ?

> 
> Iν στρενγθ ανδ σηαδοω,
> 
> Ρανγερ Θεοδορα

Of in 't Engels

> To the Esteemed Guardian Callista,
> 
> Under the watchful eyes of the moon, I pen these words with a heart both vigilant and heavy. Our land whispers secrets, yet they remain cloaked in the dense mist of uncertainty. I have patrolled the treacherous eastern bay, where the sea gnashes its teeth against the shore, and my thoughts are as tumultuous as the waters.
> 
> Our kin speak in hushed tones of the platinum helm that rests upon our Queen's brow. It glimmers not just with the light of the stars, but with a deeper, older magic. Yet, what lies beneath its lustrous surface, we dare not question. The air around the throne is heavy, laden with an unspoken truth, as if Lutheria herself watches through unseen eyes.
> 
> The creatures of Themis, ever attuned to the heartbeat of the island, have begun to act most peculiarly. The giraffes stretch their necks towards the heavens as if seeking counsel from the gods, and the rhinoceroses pause mid-stride, sniffing the air for a scent we cannot detect. Even the stimfay circle uneasily, their metallic feathers catching the sun in anxious glimmers.
> 
> In our sacred duty, we remain vigilant, yet a shadow hangs over our camps. Rumors of foreign vessels, mere phantoms in the fog, have reached my ears. We move with the stealth of the panther, but our eyes are ever drawn to the horizon, seeking the unknown.
> 
> The Great Game endures, a dance of strength and cunning. Yet, in the quiet moments, I find myself pondering the unseen threads that weave through our fate. What mysteries do the gods conceal from their mortal children? And what price must we pay for the knowledge we seek?
> 
> Guardian, your wisdom is the rudder that steers us through these troubled waters. I await your counsel, as the night awaits the dawn.
> 
> In strength and shadow,
> 
> Ranger Theodora

We want to steal the [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara) from [Netusia, the Winter Wind](wiki:netusia-the-winter-wind).

Plan:
- We cast invisibility + bardic inspiration on Atyche. Thyphoon casts bless on Atyche, me and ...?. Atyche flies in and tries to steal the [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara)
- If this would fail: I cast greater invisibility on myself, followed by dimensional door

notes.title: Session 55

fields.summary: Atyche steals the Notos Kitara; we evade Amazons and basilisks and fight awakening marble golems.

notes.body:
2024-01-06

**Last Session

- We went to [Themis](wiki:themis).
- We found a letter in greek from ranger Theodora, talking about the queen's helm. Apparently, [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) watches through it.
- Retcon: women are accepted by [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons). Men only as sex-slaves.
- We found a nice little orgy. Rutting, not rotting.

**This session**

- Day -4, in the evening.

We try to steal the [Notos Kitara](wiki:notos-kitara) (song: How we got the Kitara).
- [Atyche](wiki:atyche), blessed, inspired and invisible, flies to one of [The Satyrs](wiki:the-satyrs) - [Netusia, the Winter Wind](wiki:netusia-the-winter-wind) - disarms him with command and flies back to us.
- She hands it to [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah)!
- In the meantime, [Brax](wiki:brax) and Bibi were rolling over the ground towards the camp, just in case.
![](media/minotaurs-wrestling.jpg)
We start walking towards the Altar we saw on the other side of the island when we arrived by boat. 

We overnight with Leomond's Tiny Hut.

Day -3.
We travel on. Somewhere on the way, we try to hide from a group of somethings approaching us... But they're basilisks? Amazons, riding armored rhinos, and some basilisks.
- 4 amazon warriors
- 4 rhinos
- 4 basilisks
We hide and they pass us. When looking around, we see some more.
Around 3 in the afternoon, we arrive at the altar

Travel to the altar, which is amidst a forest of stone pillars, as follows:
- Kyrah is ballooned with levitate
- Atyche flies and pulls Kyrah along
- Brax and Bibi get "jump" and jump the 120ft to the pillar
- [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) and I "dimensional door" there.
After arriving, we do find an invisible bridge that also leads to the pillar. Oh well.

We stumble upon a forest of petrified men. Either really beautiful, naked men, or heavily scarred/dismembered people. Hundreds of them.
Furthermore, a large entrance in the cave.

Some of the statues awaken and attack us!

*Battle notes*
I get dragon's breath - acid

We end the session after destroying the marble golems, at 3:30 in the afternoon (song: Battle against the golems on petrified forest pillar).
Plan for next session: short/long rest and go into the mountain?

notes.title: Session 56

fields.summary: We push into the sacred temple and battle Amazons and an Amazon commanding four basilisks.

notes.body:
2024-01-19

notes.title: Session 57

fields.summary: We slay the Hydra, recover Titansbane from its stomach, and free Darien, the rightful queen.

notes.body:
2024-03-16

**Last Session

- We arrived at the sacred temple, the prisoner's tower
- We fought marble warriors and spent some time, until midnight, waiting
- We entered the temple and fought our way through the first floor
- Brax got stuck between two embrasures in the hallway down, where we know there's a [hydra](wiki:hydra)!

**This session**

*We start in the night of Day -2.*

Giant Constrictor Healthpool:
1. 3hp
2. 3hp
3. 3hp
4. 3hp
5. 3hp
6. 13hp
7. 13hp
8. 13hp

It went *very* dead.
We found *Titansbane, the blade of [Talieus - The Bald, Blind Titan](wiki:talieus-titan)* in the stomach of the Hydra (song: Battle against the Hydra in prisoner's tower).

I inspect the plate.
The runes talk about [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), and it looks like a teleport pad... Somewhere. I send my snake squad through and tell them to attack. *11 to hit.*

We dispatch of two more guards on the same floor, and we find cells full of prisoners. We find the Amazon prisoner there as well, the one we were looking for.

We are apparently called "The Holy Fainted Bras".

The Amazon we free is called "[Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis)", and she is the rightful queen of [Themis](wiki:themis).
She speaks of a group of Amazons that usurped the throne of her mother. [The Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) were badly malformed, with heads filled with snakes. She has been captured here for 14 years now, and is nearly of age - the age where she could've been harmed, according to the oath her mom swore.

We recruit the lizardfolk to our party until we help queen [Queen Vita](wiki:queen-vita).

We are now called:
- Mariah ([Atyche](wiki:atyche))
- Gareth ([Yendithas](wiki:yendithas))
- Tydus ([Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon))
- Brax ([Brax](wiki:brax))
- Sisi ([Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi))
- Linda ([Kyrah](wiki:kyrah))

notes.title: Session 58

fields.summary: We smash a statue of Lutheria and capture Leah the Medusa, the false queen.

notes.body:
2024-07-05

**Last Session

- We battled in the sacred temple
- We fought a [hydra](wiki:hydra)
- We introduced ourselves as [Atyche](wiki:atyche), [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas), [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon), [Brax](wiki:brax), [Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi) and [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) to [Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis).

**This session**

We start on Day -2, 02:30.

We have the choice of going to [Bront the Jancan](wiki:bront-the-jancan), father of [Steros the Jancan](wiki:steros-the-jancan), or to the other stairwell going... Somewhere.

Exposition:
Around 25 years ago dragons were spotted again, [Bront the Jancan](wiki:bront-the-jancan) was captured, [Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) was captured, and... More?

We go to the queen.
- We encounter a locked door, with switches to the sides of it.
- We open the door... And find another door.
- There are scratches on the doors. They smell of something that Brax also smelled around the foot of the colossus. No idea what it is.
- And we find a third door!
	- This one has a barred window.
	- Beyond is a room, beyond with is another, open door. There's also three levers.
- We find a final door after a T-split, and we see a door with the symbols of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) on it.

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) inspects the men in underwear beyond the Lutheria-door. They are a little dehydrated.
They refuse to cooperate.

We turn around and go the other way. There, we see another door.
Behind it are a number of bunk beds, a scroll with writing on it, and a large number of bronze medals that look like the ones won at the games.

> A sisterhood of equals
> our strength forged in battle
> Death before Dishonor

The scroll says:
- A sisterhood of equals, our strength forged in battle, death before dishonor.

After that, there's a room with large beds. There are several men, women and satyrs pleasuring each other.

In the next room, we find a statue of Lutheria, which Brax smashes (HULK SMASH).

We enter the next room, where we find the fake queen fornicating. Brax bodyslams them and we keep an eye on the rest.
She says her sister is the queen... She's called [Leah the Amazon (formerly Sanfac)](wiki:leah-the-amazon-formerly-sanfac), sister of queen [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm).
We fight! They're not doing great.

We end up knocking out Leah. The helmet seems to be a sending stone that's paired up.

We also found in this room:
- A key that does not fit anything in that room
- Leah is permanently blind

We looted the room:
- A sending stone in a small bronze chest
- 100 gold pieces, 75 platinum pieces
- the key

notes.title: Session 59

fields.summary: Interrogations reveal the Medusa coup and Lutheria's oath; we meet the captive smith Bront.

notes.body:
2024-08-09

**Last Session

- We knocked out the fake queen [Leah the Amazon (formerly Sanfac)](wiki:leah-the-amazon-formerly-sanfac), right hand of [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm).
- We found a scroll that's apparently important.

**This session**

We start at 3:30, day -2.

[Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) is being protected upstairs by [Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi) and [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah).

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) sends a message to [Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) to check in with them. We decide to go back to them.

We grab two half-carafes of drugged wine from the orgy room.
In the next room, we search through the weapons in the next room where they disrobed - and we find not-that-well-cared-for weapons. I loot a rapier.

We arrive at Darien. The three lizardfolk let us through. Darien did not know that Leah was a Medusa.

Thyphoon asks Darien about 25 years ago. She tells us that all of a sudden, one day, her mom's sister (her aunt?) did a coup. It's "like she went mad". [Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) never wear helmets, and on that day, she was wearing a helmet that looks a lot like [Leah the Amazon (formerly Sanfac)](wiki:leah-the-amazon-formerly-sanfac)'s. So... [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm) is also a fake?

- What's the real name of her "sister"?
	- [Sanasm](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm), also a Medusa for the last 25 years.
- What happened to the real one?
	- They gave them a "fake" solution. They were not allowed to kill Darien. Afterwards, however, they "pushed her into the rocks". Brought them to the sacred temple and they pushed her to the cliffs. So, probably dead.
- What happened 25 years ago?
	- They were on the north coast with a group of people. A giant fog surrounded them, and... They were "persuaded" to join with ([Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)?)
		- "We" was:
		- A small group of 4 Medusa: Sanasm, Leah, Sansat, Sancom. The others are about as important as Leah.
- Is darian's mother really dead?
	- Probably.
- What was the plan with Darian
	- She doesn't know the rest of the plan, Lutheria only spoke to [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm).
- "The tributes" downstairs.
- The Jancan makes weapons for the Medusa.
- The queen also has the weapons of Leah.
- Apparently, Medusa can manifest monster-claws.
Their new oath: unending loyalty to Lutheria, in exchange for UNLIMITED POWER.
They swore the oath, went knockout, and days later they were found by the other Amazons. They've been feeling a lot stronger since then... And she was wearing a helmet that she would never take off.
After each great hunt, [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm) would come to this temple. In the meantime, she's... Somewhere on the island.
The next great hunt will be in a day or two, and lasts about a day.

[Lady of Coins, Moxena](wiki:lady-of-coins-moxena) was the fifth of the party, but she was fighting Lutheria a little too hard. So she was banned to [Thylea](wiki:thylea). But the sending stone is apparently connected to her!
She managed to keep the gift of Lutheria (maybe?) while going her own way.

The key we found is for the chain of [Steros the Jancan](wiki:steros-the-jancan).

She barely knows anything about other islands, but Leah herself barely knows anything about the going-ons on other islands.

Also, apparently Lutheria's oath was broken by Leah, but... She didn't die from it?

We know that Jancans are near-mythical creatures. But... 25 years ago, there suddenly was a large influx of Jancans! Whaaaat

We go to [Bront the Jancan](wiki:bront-the-jancan). He has a large pile of unfinished, man-sized mechanical birds. He says he really wants to go back to [Jamkor](wiki:king-jamkor). But when we say we follow [the five](wiki:the-five), he completely shuts down.

I steal one of his adamantine shortswords.

We go for a long rest at 5 in the morning, so we will rest until about

fields.summary: In Estoria we learn Pythor's daughter is to be sacrificed, and Aesop asks us to bring the stolen Horn of Balmytria to Vallus.

notes.body:
"Corona saturday, 2" (wow, I still counted at this point?)

We travel to [Estoria](wiki:estoria).
We dream about [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan), as a maniacally laughing woman who taunts us. 
We also see an old, saddened man, tied to a ...spit?

Someone broke into the dragon shrine. There's a lot of glass on the floor, and some "purple stains".

I have some notes here about Goatlings and Maenad, I can't remember if we encounter them here, but:

	- Head of a goat

notes.body:
2024-08-23

-   We interrogated [Leah the Amazon (formerly Sanfac)](wiki:leah-the-amazon-formerly-sanfac) and went to [Steros the Jancan](wiki:steros-the-jancan). I stole one of the swords.

notes.title: Session 63

fields.summary: We find the satyr camp destroyed and make a stand to steal the false queen's crown.

notes.body:
2025-01-03

**Last Session

- We woke from the dream
- I went and got the gemstone eyes from the statue of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) down below, and looted the remainder of the stuff inside the [hydra](wiki:hydra) (2kgp, emerald ring, etc., enough to pay back [the Fates](wiki:the-fates), which was 420 platinum)
- We went to a mountain and set up a scouting location

**This session**

We start on day -2(?), and are going to travel to the Ultros to get help from [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons) on our crew(?). If we keep walking, we can get to the boat at midnight on day -1 ( #daytracker).

We encounter the "sex camp". It seems completely destroyed, at least a day back.
When looking around the camp, it seems they have been attacked by one or more people with adamantine daggers. [Netusia, the Winter Wind](wiki:netusia-the-winter-wind) is dead as well.

It seems like their attackers were willingly let in, and they attacked them afterwards. We're quite sure they're far away by now.

The daggers that are left behind give off no magical energy, but the symbol of Lutheria has been carved into them.

Horns start bleating far, far away. We see the entire horizon filling with lights and they're clearly casting a "search net".

We decide to take a stand and try to steal the crown off the [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm)'s head. We enter battle. (Song: The crown of the false queen)

notes.title: Session 64

fields.summary: We defeat Thesilea the 6th, risen as a Euryale, crown Thyphoon queen, and make Darien regent of the island.

notes.body:
2025-02-09

**Last Session

- We figured out there are several (many) ritual sites to [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan) on the island
- We went to the boat (TO THE BOAT)
- Encountered the ransacked sex camp
- 
- FIIIIIGHT

**This session**

The fight continues!
- I run away, invisible, to escape the rhinoceros onslaught
- [Brax](wiki:brax) takes the hit of all rhinos that were formerly on me, now rushing him
	- Two natural 20 saves against the rushes
- [Atyche](wiki:atyche) fireballs the whole group, immotaling me as well - I'm down
Brax finishes the fight by killing the last standing rhino _and_ the queen

A moment before she dies, she whispers...
*I.... Accept...*
The entire battlefield is surrounded by black mist. [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) screams ***NOOOO***. Brax feels himself get carried away from the queen, and he ends up next to Kyrah, who suddenly stands in the middle of the battlefield.
The magical darkness evaporates, becoming black mist on the ground. All (enemy) bodies on the field are grabbed by shadow hands and pulled into the ground. The same hands tear the flesh off of the body of [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm), until all that remains is a snake-like creature. Lower body of a snake, upper body a more angry Thesilea.

![](media/pasted-image-20250209211558.jpg)

I get healed back up (a little) by Thyphoon.

The Lutherified Thesilea comes at us.

A rough fight later, with two brown bears being involved, Thyphoon grabs onto her, dealing necrotic damage, and tearing off snake by snake. They all get pulled down by the same black hands, until finally [Queen Thesilea the 6th (formerly Sanasm)](wiki:queen-thesilea-the-6th-formerly-sanasm) herself is pulled down with the sound of thousands of tortured souls.

The black mist clears.

According to Kyrah, what Thesilea turned into was a [Euryale](wiki:euryale).

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) becomes queen of the [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons)?

It turns out [Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) had sworn an oath to not leave the island.

We use a yellow signal arrow to call for a council, at the temple.

#daytracker It is now 1 after midnight on day -1.

The [Party Name - The Holy Fainted Bras](wiki:party-name-the-holy-fainted-bras) are now #fame level 2!

We end up going to the temple, everyone is happy with [Darien, the rightful queen of Themis](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis), party party party happy, done. [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) is now queen and grants Darien govereigncy.

#daytracker we end at 7 in the morning, on day -1. We had a short rest in the meantime, but no long rest yet.

notes.title: Session 65

fields.summary: Hailed as leaders, we set sail and fight Malfeshnekor the Chimera on reaching its island.

notes.body:
2025-02-24

**Last Session

- We finished the battle against the [the Amazons](wiki:the-amazons)
- We arrived at the temple
- We made [Darien](wiki:darien-the-rightful-queen-of-themis) queen regent(?)

**This session**

We slept until 7 in the morning, day -1.
We are hailed as leaders of the island.

> The Amazons used to be a well-working community
> Thesileah seemed to be OK
> Then, one of the factions did a coup
> They made Thesileah the 5th disappear

[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) makes flowers appear by telling a story about Thyleah.

They will train a bunch of amazons to be ready for the big fight.

We tell them to start up relations again in 14 days, which is after we heard [Vallus](wiki:vallus) talk about the Amazons.

We arrived at the boat on day -1 at 12:00.

We can go to:
- [Aresia](wiki:aresia)
- Pythoria
- Island of the Chimera

We decide to go to [Chimera island](wiki:chimera-island), the constellation of the trickster.

At 06:00 in the morning on day 0:
Smell: fire and brimstone, the savannah and ...
[Malfeshnekor the Chimera](wiki:malfeshnekor-the-chimera)

We enter battle!
- Natural 20 piercing damage with a longbow by [Brax](wiki:brax). Lightning shot that the chimera shrugs off.
- Brax makes a running jump onto the Chimera and slams down with Titansbane. 
- After throwing both Bibi and Brax off of him, [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) summons vultures to catch them, and the chimera flies to Yendithas and [Atyche](wiki:atyche). It breathes fire, but they shrug it off like it's nothing (2x nat 20 saves)

notes.title: Session 66

fields.summary: After slaying the Chimera we read Damon's warning and descend the volcano to a sea of bones and an awakening Death Tyrant.

notes.body:
2025-10-12
## Recap vorige sessie
- Day 0, 9:00, we entered battle with a Chimera, and slaughtered it
- The chimera was put on ice

## This session
Starting at [OOTD Day](wiki:) 0

We are on the Ultros, traveling to the island of the chimera. (Song: The Chimera Malfeshnekor and the Tyrant beneath the volcano)
- The cold egg (Thyphoon's) currently is wiggling.

It's cloudy over [Chimera island](wiki:chimera-island)...
[Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) is going to Augur if going to the nest of the Chimera is a bad idea or not.
- Go and find the nest of the Chimera, result:
- Weal and woe (good and bad)
We arrive on the island. A lot of ships around it, all broken.
Our neck hairs start to stand up as we arrive at the island.
- [Atyche](wiki:atyche) will scout
I try to recall my past... And I remember this used to be important even back then. The dragonlords "had something to do" with the island. But I can't recall more than that.

There's clearly mist around the mountain, but Atyche can still see clearly.
- She scouts, and between the trees around 9-10 o'clock in the bay, she sees grave mounds.
- Some of the grave mounds are fresh!
I use a telepathic link once Atyche goes out of reach, using my daily cast.
There's a clear entrance to the mountain at the center of the crescent bay. A path through the forest goes towards it from the beach. Atyche does see a large marble pedestal.
Atyche returns after a final scout.
Getting close to the center of the bay would be trifficult, so we should land on one of the points of the crescent.

Thyphoon suddenly feels a burst of Abjuration magic coming from the corpse of the Chimera. We go there, and see glowing runes on the body.
- The legs of the chimera smell like death. That same smell extends over the entire island.
- It seems like the Chimera dug the graves we saw?
- At the same time, the chilling effect becomes worse.
- We now see smoke coming from the opening of the mountain.
- The mist is clearly unnatural, according to Thyphoon.

We go to land with
- The four of us
- [Bullbug (Sisi)](wiki:bullbug-sisi)
- [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah)
And go to the left (western?) point of the bay.
We decide to go to [The island of the Exiles](wiki:) next, and set the Antikithera to the warrior.

Current weather: stage 3 precipitation, stage 4 temperature, stage 1 wind.
We walk over the beach. About an hour later, we end up at the middle.
- The weather is starting to clear up, to stage 2 precipitation 
The graves give off a faint whiff of necromancy.
- Everything is in pristine maintenance
- There's a "gradient" in how fresh the mounds are. More towards the water is newer.
- The graves clearly smell like the chimera, and the footsteps of the Chimera are all between them.
There's a large difference between how old the ships are.
- Also ships from the time of the dragonlords
- Not a single marking of the dragonlords on them.

![](media/pasted-image-20251012214933.jpg)
The closer we get to the pedestal, the stronger our feeling of unease becomes.
- The clearing around the pedestal itself looks like it could have been the sleeping place of the Chimera.
- In the center, we see the pedestal.
- On top of the pedestal, we see a codex (a scroll / cryptex / thing)
- On the pedestal itself, there are markings. They look like drawings.

Detect magic by Thyphoon.
- There's no magic from anything around here.

The pedestal:
- Dragonlords led by Damon
- A lot of dragonlord corpses. One person stands, cloak tattered. He gestures "just one more thing"
- Damon locks something behind doors. What's locked away is crossed out.
- On the last panel, a chimera bows before this person.
- The person is [Damon](wiki:damon).

We probably unleashed whatever is in there by killing the Chimera.

> To whomever finds this letter,
> 
> If you are reading these words, then you have done what so many before you could not. You have slain the chimera. For this, I can only offer my admiration and my sorrow.
> 
> Know that I do not write to condemn you. How could I? You faced a terrible beast and emerged victorious. Such courage is worthy of the heroes of old, the very dragonlords I once called companions. Yet courage and wisdom are not always companions themselves, and so I must tell you what your victory has truly wrought.
> 
> The create you felled was no mere monster. Five hundred years ago, I bound it by oath to guard this place, not to hoard treasure, not to terrorise sailors for sport, but to preotect them. Every ship it turned away, every warrior it drove back to the sea... These were mercies. Few souls proved as determined as you. But where they failed and you succeeded, the true trial now begins.
> 
> Beneath this island sleeps an evil I could not destroy, only contain. Already, you may feel it. The very stones grow cold. The air grows heavy. The dead, so carefully tended, will not rest much longer. Without the chimera's living presence, the wards I wove centuries ago begin to crumble like ancient parchment.
> 
> You have won your battle, brave souls. I do not doubt your prowess. But battles and wars are different things , and this war was decided long before you were born.
> 
> Perhaps you have heard tales of the oath of peace that grand treaty sealed five hundred years ago, between titans and gods. The histories will tell of noble sacrifice and wisdom prevailing. But I doubt they tell of the game that preceded it. They do not speak of twenty squares beneath a great tree, of dice soaked in dragon's blood, of divine power wagered and lost, and stolen in turn.
> 
> I was there, I saw the price paid. I carried the scroll and the bodies home.
> 
> And I learned that some wars never truly end. They merely pause, transform, take new shapes. Take new shapes. The powers that shaped our world play games still, games within games, and mortals are often their pieces. This island, this guardian, this evil below, they are not random chance, nothing ever is.
> 
> You will find your way to the center soon enough. The path will open now that the chimera no longer bars it. There, you will face a choice: confront what lurks in the depths, or restore what I built to contain it. Perhaps there is a third way your younger minds might see that mine could not.
> 
> I do not know if you will survive what comes next. I barely did, and I paid a price that still weighs upon my bones, all that remains of me now.
> 
> But I have seen enough heroes rise and fall to know this: you have come this far. That means something. Whether [the fates](wiki:the-fates) guides you here or you wandered into their game by pure chance, you are here nonetheless.
> 
> The pieces move. The game continues. Do not let it all have been for nothing.
> 
> - Damon, last companion of the dragonlords, guardian of the Necropolis, witness to the seventh game.

- 20 squares is an ancient game, played on [Thylea](wiki:thylea) since antiquity
- We now deduce that the oath of peace was sworn beneath the tree of Thylea, on The Golden Heart
- All I remember from it is that way back when, the titans did everything they could to create creatures that would cause as much damage as they could.

The mountain was not a mountain, but a dormant volcano. We faced another earthquake when going that way. We find crumbling doors...
- The runes on the door are written in Draconic
- Taking our coin, we see several words recurring:
	- Sanctified bones of an adventurer
	- Obsidian glass
	- A sacrifice
	- The heart of the protector
- Going inside, we find bodies that look like dragonlords
- We keep going. We see a lot of bodies, some of which seem to be moving.
- we see a faint glowing 500 feet ahead of us, every +- 15 seconds. It gets brighter every time it happens.
- At 250 feet, the skeletons start twitching more and more.
- The closer we get, the more the skeletons move. We speed up.
- Some actually start pushing themselves up - but their bones are too brittle.
- At 20 feet, the tunnel starts to flatten out - and we see a gigantic round cave, 150 feet diameter, with a sea of bones - not an empty space to be seen.

In the middle, on a pile of bones, we see... A giant skull, with dots of red light around it. In the middle of the skill, a single eye, with a red light from it.
- Thyphoon helps us think of legendary creatures called Beholders.
- When it decomposes, you get what we see.
- It likely only got stronger over time.
- It still seems to be in deep slumber.
- Actual skeletons seem to come to life below it.

notes.title: Session 67

notes.body:
## Recap vorige sessie
[Session 66](wiki:session-66)
- We arrived on the [Chimera Island](wiki:chimera-island) and we felt death and decay waking
- We found a pedestal in front of a mountain, showing how [Damon](wiki:damon) sealed away *something* after failing to defeat it.
- We found a mountain, and entered it. The mountain was shaking.
- We found more and more bones, clearly from old dragonlords, behind a door that was slowly opening
- Once we finally reached the bottom of the hallway into the volcano, we found a huge chamber with a large skull, with one eye, awakening. A death tyrant.
## This session
Starting at [OOTD Day](wiki:) 0

##### Retcons

Retroactive history check on the game of 20 squares:
> The game of 20 squares is more commonly known as the royal game. It's sacred, played by gods and mortals since the dawn of time. Kings sometimes use this game to resolve a conflict to avoid war.
- We can assume that the goddess [Mytros](wiki:mytros-god) sacrificed her power to achieve the oath of peace using this game.

The ingredients to seal
- Heart of the guardian - the core of protection, still warm with duty
- Bones of the faithful - three who died in service, sanctified by a priest, cleric or person of stature
- Volcanic glass - shaped in to the seal of containment, seven shards arranged as a seven-pointed star
- The price - all bindings require sacrifice. Blood of the willing, freely given, or taken with permission.
	- We can assume this is a significant amount of blood - nothing a long rest won't restore.
The ritual. must be performed at the entrance before the threat rises. The wards will hold for as long as the guardian is alive provided the sacrifice is successful.

We decide to try and seal.
- [Atyche](wiki:atyche) flies to the boat
- [Yendithas](wiki:yendithas) and [Thyphoon](wiki:thyphoon) run for the graves for the sanctified bones.
- [Brax](wiki:brax) goes to collect obsidian

Atyche flies off, and cuts the still beating heart out of the Chimera.

Thyphoon and I go to collect bones. We findt he oldest graves, and some of them were still engraved. I recognize some:
Names
- Captain Theron Steelwind
	- > I go willingly into the dark, that other may sail in light. Let my bones be the foundation.
	- Was one of those who willingly offered up his bones for this ritual back then.
- Sister Calista
	- > The prayers answer.
	- She was one of the medics, Mother Theresa-like, who tried to help out the dragonlords.
- Young Apprentice Niklos
	- A stone-hewn tablet: "Master Damon tells us we're doing something important, Ma. Something that will protect others. Know that I was brave."
We open the three graves and take a bone from each, then close it back up.

Brax collects the Obsidian.

We arrive back at the entrance of the cave. The newer graves are visibly moving. The closer to the mountain, the more they move.

notes.body:
## Recap vorige sessie
- We talked about what to do for a long, long time
- We gathered ingredients for the ritual to seal it away again
- [Kyrah](wiki:kyrah) stayed behind

## This session
Starting at [OOTD Day](wiki:) 0, 16:00

We all arrive at the entrance of the cave with all ingredients.
- Arrange the shards of dragonglass in a 7-pointed star
- The bones are a shield towards the door

> Seal in this rising threat,
> This terrible embodiment of death.
>
> Great guardian, rise up once more, *place the heart*
> To keep those ships off-shore,
> Who would set free this beast,
> As terrible weapon unleashed.
>
> Turn away with leeway those,
> Who without intent sail close.
>
> But do permit inside,
> Those whose blood your service binds. *sacrifice the blood*
> Their companions and close allies,
> Even if they did not pay this price.
>
> Now seal away this evil brood,
> Until we can deal with it for good!

The seals around the door start glowing *(progress bar)*
The undead arrive at great speed, but can't get closer through some kind of barrier.

We hear the Death Tyrant talk in our heads close to the end of the ritual. *NOOOOO! YOU WILL NOT CAGE ME AGAIN AFTER 500 YEARS!!*
The volcano starts rumbling, and while necrotic cold tries to grasp us, it slowly starts fading away...
The undead fall over when the door closes, the ritual components are consumed, and the chimera reforms in front of us.

We search for treasure in the bay and find...
- Treasure chest full of gold, silver, platinum, etc.
- 11k copper pieces (1.1p)
- 7k silver pieces (70 p)
- 2300 gold pieces (230 p)
- 25 gems, each worth 100 gold (common gems, no diamonds etc.)
- 3 gem-studded necklaces worth 500gp each
- 7 platinum rings worth 150gp each

We set sail for the bard: [Island of the Fates](wiki:island-of-the-fates).

Apparently, the ocean has gotten calmer. We depart around 9 in the evening.

..And arrive at the island at around 7 in the morning.

Everything on the island looks the same. Except... We see some kind of fiend, wielding a trident. 
It starts clicking, but it slowly transforms into Thylean.
> Meester wil dat jullie plan ten goede komt. Ik bied mijn expertise aan... Misschien brengt dat jullie dichter bij jullie doel.

Out of the tunnel comes [Gaius](wiki:gaius). No, it's actually a doppelganger.

We expect that the "Thing", [Mezz](wiki:mezz), is a messenger of [Chondrus](wiki:chondrus).
He says that his boss expects to win "time".
- "Always in service of [Lutheria](wiki:lutheria-titan)"

We reject his offer for more information if we promise to kill Gaius. He does promise us to "solve any loose ends" if we do happen to end up killing him.

They disappear into one of the other cave entrances and the way to [the Fates](wiki:the-fates) is open.
